speaker: James Talarico
role: 德州 · 候任参议员
title: James Talarico (D-TX) Full Victory Speech

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you, Chris.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，克里斯。

cues.en: Thank you, Blanca.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，布兰卡。

cues.en: And thank you all for being here.
cues.zh: 感谢大家来到这里。

cues.en: We just took back Texas.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚夺回了得克萨斯州！

cues.en: We just proved that all the money in the world is no match for the people of Texas.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚证明，全世界的金钱，也敌不过得州人民的力量。

cues.en: We just showed that a politics of division is no match for a politics of love.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚证明，制造分裂的政治，敌不过以爱为本的政治。

cues.en: And we just sent a message to every billionaire mega donor, every trillionaire mega donor.
cues.zh: 我们也向每一位身家数十亿、乃至数万亿的巨额捐款人发出了信息。

cues.en: Every corrupt defender of this broken political system in this state, in this country, power belongs to the people.
cues.zh: 向这个州、这个国家里，维护这套失灵政治体制的每一个腐败之徒宣告：权力属于人民。

cues.en: I'm reminded of that story from Scripture of a shepherd boy who goes up against a giant.
cues.zh: 这让我想起《圣经》中那个牧羊少年对抗巨人的故事。

cues.en: For 40 days, Goliath teases and taunts.
cues.zh: 整整四十天，歌利亚不断挑衅、嘲弄。

cues.en: On the day of the fight, he shows up in full armor.
cues.zh: 决战那天，他全副武装地出现。

cues.en: He's carrying so many weapons he needs someone else to carry his shield.
cues.zh: 他带着那么多武器，甚至得让别人替他拿盾牌。

cues.en: In this race, we went up against our own Goliaths.
cues.zh: 这场竞选中，我们也面对着自己的“歌利亚”。

cues.en: The richest man in the world, the most powerful man in the world, and the entire Washington DC establishment.
cues.zh: 世界上最富有的人、最有权势的人，以及整个华盛顿的建制势力。

cues.en: David wasn't as big or as strong as Goliath.
cues.zh: 大卫没有歌利亚那么高大、强壮。

cues.en: He didn't have as many weapons, but he had hope.
cues.zh: 他的武器也没那么多，但他怀有希望。

cues.en: He had faith.
cues.zh: 他心有信仰。

cues.en: And he had a slingshot.
cues.zh: 他还有一副弹弓。

cues.en: You were my slingshot.
cues.zh: 你们就是我的弹弓。

cues.en: The people of Texas were my slingshot.
cues.zh: 得州人民，就是我的弹弓。

cues.en: And tonight And tonight, we defeated Goliath.
cues.zh: 而今晚，我们击败了歌利亚。

cues.en: Scripture has taught me, my own life has taught me, always bet on the underdog.
cues.zh: 《圣经》和我自己的人生都告诉我：永远要相信那些不被看好的人。

cues.en: Before I was a politician, I was a public school teacher.
cues.zh: 从政之前，我是一名公立学校教师。

cues.en: I taught language arts at Rhodes Middle School on the west side of San Antonio.
cues.zh: 我曾在圣安东尼奥西区的罗兹中学教授语言文学。

cues.en: And as I always say, teaching middle school is the best preparation for politics.
cues.zh: 正如我常说的，教中学生，是从政最好的准备。

cues.en: The west side is a beautiful, historic neighborhood.
cues.zh: 西区是一个美丽、历史悠久的社区。

cues.en: It's also one of the poorest zip codes in the entire state of Texas.
cues.zh: 它也是整个得州最贫困的地区之一。

cues.en: Every day, my students struggled heroically to overcome a rigged system.
cues.zh: 我的学生每天都在勇敢地抗争，努力跨越被不公平制度设置的障碍。

cues.en: My students weren't just kids.
cues.zh: 我的学生不只是孩子。

cues.en: They were survivors, dreamers, fighters.
cues.zh: 他们是顽强的生存者、追梦者、奋斗者。

cues.en: I saw it in their eyes every day.
cues.zh: 我每天都能从他们眼中看到这些。

cues.en: This unshakable resolve, this unconquered spirit.
cues.zh: 那种不可动摇的决心，那种不屈不挠的精神。

cues.en: Growing up, I saw that same fight in my mother.
cues.zh: 从小到大，我也在母亲身上看到过同样的斗志。

cues.en: A preacher's daughter from Laredo who left home at 19.
cues.zh: 她是拉雷多一位牧师的女儿，十九岁就离开了家。

cues.en: She moved up to Austin and met my birth father, a 21-year-old high school dropout whose drinking problem sometimes led to violence.
cues.zh: 她搬到奥斯汀，遇见了我的生父。他二十一岁，高中辍学，酗酒有时会引发暴力。

cues.en: One night he became abusive again.
cues.zh: 一天晚上，他再次施暴。

cues.en: But that night my mother's love rose to meet that abuse.
cues.zh: 但那一晚，母亲以爱鼓起勇气，反抗了暴力。

cues.en: She packed all our stuff into her little Ford Escort.
cues.zh: 她把我们所有的东西装进她那辆小小的福特 Escort。

cues.en: She drove me to the hotel where she worked.
cues.zh: 她开车带我来到自己工作的酒店。

cues.en: She begged the manager to let us stay in one of the rooms until we found this little apartment in East Austin.
cues.zh: 她恳求经理让我们暂住一间客房，直到我们在东奥斯汀找到一间小公寓。

cues.en: There wasn't there wasn't room for a nursery.
cues.zh: 公寓里腾不出一间婴儿房。

cues.en: So I slept in a crib in her closet.
cues.zh: 所以，我睡在她衣橱里的婴儿床上。

cues.en: And she was so proud of that closet.
cues.zh: 她却为那个衣橱感到无比自豪。

cues.en: She decorated it with pictures and toys.
cues.zh: 她用照片和玩具装饰它。

cues.en: No one was going to tell her it wasn't a nursery.
cues.zh: 谁也别想告诉她，那不是一间婴儿房。

cues.en: Always bet on the underdog.
cues.zh: 永远要相信不被看好的人。

cues.en: We were the underdogs in this race.
cues.zh: 这场竞选中，我们就是不被看好的那一方。

cues.en: We went up against nearly 40 years of doubt and disillusionment.
cues.zh: 我们面对的是将近四十年的怀疑与失望。

cues.en: We went up against more than $300 million, more than any Senate campaign in American history.
cues.zh: 我们面对的是超过三亿美元的资金，比美国历史上任何参议员竞选都多。

cues.en: We went up against all the negative ads, smear campaigns, foreign bots, and AI deep fakes that money can buy.
cues.zh: 我们面对的是金钱买得到的一切：负面广告、抹黑攻势、境外机器人账号和 AI 深度伪造。

cues.en: Those attacks were the final howls of a dying establishment.
cues.zh: 那些攻击，是垂死的建制势力最后的哀嚎。

cues.en: The death rattle of a status quo that knows its days are numbered.
cues.zh: 是一个自知时日无多的旧秩序发出的临终喘息。

cues.en: They played dirty because they were desperate.
cues.zh: 他们不择手段，因为他们已经走投无路。

cues.en: But we never lost hope.
cues.zh: 但我们从未失去希望。

cues.en: We never lost faith.
cues.zh: 我们从未失去信念。

cues.en: And against big money and long odds, we took our power back.
cues.zh: 面对巨额资金和悬殊的胜算，我们仍然夺回了自己的权力。

cues.en: Always, always bet on the underdog.
cues.zh: 永远，永远要相信不被看好的人。

cues.en: We built a movement unlike any this state has ever seen.
cues.zh: 我们建立了这个州前所未见的一场运动。

cues.en: We united Texans from all backgrounds and beliefs onto one team to take on this broken, corrupt political system.
cues.zh: 我们把不同背景、不同信仰的得州人团结在一起，共同挑战这个失灵、腐败的政治体制。

cues.en: First-time voters, three-time Trump voters, working people from every corner of this state who are fed up and ready for change.
cues.zh: 首次投票的人、三次投给特朗普的人，以及全州各地受够了现状、准备迎接改变的劳动者。

cues.en: This win is for every underdog who's been counted out and left behind.
cues.zh: 这场胜利，属于每一个被低估、被抛在身后的人。

cues.en: This win is for every teacher and every nurse, for every farmer and every rancher, for every young person who's trying to buy a home,
cues.zh: 属于每一位教师和护士、每一位农民和牧场主、每一个努力买房的年轻人，

cues.en: For every parent who's trying to put food on the table.
cues.zh: 也属于每一个为养家糊口而奔忙的父母。

cues.en: This win is for every Texan who's ever wondered if anyone is listening.
cues.zh: 这场胜利，属于每一个曾怀疑是否有人倾听自己的得州人。

cues.en: I heard you.
cues.zh: 我听见了你们。

cues.en: We heard you.
cues.zh: 我们听见了你们。

cues.en: And tonight the world hears you.
cues.zh: 而今晚，全世界都听见了你们。

cues.en: To the Texans who supported this movement, I am humbled by your trust and I will work every day to be worthy of it.
cues.zh: 对于支持这场运动的得州人，你们的信任让我深感谦卑；我会每天努力，不辜负这份信任。

cues.en: And to the Texans who didn't vote for me, I will be your senator too.
cues.zh: 对于没有投票给我的得州人，我也会是你们的参议员。

cues.en: I will always I will always serve you.
cues.zh: 我会始终为你们服务。

cues.en: I will always fight for you.
cues.zh: 我会始终为你们而奋斗。

cues.en: This win is not about the Democratic Party or Republican Party.
cues.zh: 这场胜利，不只关乎民主党或共和党。

cues.en: It's much bigger than that.
cues.zh: 它的意义远远超出党派。

cues.en: There is something broken in America.
cues.zh: 美国有些东西出了问题。

cues.en: Our economic system is broken.
cues.zh: 我们的经济体制出了问题。

cues.en: Our political system is broken.
cues.zh: 我们的政治体制出了问题。

cues.en: Even our relationships with each other feel broken.
cues.zh: 甚至我们彼此之间的关系，也让人觉得破碎了。

cues.en: That's because that's because the most powerful people in the world want it that way.
cues.zh: 这是因为，世界上最有权势的人，就希望事情变成这样。

cues.en: My granddad was a Baptist preacher in South Texas.
cues.zh: 我的外祖父是得州南部的一位浸礼会牧师。

cues.en: And when I was little, he told me that we follow a barefoot rabbi who gave us two commandments.
cues.zh: 小时候，他告诉我，我们追随的那位赤脚拉比，给了我们两条诫命。

cues.en: Love God and love neighbor.
cues.zh: 爱上帝，爱邻人。

cues.en: Because there is no love of God without love of neighbor.
cues.zh: 因为不爱邻人，就谈不上爱上帝。

cues.en: Every every single person bears the image of the sacred.
cues.zh: 每一个人，都体现着神圣的形象。

cues.en: Every single person is holy.
cues.zh: 每一个人，都是神圣的。

cues.en: Not just my neighbor who looks like me.
cues.zh: 不只是那些长得像我的邻人。

cues.en: Not just my neighbor who prays like me.
cues.zh: 不只是那些和我一样祈祷的邻人。

cues.en: Not just my neighbor who votes like me.
cues.zh: 不只是那些和我投票选择相同的邻人。

cues.en: I am called to love all of my neighbors the way I love myself.
cues.zh: 我蒙召去爱所有邻人，就像爱自己一样。

cues.en: Because despite our differences, we all want the same things.
cues.zh: 因为尽管我们存在差异，我们想要的其实是同样的东西。

cues.en: A safe neighborhood, a good job, a high quality, well-funded public school, and the ability to see a doctor when we need one.
cues.zh: 安全的社区、好的工作、优质且经费充足的公立学校，以及有需要时能看得起病。

cues.en: But the billionaires who own the social media algorithms, who own the cable news networks, who own the politicians fighting on our screens,
cues.zh: 但那些控制社交媒体算法、有线新闻网络，以及屏幕上互相争吵的政客的亿万富翁，

cues.en: They want us at each other's throats.
cues.zh: 他们想让我们彼此撕咬。

cues.en: They want us focused on how we're different instead of on how we're the same.
cues.zh: 他们想让我们只盯着彼此的不同，而忽略我们的共同之处。

cues.en: They want us looking left and right at each other instead of looking up at them.
cues.zh: 他们想让我们左右互斗，而不抬头看看上面的他们。

cues.en: The real fight in this country is not left versus right.
cues.zh: 这个国家真正的对抗，不是左派对右派。

cues.en: It is top versus bottom.
cues.zh: 而是上层对下层。

cues.en: The people at the top work so hard to keep us angry and divided because our unity is a threat to their wealth and their power.
cues.zh: 顶层的人竭力让我们愤怒、分裂，因为我们的团结，会威胁他们的财富和权力。

cues.en: We saw it in this race.
cues.zh: 我们在这场竞选中看到了这一点。

cues.en: We saw it in every billionaire funded attack ad.
cues.zh: 我们在每一条由亿万富翁出资的攻击广告中，都看到了这一点。

cues.en: The people at the top divide us by party, by race, by gender, by religion, by culture, so we don't notice that they are picking our pockets,
cues.zh: 顶层的人以党派、种族、性别、宗教、文化划分我们，好让我们察觉不到，他们正在掏空我们的口袋，

cues.en: That they are defunding our schools, that they are gutting our healthcare, that they are raising taxes on all of us while they cut taxes for themselves.
cues.zh: 削减学校经费、掏空医疗保障，给我们所有人加税，却给自己减税。

cues.en: It is the oldest strategy in the world, divide and conquer.
cues.zh: 这是世上最古老的策略：分而治之。

cues.en: But tonight we sent a crystal clear message to the people at the top, we will not be conquered.
cues.zh: 但今晚，我们向顶层的人发出了清楚无误的信息：我们不会屈服。

cues.en: It I think it's safe to say that we are tired of being pitted against each other.
cues.zh: 我想可以肯定地说，我们厌倦了被煽动着彼此对立。

cues.en: We are tired of being told to hate each other.
cues.zh: 我们厌倦了被告知应该互相仇恨。

cues.en: It has been 10 years of this kind of politics, politics as blood sport, politics as trolling and owning,
cues.zh: 这种政治已经持续十年：把政治当作血腥竞技、当作挑衅和羞辱对手的游戏，

cues.en: Politics as professional wrestling.
cues.zh: 当作职业摔跤表演。

cues.en: It tears families apart.
cues.zh: 它撕裂家庭。

cues.en: It ends friendships and it leaves us all feeling terrible all the time.
cues.zh: 它终结友谊，让我们所有人始终感到痛苦。

cues.en: People across the political spectrum are hungry for a different kind of politics, not a politics of hate,
cues.zh: 不同政治立场的人，都渴望一种不同的政治：不是仇恨的政治，

cues.en: Not a politics of fear, not a politics of division, but a politics of love.
cues.zh: 不是恐惧的政治，不是分裂的政治，而是爱的政治。

cues.en: My faith teaches me that love is the strongest force in the universe.
cues.zh: 我的信仰告诉我，爱是宇宙中最强大的力量。

cues.en: Love is not passive.
cues.zh: 爱不是消极被动。

cues.en: Love is not neutral.
cues.zh: 爱不是无动于衷。

cues.en: Love is not weak.
cues.zh: 爱不是软弱。

cues.en: Love requires that we stand between the bullies and the bullied.
cues.zh: 爱要求我们站在霸凌者和受欺凌者之间。

cues.en: Love requires that we look evil in the eye and not blink.
cues.zh: 爱要求我们直视邪恶，毫不退缩。

cues.en: That kind of love has always been a threat to the powers that be.
cues.zh: 这样的爱，一直是当权者眼中的威胁。

cues.en: That kind of love is revolutionary.
cues.zh: 这样的爱，具有革命性的力量。

cues.en: That kind of love is creative.
cues.zh: 这样的爱，具有创造性的力量。

cues.en: Hate is predictable.
cues.zh: 仇恨总是千篇一律。

cues.en: Hate is boring.
cues.zh: 仇恨很无聊。

cues.en: Hate can't lower our energy bills.
cues.zh: 仇恨不能降低我们的能源账单。

cues.en: Hate can't teach a child to read.
cues.zh: 仇恨不能教会一个孩子阅读。

cues.en: Hate can't build a future.
cues.zh: 仇恨不能创造未来。

cues.en: But what hate can't do love can.
cues.zh: 但仇恨做不到的，爱可以做到。

cues.en: Love can turn a student into a scholar.
cues.zh: 爱能把学生培养成学者。

cues.en: Love can turn a closet into a nursery.
cues.zh: 爱能把衣橱变成婴儿房。

cues.en: Love can turn an enemy into a friend.
cues.zh: 爱能把敌人变成朋友。

cues.en: Love can turn a campaign into a movement.
cues.zh: 爱能把一场竞选变成一场社会运动。

cues.en: Love can heal what's broken in America.
cues.zh: 爱能修复美国破碎的地方。

cues.en: We can't defeat the politics of division with more division.
cues.zh: 我们不能用更多的分裂，击败制造分裂的政治。

cues.en: We can't win that game.
cues.zh: 那样的游戏，我们赢不了。

cues.en: We have to change the game.
cues.zh: 我们必须改变游戏规则。

cues.en: In my experience, when you extend an open hand rather than a closed fist, you'll be surprised by who takes that hand.
cues.zh: 我的经验是，当你伸出友善的手，而不是挥起紧握的拳头，你会惊讶于谁会握住你的手。

cues.en: We didn't win this race by alienating our neighbors or shaming our neighbors or ridiculing our neighbors.
cues.zh: 我们赢下这场竞选，并不靠疏远、羞辱或嘲弄邻人。

cues.en: We embodied a new kind of politics, a politics rooted in a deep love for our state, for our country,
cues.zh: 我们践行了一种新的政治，根植于对我们的州、我们的国家，

cues.en: And most importantly, for all of our neighbors.
cues.zh: 以及最重要的，对所有邻人的深厚热爱。

cues.en: We mobilized.
cues.zh: 我们动员了起来。

cues.en: We mobilized our 60,000 volunteers in every corner of this state, and together we delivered bottled water to Sandbranch,
cues.zh: 我们动员全州六万名志愿者，一起把瓶装水送到桑德布兰奇，

cues.en: A community south of Dallas with no running water.
cues.zh: 那是达拉斯以南一个没有自来水的社区。

cues.en: We donated school supplies to an elementary school in El Cenizo, a small town on the border.
cues.zh: 我们向边境小镇埃尔塞尼索的一所小学捐赠了学习用品。

cues.en: We collected more than 20,000 lb of groceries for families in Fort Worth who are struggling under the high cost of living.
cues.zh: 我们募集了两万多磅食品，送给沃思堡那些承受高昂生活成本的家庭。

cues.en: Before the world changes in ways you see on TV or read about in newspapers, the world changes person to person,
cues.zh: 在世界出现那些你在电视上看到、在报纸上读到的变化之前，改变先发生在人与人之间，

cues.en: Neighbor to neighbor.
cues.zh: 邻里之间。

cues.en: In each moment when you choose to be kind, in each neighbor we choose to love, in each prayer that we say for someone who would not pray for us in return.
cues.zh: 发生在你选择善良的每一刻，发生在我们选择去爱的每一位邻人身上，也发生在我们为那些不会回报祈祷的人所作的祈祷中。

cues.en: This is how we won Texas.
cues.zh: 我们就是这样赢下得州的。

cues.en: This is a win the size of Texas.
cues.zh: 这是一场和得州一样宏大的胜利。

cues.en: And now we have a mandate the size of Texas.
cues.zh: 而现在，我们也肩负着和得州一样宏大的民意授权。

cues.en: This election was about chasing a vision of what this state can be.
cues.zh: 这场选举，是为了追寻这个州本应成为的样子。

cues.en: Texas public schools that are the envy of the nation, a Texas economy that is second to none,
cues.zh: 让得州的公立学校成为全国典范，让得州的经济首屈一指，

cues.en: And Texas families that are stronger and healthier than they've ever been before.
cues.zh: 让得州的家庭比以往任何时候都更强健、更健康。

cues.en: It won't it won't happen overnight, but a giant state deserves giant dreams.
cues.zh: 这不会一夜实现，但一个伟大的州，值得拥有宏大的梦想。

cues.en: And we know how to get there.
cues.zh: 而我们知道如何实现它。

cues.en: We must get big money out of our politics so no billionaire or trillionaire can buy our elections.
cues.zh: 我们必须让大金主退出政治，让任何亿万富翁、万亿富翁都无法收买我们的选举。

cues.en: We must unrig this economic system that only benefits the top 1%.
cues.zh: 我们必须改变这个只让最富有的百分之一受益的经济体制。

cues.en: We must pass universal healthcare so no one goes bankrupt just because they get sick.
cues.zh: 我们必须通过全民医疗保障，让任何人都不再仅仅因为生病就破产。

cues.en: We must invest in our teachers and our students so every underdog has a fighting chance.
cues.zh: 我们必须投资教师和学生，让每一个处于弱势的人都有公平竞争的机会。

cues.en: We must end these corrupt forever wars that are driving up prices and killing our brave men and women in uniform.
cues.zh: 我们必须结束这些腐败、无休无止的战争；它们抬高物价，夺去英勇军人的生命。

cues.en: And we must heal the deep spiritual corruption at the root of all of these crises.
cues.zh: 我们必须医治所有这些危机根源处，那种深层的精神腐败。

cues.en: We must bridge the divides between us and repair the ties that bind us.
cues.zh: 我们必须弥合分歧，修复将我们联系在一起的纽带。

cues.en: We forged a new kind of politics here in the Lone Star State, an answer to this decade of division.
cues.zh: 我们在孤星州开创了一种新的政治，回应这十年来的分裂。

cues.en: We showed that when working people come together across every dividing line we can do extraordinary things.
cues.zh: 我们证明了，劳动者跨越所有分界团结起来，就能做出非凡的事情。

cues.en: We won this race because people who are desperate for change now are going to get change.
cues.zh: 我们赢下这场竞选；那些迫切渴望改变的人，如今将迎来改变。

cues.en: That old politics is dying and a new politics is being born through each of us, through every underdog,
cues.zh: 旧的政治正在消亡，新的政治正在我们每一个人、每一个不被看好的人身上诞生，

cues.en: Through every David against every Goliath, through every Texan who believed in our state and believed in this movement.
cues.zh: 诞生于每一个对抗歌利亚的大卫，诞生于每一个相信这个州、相信这场运动的得州人。

cues.en: Now the real work begins.
cues.zh: 现在，真正的工作开始了。

cues.en: 2,000 years ago, when the people at the top hurt his neighbors, that barefoot rabbi didn't stay in his room and pray.
cues.zh: 两千年前，当权势者伤害他的邻人时，那位赤脚拉比没有只留在房里祈祷。

cues.en: He walked into the seat of power and he flipped over the tables of injustice.
cues.zh: 他走进权力中心，掀翻了不公义的桌子。

cues.en: As this movement heads to the seat of power, as we head to the United States Senate, we know what this moment requires of us.
cues.zh: 当这场运动走向权力中心，当我们走进美国参议院，我们知道这个时刻要求我们做什么。

cues.en: Texas, it's time to start flipping tables.
cues.zh: 得州，是时候开始掀翻那些桌子了。

cues.en: Thank you for being here.
cues.zh: 感谢你们来到这里。

subtitleType: 校订英文 / 中文翻译（听不清处已标注）

speaker: Gina Hinojosa
role: 德州 · 候任州长
title: Gina Hinojosa delivers victory speech after winning Texas governor’s race

cues.en: We did it.
cues.zh: 我们做到了！

cues.en: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the shock of this win.
cues.zh: 得州的一切都更大，这场胜利带来的震撼也一样。

cues.en: We shocked the world tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们震惊了世界。

cues.en: With a Texas chip on our shoulder, we showed that anything is possible.
cues.zh: 带着得州人不服输的劲头，我们证明了一切皆有可能。

cues.en: Because it never bothered me that they doubted me.
cues.zh: 他们怀疑我，从来没有让我介意。

cues.en: It bothered me that they doubted us.
cues.zh: 让我介意的是，他们怀疑我们所有人。

cues.en: Hundreds of millions on attack ads, written off over and over again.
cues.zh: 数亿美元的攻击广告，一次又一次地认定我们没希望。

cues.en: But Texas, my faith in you never wavered.
cues.zh: 但是得州，我对你们的信心从未动摇。

cues.en: I have spoken to Governor Abbott.
cues.zh: 我已经与阿博特州长通了话。

cues.en: He called to congratulate me.
cues.zh: 他打来电话，向我表示祝贺。

cues.en: He extended a generous offer to assist with the transition.
cues.zh: 他也慷慨表示愿意协助权力交接。

cues.en: I want to thank him and his family for their years of service to this great state.
cues.zh: 我要感谢他和他的家人，多年来为这个伟大州所付出的服务。

cues.en: And now I stand before you humbled and grateful and in awe of the incredible grace and power of God and of Texas.
cues.zh: 此刻我站在各位面前，心怀谦卑与感激，敬畏上帝和得州令人难以置信的恩典与力量。

cues.en: I am a daughter of the Rio Grande Valley.
cues.zh: 我是里奥格兰德河谷的女儿。

cues.en: Where the people embody the work ethic and values of our great state.
cues.zh: 那里的人们，体现着我们伟大州的勤劳精神与价值观。

cues.en: Where no one would have imagined that one day a little girl from the RGV would stand before you here as the next governor of the greatest state.
cues.zh: 谁也不曾想到，有一天，那个来自河谷的小女孩，会站在各位面前，成为这个伟大州的下一任州长。

cues.en: But God had a plan.
cues.zh: 但上帝自有安排。

cues.en: And the people of Texas had a plan, too.
cues.zh: 得州人民，也有自己的安排。

cues.en: It was a plan I did not know.
cues.zh: 那是我自己原本不知道的安排。

cues.en: I never set out to be a politician.
cues.zh: 我从未打算成为一名政治人物。

cues.en: I am a mom.
cues.zh: 我是一位母亲。

cues.en: I am a mom who loves her children, who believes in their teachers.
cues.zh: 一位爱自己的孩子、信任他们老师的母亲。

cues.en: And who believes in Texas public schools.
cues.zh: 也信任得州公立学校。

cues.en: And when I saw my child's school under threat, I did what any mom would do.
cues.zh: 当我看到孩子的学校受到威胁时，我做了任何母亲都会做的事。

cues.en: I fought back.
cues.zh: 我奋起反抗。

cues.en: I ran for the school board because I wanted my child and every Texas child to have the opportunity to succeed.
cues.zh: 我竞选学区董事，因为我希望自己的孩子，以及得州每一个孩子，都有成功的机会。

cues.en: From the school board to the House of Representatives.
cues.zh: 从学区董事会，到州众议院。

cues.en: And now with your extraordinary faith and the trust of the people of Texas to the governor's [inaudible].
cues.zh: 如今，带着你们非凡的信任、带着得州人民的托付，走到州长的……[此处听不清]。

cues.en: Only here, only here, where no matter where you come from, no matter how humble your beginnings, your life can be bigger than your dreams.
cues.zh: 只有在这里，无论你从哪里来、起点多么卑微，你的人生都可以超越自己的梦想。

cues.en: When we started this campaign a little over a year ago, I asked a simple question.
cues.zh: 一年多前，我们开始这场竞选时，我问了一个简单的问题。

cues.en: Is Texas a state that is by and for the people of Texas?
cues.zh: 得州，是一个由得州人民治理、为得州人民服务的州吗？

cues.en: Or is this the billionaire's world and we just live here?
cues.zh: 还是说，这里是亿万富翁的世界，我们只不过住在其中？

cues.en: Does Texas belong to the parents and their children?
cues.zh: 得州属于父母和他们的孩子吗？

cues.en: Or the billionaires trying to dismantle our schools.
cues.zh: 还是属于那些试图拆毁我们学校的亿万富翁？

cues.en: Does Texas belong to the farmers and ranchers who have worked this land for generations, or the corporations trying to buy it up?
cues.zh: 得州属于在这片土地上耕耘数代的农民、牧场主，还是属于那些想把土地买光的公司？

cues.en: Does Texas belong to the working families who pay their taxes and do everything right, or the wealthy and well-connected who play by different rules?
cues.zh: 得州属于按时纳税、循规蹈矩的劳动家庭，还是属于那些另有一套规则的富人和权贵？

cues.en: Does Texas belong to the people who rise before the sun, who work two jobs, who build our homes,
cues.zh: 得州属于那些天不亮就起床、打两份工、建造我们家园的人吗？

cues.en: Who keep our hospitals running, who put everything they've got into small businesses and big dreams?
cues.zh: 属于维持医院运转、把全部心血投入小企业与大梦想的人吗？

cues.en: Or does it belong to the people who write the biggest check to politicians in Austin?
cues.zh: 还是属于那些给奥斯汀政客开出最大支票的人？

cues.en: Tonight, Texas, we answered and we did not whisper.
cues.zh: 今晚，得州，我们作出了回答，而且绝不轻声细语。

cues.en: We answered loud enough for every billionaire, every lobbyist, and every corrupt politician in Austin to hear: Texas belongs to us.
cues.zh: 我们的声音足够响亮，让每一个亿万富翁、每一个说客、每一个奥斯汀的腐败政客都听见：得州属于我们！

cues.en: It's a question we answered in McAllen and Corpus Christi, in Dallas and in Temple, in San Antonio and Lubbock.
cues.zh: 麦卡伦、科珀斯克里斯蒂、达拉斯、坦普尔、圣安东尼奥和拉伯克，都回答了这个问题。

cues.en: From the neighborhoods of Austin to the wide open skies of West Texas all the way out to Big Bend.
cues.zh: 从奥斯汀的街区，到西得州辽阔的天空，一直到大弯地区。

cues.en: We answered in our big cities where they tried to silence your voice with gerrymandered maps and closed polling sites only to see turnout like never before.
cues.zh: 我们的大城市作出了回答：他们用操纵选区和关闭投票站压制你们的声音，却迎来了前所未有的投票热情。

cues.en: And you answered in small towns where people have been told their vote was already spoken for.
cues.zh: 小城镇也作出了回答；那里的人曾被告知，他们的选票早已被别人决定。

cues.en: We answered in communities that politicians visit every four years to ask for your vote only to forget about you as soon as they get to Austin.
cues.zh: 那些政客四年才来求一次选票、到奥斯汀后便忘得一干二净的社区，也作出了回答。

cues.en: We answered in places that have been overlooked, underestimated, and left behind for far too long.
cues.zh: 那些被忽视、被低估、被抛在身后太久的地方，也作出了回答。

cues.en: And we answered across party lines because this campaign was always about whether the people of Texas ought to have a government that belongs to them.
cues.zh: 我们跨越党派作出了回答，因为这场竞选始终在问：得州人民是否应该拥有属于自己的政府。

cues.en: Not the highest bidder, not the biggest donor, not the most powerful lobbyist.
cues.zh: 不属于出价最高的人，不属于捐款最多的人，不属于权势最大的说客。

cues.en: You.
cues.zh: 而属于你们。

cues.en: And I want to say something to the powerful people who have gotten very comfortable running this state.
cues.zh: 我要对那些早已习惯安稳掌控这个州的权势者说几句话。

cues.en: The voters have delivered a mandate for change, and it is change they will get.
cues.zh: 选民已经授予改变的使命，而他们一定会得到改变。

cues.en: We will lead with a politics of courage, not convenience.
cues.zh: 我们将以勇气、而非权宜之计来引领政治。

cues.en: Progress will not be halted by partisanship, and Texas will bow down to no one.
cues.zh: 进步不会被党争阻挡，得州不会向任何人低头。

cues.en: The days of treating our public schools like they are for sale are over.
cues.zh: 把我们的公立学校当作待售商品的日子，结束了。

cues.en: The days of treating our tax dollars like your personal piggy bank are over.
cues.zh: 把纳税人的钱当作私人存钱罐的日子，结束了。

cues.en: The days of writing one set of rules for working people and another for the wealthy and well-connected are over.
cues.zh: 给劳动者一套规则、给富人和权贵另一套规则的日子，结束了。

cues.en: And the days of telling Texans to settle for less while only billionaires in boardrooms profit from a state we have all built — those days are over, Too.
cues.zh: 要求得州人将就、却让董事会里的亿万富翁独享我们共同建设成果的日子，也结束了。

cues.en: This state was built by people with calloused hands and tired feet.
cues.zh: 这个州，是由双手长满老茧、双脚疲惫不堪的人们建设起来的。

cues.en: By teachers and nurses.
cues.zh: 由教师和护士。

cues.en: By oilfield workers and truck drivers.
cues.zh: 由油田工人和卡车司机。

cues.en: By small-business owners who put everything they had on the line.
cues.zh: 由押上全部身家的小企业主。

cues.en: By parents who sacrificed so their children could have a better life.
cues.zh: 由为孩子更好的人生而作出牺牲的父母。

cues.en: And those are the people who should come first in the state they built.
cues.zh: 在他们亲手建设的这个州，他们理应被放在第一位。

cues.en: They have labored and maintained an American dream through a long hard night.
cues.zh: 漫漫长夜里，他们辛勤劳动，守护着一个美国梦。

cues.en: My friends, it is morning now.
cues.zh: 朋友们，现在，天亮了。

cues.en: Tomorrow, our transition begins.
cues.zh: 明天，我们的交接工作开始。

cues.en: And in January, I will take the oath of office ready to lead a government by the people and for the people.
cues.zh: 一月，我将宣誓就职，领导一个由人民治理、为人民服务的政府。

cues.en: Not for the people who donated the most, not for the people who know the right people, but for every single Texan.
cues.zh: 不为捐款最多的人，不为关系最硬的人，而为每一个得州人。

cues.en: Because this governor's office does not belong to me.
cues.zh: 因为州长办公室不属于我。

cues.en: It does not belong to my party.
cues.zh: 不属于我的政党。

cues.en: It belongs to you.
cues.zh: 它属于你们。

cues.en: This is our Texas.
cues.zh: 这是我们的得州。

cues.en: This is our government.
cues.zh: 这是我们的政府。

cues.en: And this is our one fight.
cues.zh: 这是我们共同的一场奋斗。

cues.en: And tonight we won.
cues.zh: 而今晚，我们赢了。

cues.en: Let me be clear.
cues.zh: 我要说清楚。

cues.en: We did not end one era of single party rule just to usher in another.
cues.zh: 我们结束一个政党独大的时代，不是为了开启另一个。

cues.en: The same national pundits and political class who ignored and then misunderstood this campaign will declare this a victory for Democrats.
cues.zh: 那些先是忽视、后来又误解这场竞选的全国评论员和政治圈人士，会宣布这是民主党的胜利。

cues.en: They continue to misunderstand.
cues.zh: 他们依旧没有看懂。

cues.en: This victory is so much bigger.
cues.zh: 这场胜利的意义，要大得多。

cues.en: It belongs to Texas.
cues.zh: 它属于得州。

cues.en: It is a victory for taxpayers who work too hard to see their money handed out to donors and special interests.
cues.zh: 这是纳税人的胜利；他们工作如此辛苦，不该眼看自己的钱被送给捐款人和特殊利益集团。

cues.en: We will end the era of no bid contracts in Texas.
cues.zh: 我们将结束得州不经竞标就授予合同的时代。

cues.en: And please listen, it is a victory for young people.
cues.zh: 也请听清楚：这是年轻人的胜利。

cues.en: Young people across our state who possess unimaginable talent but have been left feeling so little hope.
cues.zh: 全州那些才华无可限量，却长期感觉看不到希望的年轻人。

cues.en: You will never have to choose between the state you love and a job that'll pay your worth.
cues.zh: 你们再也不必在自己热爱的州，和一份配得上自己价值的工作之间作选择。

cues.en: You will have the economy that serves your ambitions, your dreams, and your hard work.
cues.zh: 你们将拥有一个支持你们抱负、梦想与辛勤付出的经济环境。

cues.en: A government on your side and the hope you deserve.
cues.zh: 一个站在你们这一边的政府，以及你们应得的希望。

cues.en: This is a victory for teachers who will be paid what they are worth.
cues.zh: 这是教师的胜利；他们将获得与自身价值相称的薪酬。

cues.en: And in case you have not heard, on day one, I will fire Mike Morath, and we will work tirelessly to repair the damage of the Texas voucher scam and end an
cues.zh: 如果你们还没听说：上任第一天，我就会解雇迈克·莫拉思，并全力修复得州教育券骗局造成的伤害，结束那个

cues.en: Era in which our schools are sold for parts.
cues.zh: 将学校拆开变卖的时代。

cues.en: This is a victory for the parents of Texas.
cues.zh: 这是得州家长的胜利。

cues.en: We are taking our children's education back from a government that has failed them.
cues.zh: 我们要把孩子的教育，从一个辜负他们的政府手中拿回来。

cues.en: Schools will not be taken out of our control.
cues.zh: 学校不会被夺走本地管理权。

cues.en: They will not be shuttered or suffocated.
cues.zh: 不会被关闭，也不会被逼得难以生存。

cues.en: Being a parent is hard enough.
cues.zh: 做父母已经够难了。

cues.en: Without carrying the burden of a government's failures.
cues.zh: 不该还要承担政府失职带来的重担。

cues.en: To the children of Texas, your schools will not close.
cues.zh: 得州的孩子们，你们的学校不会关闭。

cues.en: You will be invested in and you will grow up in a Texas where you are lifted up every single day to reach your Godgiven potential.
cues.zh: 我们会投资你们；你们将在一个每天都帮助你们发挥天赋与潜能的得州长大。

cues.en: Tonight, I make a solemn promise to every single Texan.
cues.zh: 今晚，我向每一个得州人作出庄严承诺。

cues.en: Whether you voted for me or Greg Abbott or felt so betrayed by a broken politics that you did not vote at all,
cues.zh: 无论你投给了我、投给格雷格·阿博特，还是因被失灵的政治伤得太深而根本没有投票，

cues.en: Whether you're a Democrat, a Republican, or neither, no matter where you live, no matter what your expectations of me are,
cues.zh: 无论你是民主党人、共和党人，还是两者都不是；无论你住在哪里、对我抱有什么期待，

cues.en: No matter how accustomed you've become to corruption and incompetence, to experiencing government as something that is done to you,
cues.zh: 无论你多么习惯腐败和无能，习惯把政府看作一个只会对你发号施令的存在，

cues.en: Not with you, for you, or by you.
cues.zh: 而不是与你一起、为你服务、由你作主。

cues.en: Hear what Texas said today loud and clear.
cues.zh: 请听清得州今天发出的响亮声音。

cues.en: Your government belongs to you.
cues.zh: 你的政府，属于你。

cues.en: As your governor, I will never forget it.
cues.zh: 作为你们的州长，我永远不会忘记这一点。

cues.en: There will be no special set of rules for the wealthy and well-connected.
cues.zh: 不会再为富人和权贵另设一套特殊规则。

cues.en: No looking the other way when someone in my own party does wrong.
cues.zh: 不会在自己党内有人做错事时，假装看不见。

cues.en: No excuses for corruption because it comes from someone who shares my politics.
cues.zh: 不会因为腐败者与我政治立场相同，就为他们开脱。

cues.en: Corruption does not become right when our side does it.
cues.zh: 腐败不会因为是我们这一方干的，就变成正确的事。

cues.en: Accountability does not stop at the doors of the governor's office.
cues.zh: 问责不会止步于州长办公室门口。

cues.en: It begins there.
cues.zh: 它将从这里开始。

cues.en: The trust you have placed in me tonight is not a blank check.
cues.zh: 今晚你们给予我的信任，不是一张空白支票。

cues.en: It is a sacred responsibility and I intend to earn it every single day.
cues.zh: 它是一份神圣的责任，我会每天努力去配得上它。

cues.en: There will be times when we disagree.
cues.zh: 我们会有意见不同的时候。

cues.en: But I promise you this.
cues.zh: 但我向你们保证。

cues.en: I will always tell you the truth and nothing but the truth.
cues.zh: 我会始终告诉你们真相，只讲真相。

cues.en: I will serve you and only you.
cues.zh: 我会为你们服务，而且只为你们服务。

cues.en: I will listen when you disagree.
cues.zh: 你们不同意时，我会倾听。

cues.en: I will admit when I am wrong.
cues.zh: 我错了，就会承认。

cues.en: And I will never forget who sent me here.
cues.zh: 我永远不会忘记，是谁把我送到这里。

cues.en: The power of this office does not belong to me.
cues.zh: 这个职位的权力，不属于我。

cues.en: It belongs to you.
cues.zh: 它属于你们。

cues.en: And as excited as I am by the history we've made tonight, I pray it does not compare to the future we build together.
cues.zh: 尽管今晚创造的历史令我激动，我祈愿，它仍无法与我们共同创造的未来相比。

cues.en: The nation will look at Texas and say, "We've won something far more important than an election."
cues.zh: 全国将看着得州说：“他们赢得了远比一场选举更重要的东西。”

cues.en: They will look at Texas and say that faith in government has been restored.
cues.zh: 他们会看着得州说，人们对政府的信任恢复了。

cues.en: They will look at Texas and see the power of a government that lifts every single person up and never punches down.
cues.zh: 他们会看见一个扶起每一个人、从不欺压弱者的政府，能有多大的力量。

cues.en: We will build a government more honest, more just, and worthy of the people who call Texas home.
cues.zh: 我们将建设一个更诚实、更公正、配得上以得州为家的人们的政府。

cues.en: And we will never forget the simple truth that brought us here tonight.
cues.zh: 我们永远不会忘记，把我们带到今晚的那个简单真理。

cues.en: Texas belongs to the people of Texas.
cues.zh: 得州，属于得州人民。

cues.en: I can't help but think of my grandmother, Grandma Hinojosa, who used to tell me, 'No te dejes.'
cues.zh: 我不禁想起祖母，伊诺霍萨奶奶。她总对我说：“No te dejes。”

cues.en: Know your worth, and fight to defend it.
cues.zh: 要知道自己的价值，并为捍卫它而战。

cues.en: A lot of Latinas in Texas grew up hearing those same words.
cues.zh: 许多得州的拉丁裔女性，从小也听母亲和祖母说过同样的话。

cues.en: From their own mothers, their own abuelas.
cues.zh: 来自她们自己的母亲，自己的祖母。

cues.en: This year we lived them and we changed this state.
cues.zh: 今年，我们践行了这句话，也改变了这个州。

cues.en: And this win belongs to you and to them.
cues.zh: 这场胜利，属于你们，也属于她们。

cues.en: And I need to thank some people here now who made this all possible.
cues.zh: 现在，我要感谢一些让这一切成为可能的人。

cues.en: Pablo, no one has sacrificed more than you.
cues.zh: 巴勃罗，没有人比你作出的牺牲更多。

cues.en: You have been so supportive.
cues.zh: 你一直如此支持我。

cues.en: You have been so supportive and gracious and I am so proud of you.
cues.zh: 你一直如此支持、宽厚，我为你无比骄傲。

cues.en: Even though neither you nor Matteo ever asked for this, my fight comes from my deep love for the both of you and my desire to make this world safer and better
cues.zh: 尽管你和马泰奥都从未主动选择这些，我的奋斗，源于对你们俩的深爱，源于希望让这个世界更安全、更美好的心愿，

cues.en: For the both of you.
cues.zh: 为了你们两个人。

cues.en: You have been so understanding and encouraging and I thank you both so much.
cues.zh: 你们如此体谅、如此鼓励我，我非常感谢你们。

cues.en: To my husband John who I made promise to never run for office.
cues.zh: 感谢我的丈夫约翰；当初，我还曾要求他答应永不参选。

cues.en: You have been the rock who has held it all down and sacrificed and stood beside me in the hardest fights.
cues.zh: 你是撑住一切的磐石，在最艰难的斗争中牺牲、付出，始终站在我身旁。

cues.en: This is not possible without you and I love you.
cues.zh: 没有你，就没有这一切。我爱你。

cues.en: To my sister, Xochitl, who spent a year telling everyone who would listen that we would win, who believed so relentlessly and with such certainty that it finally came true.
cues.zh: 感谢我的姐姐索奇特尔；整整一年，她逢人就说我们会赢，信念如此坚定，最终让它成为现实。

cues.en: I love you, sis.
cues.zh: 姐姐，我爱你。

cues.en: You're the best sister a sister could ask for.
cues.zh: 你是一个姐妹所能期望的最好的姐妹。

cues.en: Mom and Dad, Cyndi and Robert, my brothers and sisters, and my entire family: thank you.
cues.zh: 爸爸妈妈，辛迪和罗伯特，我的兄弟姐妹，以及所有家人：谢谢你们。

cues.en: Thank you for working day and night.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们日夜辛劳。

cues.en: Everything I believe and love about this state is because of you.
cues.zh: 我对这个州的信念与热爱，全都源于你们。

cues.en: And I love all of you.
cues.zh: 我爱你们所有人。

cues.en: To our next United States Senator, James Talarico.
cues.zh: 感谢我们下一任美国参议员，詹姆斯·塔拉里科。

cues.en: For years, we believed there had to be a different and better way forward.
cues.zh: 多年来，我们一直相信，一定有一条不同、也更好的前进道路。

cues.en: It looks like we were right.
cues.zh: 看来，我们是对的。

cues.en: Thank you and congratulations, my friend.
cues.zh: 谢谢，也祝贺你，我的朋友。

cues.en: To Amy Friedman, my campaign [inaudible].
cues.zh: 感谢艾米·弗里德曼，我的竞选……[此处听不清]。

cues.en: You are an angel sent down from heaven to run this campaign.
cues.zh: 你是上天派来主持这场竞选的天使。

cues.en: You believed in me and you believed in Texas.
cues.zh: 你相信我，也相信得州。

cues.en: I will never forget all that you gave.
cues.zh: 你为此付出的一切，我永远不会忘记。

cues.en: All that you sacrificed to get us here.
cues.zh: 以及你为把我们带到这里所作出的一切牺牲。

cues.en: You led the best campaign team in the nation, a team that I hope gets some well-earned sleep tonight.
cues.zh: 你带领了全国最棒的竞选团队；希望大家今晚都能睡一个应得的好觉。

cues.en: To the people who showed up early for me and often, who posted when I could still keep track of who was tagging me,
cues.zh: 感谢那些从最初就一次次支持我的人，在我还能数清谁在社交媒体标记我时，就开始发帖的人，

cues.en: Whether it was 10 times a day from Houston or DMs spreading my message to Texas newcomers, who showed up at events when it was still only familiar faces.
cues.zh: 无论是在休斯敦一天发十次帖子，还是用私信向新得州人传播我们的理念；感谢那些活动现场还尽是熟面孔时就来到的人。

cues.en: Who gave your labor and your love and you took a leap of faith.
cues.zh: 你们付出了劳动和爱，也勇敢地选择了相信。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们。

cues.en: And to my hometown, Brownsville.
cues.zh: 也感谢我的家乡，布朗斯维尔。

cues.en: Tonight, one of your own becomes the first governor of Texas from the Rio Grande Valley.
cues.zh: 今晚，你们中的一员，将成为得州首位来自里奥格兰德河谷的州长。

cues.en: We did it.
cues.zh: 我们做到了！

cues.en: We did it.
cues.zh: 我们做到了！

cues.en: Good night, and God bless Texas.
cues.zh: 晚安，愿上帝保佑得州。

subtitleType: 校订英文 / 中文翻译（听不清处已标注）

speaker: Roy Cooper
role: 北卡罗来纳州 · 候任参议员
title: Roy Cooper (D-NC) Full Victory Speech

cues.en: Hello, North Carolina.
cues.zh: 北卡罗来纳州，你们好！

cues.en: Are we having a good time tonight or what?
cues.zh: 今晚大家开心不开心？

cues.en: North Carolinians, you have made your voices heard and they were loud.
cues.zh: 北卡的朋友们，你们发出了自己的声音，而且响亮无比。

cues.en: Thank you all so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢大家。

cues.en: There's a few people I need to thank before anybody else.
cues.zh: 首先，我要感谢几个人。

cues.en: To my amazing wife, Kristen, my wonderful daughters, and the rest of my family over here.
cues.zh: 我了不起的妻子克里斯汀、出色的女儿们，以及在场的其他家人。

cues.en: I am so grateful for your love and support.
cues.zh: 我无比感激你们的爱与支持。

cues.en: You guys are the light of my life and I could not do it without you.
cues.zh: 你们照亮了我的生命；没有你们，我做不到这一切。

cues.en: And to everyone here, including our volunteers, staff, and supporters in this campaign, thank you for everything you did to take this United States Senate seat back for the people of North Carolina.
cues.zh: 感谢在座每一个人，包括志愿者、工作人员和支持者；你们所做的一切，帮助北卡罗来纳州人民夺回了这个美国参议院席位。

cues.en: Now, I know this was a hard-fought race, and I do wish God's blessings for Michael Whatley and his family.
cues.zh: 我知道这是一场艰苦的竞选，愿上帝保佑迈克尔·沃特利和他的家人。

cues.en: I spoke with him earlier tonight and he acknowledged our victory.
cues.zh: 今晚早些时候，我与他通了话，他承认了我们的胜利。

cues.en: You know, 16 months ago, we launched this campaign together.
cues.zh: 十六个月前，我们一起启动了这场竞选。

cues.en: We knew that for too many people in North Carolina, the middle class was feeling like a distant dream.
cues.zh: 我们知道，对太多北卡人来说，跻身中产阶层已像一个遥远的梦想。

cues.en: We knew that the Washington DC insiders and the richest Americans were getting unimaginable wealth at our expense.
cues.zh: 我们知道，华盛顿的内部人士和美国最富有的人，正在以我们的利益为代价，攫取难以想象的财富。

cues.en: We knew that the chaos and corruption in Washington were hurting our people.
cues.zh: 我们知道，华盛顿的混乱和腐败，正在伤害我们的人民。

cues.en: Today you said this has to stop.
cues.zh: 今天，你们说：这一切必须停止。

cues.en: And as your new United States Senator, I am ready to take that message to Washington and work to do something about it.
cues.zh: 作为你们新当选的美国参议员，我已准备好把这句话带到华盛顿，并采取行动。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: It would have been easier for us to just complain and watch from the sidelines, to shake our heads and turn away.
cues.zh: 我们本可以只在场边抱怨、观望，摇摇头，转身离开；那样更容易。

cues.en: It would have been easier, but it wouldn't have been right.
cues.zh: 那样更容易，却不正确。

cues.en: And I've told you many times on Sundays in church, I kept coming back to a passage from the book of Luke.
cues.zh: 我多次告诉过你们，星期日在教堂里，我总会想起《路加福音》中的一段话。

cues.en: To whom much is given, much is required.
cues.zh: 多给谁，就向谁多取；多托谁，就向谁多要。

cues.en: And I thought about the many blessings we have in North Carolina that I have in my life.
cues.zh: 我想起北卡罗来纳州拥有的种种福分，也想起我人生中的种种福分。

cues.en: And I knew what was required of me and you knew what was required of us.
cues.zh: 我知道自己该承担什么，而你们也知道，我们共同该承担什么。

cues.en: This campaign was powered by you, the people of North Carolina.
cues.zh: 为这场竞选提供力量的，是你们，北卡罗来纳州人民。

cues.en: And together, we're standing up for the people Washington has let down.
cues.zh: 我们一起，为那些被华盛顿辜负的人挺身而出。

cues.en: The small business owners watching their livelihoods disappear because of tariffs.
cues.zh: 为眼看关税摧毁自己生计的小企业主。

cues.en: The people who need health care and are terrified of seeing the federal government take it away.
cues.zh: 为那些需要医疗服务、却害怕联邦政府将其夺走的人。

cues.en: The farmers getting crushed by the cost of fertilizer and diesel because of this neverending war.
cues.zh: 为那些因这场无休止的战争，承受高昂化肥和柴油成本、被压得喘不过气的农民。

cues.en: The hardworking families and the people on fixed incomes who desperately need their elected officials to recognize how expensive things are and to work to make stuff cost less.
cues.zh: 为勤劳的家庭、依靠固定收入生活的人；他们迫切需要民选官员看见物价有多高，采取行动降低开支。

cues.en: You know, North Carolinians work hard and they shouldn't need a lobbyist to unlock the American dream.
cues.zh: 北卡人辛勤工作，他们不该还需要一个说客，才能敲开美国梦的大门。

cues.en: That should be the job of the people they elect to represent them.
cues.zh: 这本该是他们选出的代表应该做的工作。

cues.en: And North Carolinians, I accept your job offer.
cues.zh: 北卡人民，我接受你们的这份工作聘请。

cues.en: Tonight, guys, we told Washington loud and clear that North Carolinians will always matter more than the billionaires and the insiders.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们响亮而明确地告诉华盛顿：北卡人民，永远比亿万富翁和内部权贵更重要。

cues.en: Tonight, we showed the country that when everyday people come together, we can make change.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们向全国证明，普通人团结起来，就能带来改变。

cues.en: Tonight, we let everyone know that we are just getting started.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们让所有人知道，我们才刚刚开始。

cues.en: Guys, tonight the campaign ends, but tomorrow the work of governing begins.
cues.zh: 今晚竞选结束，但明天，治理的工作就开始了。

cues.en: We have to work to make health care, housing and groceries more affordable to end this war and stop the pain at the pump.
cues.zh: 我们必须让医疗、住房和食品更负担得起，结束这场战争，减轻人们在加油站承受的痛苦。

cues.en: To protect Medicaid expansion.
cues.zh: 保护医疗补助扩展政策。

cues.en: We work so hard for, to stop corruption and take on special interests that get rich while people struggle to get by.
cues.zh: 那是我们辛苦争取来的；我们还要制止腐败，挑战那些在人们艰难度日时大发横财的利益集团。

cues.en: To strengthen our democracy and live up to this nation's highest ideals.
cues.zh: 巩固民主，实现这个国家最崇高的理想。

cues.en: Hey guys, it won't be easy and it won't be simple.
cues.zh: 各位，这不会容易，也不会简单。

cues.en: But I know that to whom much is given, much is required.
cues.zh: 但我知道：受托越多，责任越大。

cues.en: Guys, in North Carolina, we don't just believe in the promise of tomorrow.
cues.zh: 在北卡，我们不只是相信明天的希望。

cues.en: We become it.
cues.zh: 我们让希望成为现实。

cues.en: First in flight, first colony to demand independence, first public university.
cues.zh: 率先实现飞行、率先提出独立要求的殖民地、第一所公立大学。

cues.en: We race to lead because we know what hope the future holds.
cues.zh: 我们争当先行者，因为我们知道，未来蕴藏着怎样的希望。

cues.en: And when you've got hope, when you've got hope, anything is possible.
cues.zh: 而只要心怀希望，一切皆有可能。

cues.en: Tonight, guys, I am deeply grateful for and humbled by the confidence and trust you have once again placed in me.
cues.zh: 今晚，对于你们再次给予我的信心与信任，我深怀感激，也倍感谦卑。

cues.en: I am determined that no matter the challenges that confront me, I will be an independent voice ready to work with anyone to do what's right for this amazing state that has given me so much.
cues.zh: 无论面对什么挑战，我都会坚持独立发声，与任何愿意为这个给予我如此之多的伟大州做正确事情的人合作。

cues.en: Guys, I will be your voice.
cues.zh: 各位，我会替你们发声。

cues.en: As your senator, I will always put you, the people of North Carolina, first.
cues.zh: 作为你们的参议员，我始终会把北卡罗来纳州人民放在第一位。

cues.en: I will put you before politics.
cues.zh: 把你们放在政治算计之前。

cues.en: I'll put you before party.
cues.zh: 放在党派之前。

cues.en: I will put you before power.
cues.zh: 放在权力之前。

cues.en: I'm not going to Washington to be something.
cues.zh: 我去华盛顿，不是为了当什么大人物。

cues.en: I'm going to Washington to do something.
cues.zh: 而是为了真正做些事情。

cues.en: And at the end of the day, I am still a prisoner of hope.
cues.zh: 归根结底，我仍是一个始终被希望牢牢牵引的人。

cues.en: I truly believe that our best days lie ahead.
cues.zh: 我真心相信，我们最好的日子还在前方。

cues.en: That we can make the course correction that our great country so badly needs.
cues.zh: 相信我们能为这个伟大的国家，作出它如此迫切需要的方向修正。

cues.en: That North Carolina and the United States have a future teeming with possibilities.
cues.zh: 相信北卡罗来纳州和美国，都拥有充满可能性的未来。

cues.en: So, what do you say, North Carolina?
cues.zh: 北卡的朋友们，你们怎么说？

cues.en: Are you ready for change?
cues.zh: 你们准备好迎接改变了吗？

cues.en: Are you ready to turn things around for hardworking people?
cues.zh: 准备好为辛勤工作的人民扭转局面了吗？

cues.en: Are you ready to meet the promise of tomorrow?
cues.zh: 准备好实现明天的希望了吗？

cues.en: I am too.
cues.zh: 我也准备好了。

cues.en: May God bless all of you, our country, and the great state of North Carolina.
cues.zh: 愿上帝保佑各位，保佑我们的国家，保佑伟大的北卡罗来纳州。

cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

subtitleType: 校订英文 / 中文翻译（听不清处已标注）

speaker: Peggy Flanagan
role: 明尼苏达州 · 候任参议员
title: Peggy Flanagan calls for end to 'Trump era of chaos' during Senate victory speech

cues.en: Casting their ballots to decide who should hold the seat that has been held by the likes of Tina Smith,
cues.zh: 人们投下选票，决定由谁接任这个席位；蒂娜·史密斯，

cues.en: Al Franken, Paul Wellstone, Walter Mondale, and Hubert Humphrey.
cues.zh: 阿尔·弗兰肯、保罗·韦尔斯通、沃尔特·蒙代尔和休伯特·汉弗莱，都曾担任过它。

cues.en: But this seat was also once held by a man named Knute Nelson, who passed a bill more than a century ago that forced thousands of Anishinaabe people from their land and
cues.zh: 但这个席位，也曾属于克努特·纳尔逊。一百多年前，他通过的一项法案，迫使成千上万阿尼希纳贝人离开自己的土地，

cues.en: Onto the White Earth Reservation.
cues.zh: 迁入白土保留地。

cues.en: And tonight, a daughter of the White Earth Nation has been elected to occupy that same seat as the first Native American woman ever elected to the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 而今晚，一位白土部族的女儿，当选担任同一个席位，成为史上首位当选美国参议员的原住民女性。

cues.en: Please welcome my wife, my person, and our Senator-elect, Peggy Flanagan!
cues.zh: 请欢迎我的妻子、我的伴侣、我们的候任参议员，佩吉·弗拉纳根！

cues.en: Woo!
cues.zh: 太棒了！

cues.en: Woo!
cues.zh: 太棒了！

cues.en: Minnesota!
cues.zh: 明尼苏达！

cues.en: Wow!
cues.zh: 哇！

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Minnesota!
cues.zh: 明尼苏达！

cues.en: You just beat Donald Trump again!
cues.zh: 你们刚刚又一次击败了唐纳德·特朗普！

cues.en: And you know what?
cues.zh: 你们知道吗？

cues.en: America did, too.
cues.zh: 美国也一样。

cues.en: You said no more war.
cues.zh: 你们说，不要再有战争。

cues.en: No more health care cuts.
cues.zh: 不要再削减医疗保障。

cues.en: No more taking food away from children and seniors.
cues.zh: 不要再夺走儿童和老人餐桌上的食物。

cues.en: No more selling this country off to the highest bidder.
cues.zh: 不要再把这个国家卖给出价最高的人。

cues.en: And you said no more masked goons shooting our neighbors and terrorizing our communities.
cues.zh: 你们说，不要再让蒙面暴徒向邻居开枪、恐吓我们的社区。

cues.en: You said no more ballrooms, no more bombs or tax breaks for billionaires.
cues.zh: 不要再修宴会厅，不要再投炸弹，不要再给亿万富翁减税。

cues.en: The grift stops now.
cues.zh: 中饱私囊，到此为止。

cues.en: And taking back our country from the grip of the most corrupt administration in our nation's history starts tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚开始，我们要把国家从美国历史上最腐败的政府手中夺回来。

cues.en: Because all across this state and all across this country, people are saying enough is enough.
cues.zh: 因为全州、全国各地的人都在说：够了，就是够了。

cues.en: They're saying that working people deserve an economy and a country that finally works for them, not Donald Trump and his billionaire besties.
cues.zh: 劳动人民值得拥有一个真正为他们运转的经济和国家，而不是只为特朗普和他的亿万富翁好友服务。

cues.en: It is time to end the Trump era of chaos, cruelty, and corruption.
cues.zh: 是时候结束特朗普这个混乱、残酷、腐败的时代。

cues.en: And friends, it is time for new voices to shake up our party and take back our nation.
cues.zh: 朋友们，是时候让新的声音撼动我们的政党，夺回我们的国家。

cues.en: It is time to help people.
cues.zh: 是时候帮助人民。

cues.en: It is time to help people afford the lives they want to live.
cues.zh: 帮助人民负担得起自己想过的生活。

cues.en: Let today be the start of a new American movement.
cues.zh: 让今天成为一场新的美国运动的起点。

cues.en: It is a movement that is defined not by corporate greed or political hatred, but by the power of people coming together to demand change.
cues.zh: 定义这场运动的，不是企业贪婪或政治仇恨，而是人们团结起来、要求改变的力量。

cues.en: And we saw it coming, Minnesota.
cues.zh: 明尼苏达，我们早已看到它的到来。

cues.en: Because it began right here.
cues.zh: 因为它就从这里开始。

cues.en: When a president who thinks he's a king sent thugs to our state, you sent his private army packing.
cues.zh: 当那个自以为是国王的总统，把暴徒派到我们州时，你们把他的私人军队赶了回去。

cues.en: In the dead of winter, you chose to leave the safety of your home.
cues.zh: 严冬之中，你们选择走出安全的家。

cues.en: You picked up groceries for people you didn't know.
cues.zh: 为素不相识的人采购食品。

cues.en: You walked kids to school who weren't yours.
cues.zh: 护送并非自己孩子的孩子上学。

cues.en: You marched.
cues.zh: 你们走上街头。

cues.en: You blew whistles.
cues.zh: 你们吹响哨子。

cues.en: You believed that your neighbors are always worth fighting for.
cues.zh: 你们相信，邻居永远值得我们为之奋斗。

cues.en: And you proved that when Minnesotans fight for one another, we can inspire a nation to join that fight.
cues.zh: 你们证明，明尼苏达人为彼此而战时，能鼓舞整个国家加入。

cues.en: Because when you come for one of us, you come for all of us.
cues.zh: 因为当你伤害我们中的一个人，就是在伤害我们所有人。

cues.en: And And we are not just the land of 10,000 lakes.
cues.zh: 我们不只是“万湖之州”。

cues.en: We are the land of 5.8 million neighbors.
cues.zh: 我们也是五百八十万邻人的家园。

cues.en: And to be a Minnesotan is to believe in fairness above all else.
cues.zh: 作为明尼苏达人，就是相信公平高于一切。

cues.en: It moves us to act for one another.
cues.zh: 这推动着我们为彼此行动。

cues.en: And today, we chose change.
cues.zh: 而今天，我们选择了改变。

cues.en: All across the country today, people spoke loudly and clearly, and the powerful sure better listen.
cues.zh: 今天，全国人民清楚、响亮地发出了声音，权势者最好认真倾听。

cues.en: Whether the people put up signs for a pediatrician in South Carolina or made calls for a former school teacher in Texas whether they knocked on doors for a Paralympic legislator in
cues.zh: 无论是为南卡罗来纳的一位儿科医生插上支持标牌，为得州的一位前教师打电话，还是为艾奥瓦的一位残奥运动员州议员，

cues.en: Iowa or for a logger in Maine, a Methodist minister in Kansas, or a Muslim American doctor in Michigan,
cues.zh: 为缅因州的伐木工、堪萨斯的循道宗牧师，或密歇根的穆斯林美国医生敲门，

cues.en: Or whether they voted for the daughter of a Navy veteran and school teacher in Chicago, or worked their hearts out for this Irish Catholic Native American from St. Louis Park.
cues.zh: 无论是投票给芝加哥一位海军老兵与教师的女儿，还是为我这个来自圣路易斯帕克、信奉天主教、有爱尔兰血统的原住民女性竭尽全力。

cues.en: We know We know that people demanded more.
cues.zh: 我们知道，人民要求更多。

cues.en: And for those of us elected in this moment, it is our duty to deliver.
cues.zh: 对我们这些此刻当选的人来说，兑现承诺，是责任。

cues.en: And you better believe that change is going to come.
cues.zh: 请你们相信，改变一定会到来。

cues.en: It's going to come from new voices that weren't picked by the establishment or party leaders.
cues.zh: 它将来自那些不是由建制势力、不是由党内领袖挑选的新声音。

cues.en: We were picked by the people.
cues.zh: 我们是人民选出来的。

cues.en: We fought back against the money.
cues.zh: 我们反击了金钱势力。

cues.en: We took on our own party, and we are the ones who are going to shake up the status quo.
cues.zh: 我们挑战了自己党内的力量，而我们正是将要撼动现状的人。

cues.en: We were overlooked and underestimated, but we will not be stopped.
cues.zh: 我们曾被忽视、被低估，但不会被阻挡。

cues.en: Boozhoo.
cues.zh: 你好。（奥吉布瓦语）

cues.en: Peggy Flanagan Anishinaabe Kwe.
cues.zh: 我是佩吉·弗拉纳根，一位阿尼希纳贝女性。

cues.en: [Speaks in Ojibwe.] So, the name you voted for on the ballot says Peggy Flanagan.
cues.zh: [用奥吉布瓦语自我介绍。]你们在选票上看到的名字，是佩吉·弗拉纳根。

cues.en: But, my Ojibwe name is Speaks in a loud and clear voice woman.
cues.zh: 但我的奥吉布瓦名字，意为“声音响亮清晰的女人”。

cues.en: I am a proud daughter of the White Earth Nation.
cues.zh: 我是白土部族骄傲的女儿。

cues.en: And my family is the wolf clan.
cues.zh: 我的家族属于狼氏族。

cues.en: And the role of our clan is to ensure we never leave anyone behind.
cues.zh: 我们氏族的职责，是确保不落下任何人。

cues.en: And that's been the purpose of our campaign.
cues.zh: 这也一直是我们竞选的宗旨。

cues.en: We refuse to let this country leave anyone behind.
cues.zh: 我们拒绝让这个国家抛下任何人。

cues.en: And here's the deal.
cues.zh: 事情是这样的。

cues.en: Our campaign didn't begin in a Washington, D.C.
cues.zh: 我们的竞选，不是从华盛顿的

cues.en: Conference room.
cues.zh: 会议室开始的。

cues.en: But, at a kitchen table in St. Louis Park.
cues.zh: 而是从圣路易斯帕克的一张厨房餐桌开始。

cues.en: And it grew.
cues.zh: 随后，它不断壮大。

cues.en: It grew in the basement of the Hibbing Public Library next to the Bob Dylan exhibit.
cues.zh: 在希宾公共图书馆的地下室、鲍勃·迪伦展览旁，生根成长。

cues.en: In cafes, in churches, in VFWs, barns, garages, union halls, and living rooms.
cues.zh: 在咖啡馆、教堂、退伍军人会馆、谷仓、车库、工会大厅和客厅里。

cues.en: And at the darkest hour, in the weeks and months after Donald Trump was elected, when he still looked unbeatable,
cues.zh: 最黑暗的时刻，特朗普当选后的那些日子里，当他看上去仍不可战胜时，

cues.en: You took the boldest action imaginable.
cues.zh: 你们采取了最勇敢的行动。

cues.en: You showed up.
cues.zh: 你们站了出来。

cues.en: And we took out our flip chart paper.
cues.zh: 我们拿出挂图纸。

cues.en: And we asked each other, "What worries you?
cues.zh: 问彼此：“你在担心什么？

cues.en: Who are you fighting for?
cues.zh: 你在为谁奋斗？

cues.en: And what brings you hope?"
cues.zh: 什么让你心怀希望？”

cues.en: And we even put it on Post-it notes and we shared our stories.
cues.zh: 我们把答案写在便利贴上，分享自己的故事。

cues.en: And people all across this state have continued to share their stories with me every day since.
cues.zh: 从那以后，全州的人们每天都在继续与我分享。

cues.en: Like Jessica, a librarian married to a farmer in Canby, who has a $16,000 deductible and had to pay 600 bucks for a 5-minute med check.
cues.zh: 例如坎比的图书管理员杰西卡，她嫁给一位农民，保险自付额高达一万六千美元，五分钟的用药检查却要花六百美元。

cues.en: Or Maggie in Moorhead, who works the night shift at a hotel and then gets up in the morning to run a bakery the next day because one job isn't enough.
cues.zh: 又如穆尔黑德的玛吉，在酒店上夜班，早晨又得起床经营面包店，因为一份工作不够维持生活。

cues.en: It should be.
cues.zh: 本来，一份就应该够。

cues.en: Or my buddy Bentley, who I met in Brainerd, who relies on Medicaid to survive.
cues.zh: 还有在布雷纳德认识的小朋友本特利，他靠医疗补助维持生命。

cues.en: His mom, Chris, lives in fear of what Donald Trump's cuts to Medicaid will mean for her child.
cues.zh: 他的母亲克里斯，总在担心特朗普削减医疗补助会怎样影响自己的孩子。

cues.en: And she is one of the best moms I have ever met in my entire life.
cues.zh: 她是我一生见过最好的母亲之一。

cues.en: It is the people of Minnesota that saw a space to fight back in this campaign.
cues.zh: 是明尼苏达人民，在这场竞选中看到了反击的空间。

cues.en: You powered us to victory and you made our mission clear.
cues.zh: 你们推动我们走向胜利，也明确了我们的使命。

cues.en: You fought for me and now I'm going to fight for you.
cues.zh: 你们为我而战，现在，我将为你们而战。

cues.en: So, friends, in Washington, here's what I'm going to throw down for.
cues.zh: 朋友们，到华盛顿后，我要全力争取这些事。

cues.en: We are going to lower costs so that families can afford their lives.
cues.zh: 降低生活成本，让家庭能够负担生活。

cues.en: We are going to get rid of prior authorizations so that some dude behind a desk, or worse yet,
cues.zh: 取消医疗事先审批，让坐在办公桌后的人，甚至更糟，

cues.en: An AI bot, can't determine whether or not you get the life-saving health care that your doctor has prescribed.
cues.zh: 一个 AI 机器人，无法决定你是否能获得医生开出的救命医疗服务。

cues.en: We will pass right to repair so that farmers can fix their own damn equipment.
cues.zh: 通过维修权法，让农民有权修理自己的设备。

cues.en: We will rip ICE apart.
cues.zh: 我们要拆解移民与海关执法局。

cues.en: That's right.
cues.zh: 没错。

cues.en: And we have the opportunity to replace it with an immigration system that is grounded in public safety for everybody.
cues.zh: 我们有机会，用一个立足于所有人公共安全的新移民制度取代它。

cues.en: Dignity and due process, which by the way is still a part of our constitution.
cues.zh: 维护尊严和正当程序；顺便提醒，这些仍是宪法的一部分。

cues.en: A system that does not tear children away from their families.
cues.zh: 一个不会把孩子从家人身边撕开的制度。

cues.en: We will stop Washington's corruption and hold the most corrupt administration in our nation's history accountable every day.
cues.zh: 我们将制止华盛顿的腐败，每一天都追究这个史上最腐败政府的责任。

cues.en: And we will end Donald Trump's reckless war in Iran.
cues.zh: 结束特朗普在伊朗发动的鲁莽战争。

cues.en: And hear me now.
cues.zh: 请听清楚。

cues.en: We will pass Medicare for All once and for all.
cues.zh: 我们将通过全民医疗保险，彻底落实。

cues.en: And listen.
cues.zh: 还有，请听着。

cues.en: People will tell us that we are dreaming too big and that we are asking for too much.
cues.zh: 有人会说，我们的梦想太大、要求太多。

cues.en: Do not listen to that.
cues.zh: 不要听这些话。

cues.en: All of this is possible, friends, because we know that we get what we organize for.
cues.zh: 朋友们，这一切都可能，因为我们知道，组织起来争取什么，就能赢得什么。

cues.en: I love you, too.
cues.zh: 我也爱你。

cues.en: And I have to say that I can't quite believe that I am standing here as your next United States Senator from the best state in the country.
cues.zh: 我必须说，我还是难以相信，自己竟然站在这里，成为全国最棒的州的下一任美国参议员。

cues.en: My heart My heart My heart is so full.
cues.zh: 我的内心，充满了感动。

cues.en: And I'm also thinking a lot about my mom.
cues.zh: 我也一直在想我的母亲。

cues.en: We lost her shortly after the 2022 election.
cues.zh: 二〇二二年选举后不久，她离开了我们。

cues.en: And while she hasn't been on this earthly plane, she has been right here with me along this entire journey.
cues.zh: 尽管她已不在人世，这整段旅程中，她始终与我同在。

cues.en: It's Pat Flanagan's strength and resilience that gave me the courage and the conviction to believe that a kid like me could one day stand on a stage like this one.
cues.zh: 正是帕特·弗拉纳根的坚强与韧性，给我勇气和信念，让我相信，像我这样的孩子，有一天也能站在这样的舞台上。

cues.en: And it was my dad, Marvin Manypenny, who taught me to speak truth to power.
cues.zh: 是我的父亲马文·曼尼彭尼，教会我向权力说真话。

cues.en: He used to say, "My girl, I want to burn the system down.
cues.zh: 他常说：“女儿啊，我想把这套体制烧掉。

cues.en: And you want to change it from the inside out."
cues.zh: 而你想从内部改变它。”

cues.en: Well, Minnesota, that's what we did tonight.
cues.zh: 明尼苏达，今晚，我们就是这样做的。

cues.en: And that is what we are going to keep doing together.
cues.zh: 我们也将继续一起这样做。

cues.en: We're going to change the hell out of the system and finally make it work for us.
cues.zh: 彻底改变这套体制，终于让它为我们服务。

cues.en: Because you proved that once again, the many can beat the money, and no president can ever beat the power of the people.
cues.zh: 你们再次证明，广大民众能够战胜金钱，没有任何总统能战胜人民的力量。

cues.en: You said, loud and clear, that we refuse to settle for leftovers.
cues.zh: 你们清楚、响亮地说，我们拒绝只分到残羹剩饭。

cues.en: And you you helped a small, but scrappy, often underestimated, enrolled member of the White Earth Nation become the first Native American woman in history to be elected to the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 你们帮助一个身材小巧、却顽强不屈、常被低估的白土部族成员，成为史上第一位当选美国参议员的原住民女性。

cues.en: So, to the young people out there who look like me, to the daughters and to the sons who too often are forgotten or erased,
cues.zh: 那些和我长得相像的年轻人，那些常被遗忘、被抹去的女儿与儿子们，

cues.en: I see you.
cues.zh: 我看见你们了。

cues.en: Do not be disheartened that it took 250 years for one of us to get here.
cues.zh: 不要因为过了二百五十年，我们才有一人走到这里，就灰心。

cues.en: Be inspired by the fact that with grit and determination and the resilience of our people, whichever one of you is next,
cues.zh: 要从这里获得鼓舞：凭借毅力、决心，以及我们人民的韧性，无论下一个是你们中的谁，

cues.en: You're going to get here a lot faster.
cues.zh: 你都会更快走到这里。

cues.en: Because if Auntie Peggy can do it, you can do it, too.
cues.zh: 因为佩吉阿姨做得到，你也做得到。

cues.en: And people people will underestimate you, my girl.
cues.zh: 孩子，人们会低估你。

cues.en: Do not let them.
cues.zh: 不要让他们这样做。

cues.en: You know who you are.
cues.zh: 你知道自己是谁。

cues.en: You know where you come from, and you know what you can do.
cues.zh: 知道自己从哪里来，知道自己能做到什么。

cues.en: There is no stopping you from achieving your dreams.
cues.zh: 没有什么能阻止你实现梦想。

cues.en: And there is no stopping Minnesota because our cause is righteous and our people will not bend.
cues.zh: 也没有什么能阻止明尼苏达，因为我们的事业是正义的，我们的人民不会屈服。

cues.en: And you better believe that we are going to fight like hell for our state and for our country.
cues.zh: 请相信，我们一定会为自己的州、自己的国家，全力战斗。

cues.en: And it would take me weeks to thank all of the people that I need to thank.
cues.zh: 如果要感谢所有需要感谢的人，我恐怕得花上好几个星期。

cues.en: But I do want to take a few moments.
cues.zh: 但我还是想用一点时间。

cues.en: I want to take a moment to thank Michele Tafoya for running a spirited campaign.
cues.zh: 感谢米歇尔·塔福亚，她进行了一场充满活力的竞选。

cues.en: She No, no, no, no, no.
cues.zh: 不，不，不要这样。

cues.en: She called earlier tonight, and she said, "I hope you do right by Minnesota."
cues.zh: 今晚早些时候，她来电说：“希望你为明尼苏达做正确的事。”

cues.en: And I said, "You bet."
cues.zh: 我回答：“那当然。”

cues.en: I want to thank my campaign team led by a badass Minnesotan from New Ulm who ran a small but mighty team that held 360 events in 125 communities.
cues.zh: 感谢竞选团队，由来自新阿尔姆的一位了不起的明尼苏达人领导；这支小而精悍的团队，在一百二十五个社区举办了三百六十场活动。

cues.en: And she did it.
cues.zh: 她做到了。

cues.en: She did it in the face of unimaginable tragedies and unprecedented money spent against us.
cues.zh: 面对难以想象的悲剧，以及对手投入的空前资金，她仍然做到了。

cues.en: Thank you, Peyton Lewis.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，佩顿·刘易斯。

cues.en: And thank you to the campaign team that you led to victory.
cues.zh: 也感谢你带领取得胜利的竞选团队。

cues.en: You slayed.
cues.zh: 你们太厉害了。

cues.en: And to Megan Shannon, our deputy campaign manager, whose problem-solving abilities know no bounds and can always solve problems and knows which direction flags should face.
cues.zh: 感谢副竞选经理梅根·香农，你解决问题的能力无穷无尽，总能找到办法，连旗帜该朝哪个方向都知道。

cues.en: I thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢你。

cues.en: And to Noodle, we can't wait to meet you.
cues.zh: 还有努德尔，我们迫不及待想见到你。

cues.en: And to every single volunteer whose hard work powered this entire campaign, thank you.
cues.zh: 每一位用辛勤劳动支撑整场竞选的志愿者，谢谢你们。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: And thank you, Senator Tina Smith.
cues.zh: 感谢蒂娜·史密斯参议员。

cues.en: Thank you for being a mentor and a friend and an inspiration.
cues.zh: 感谢你做我的导师、朋友，给予我启发。

cues.en: Thank you for everything you've done for me and for the people of Minnesota.
cues.zh: 感谢你为我、为明尼苏达人民所做的一切。

cues.en: You are leaving some awfully big Chuck Taylors to fill, sister.
cues.zh: 姐妹，你留下的那双匡威帆布鞋，实在太难接过了。

cues.en: I love you so much.
cues.zh: 我非常爱你。

cues.en: And thank you to Governor Tim Walz.
cues.zh: 也感谢蒂姆·沃尔兹州长。

cues.en: I am grateful for all of the work that we did together on behalf of Minnesota's children and families and the historic work to strengthen tribal state relations.
cues.zh: 感谢我们共同为明尼苏达儿童与家庭所做的工作，也感谢在加强部族与州政府关系上取得的历史性成果。

cues.en: Thank you, Governor, for your service to Minnesota.
cues.zh: 州长，谢谢你为明尼苏达的服务。

cues.en: And last, but never, ever least, Tom and Siobhan, you are my inspiration.
cues.zh: 最后，当然绝非最不重要的，汤姆和希沃恩，你们是我的动力。

cues.en: Tom, you are my person.
cues.zh: 汤姆，你是我的灵魂伴侣。

cues.en: And I cannot believe I got to marry my local celebrity crush.
cues.zh: 我仍不敢相信，自己竟然嫁给了曾经暗恋的本地名人。

cues.en: And that every day you define what it means to be in a true partnership.
cues.zh: 每一天，你都让我明白，真正的伙伴关系意味着什么。

cues.en: I love you.
cues.zh: 我爱你。

cues.en: And to my whole heart, Siobhan, my girl, I am so proud of you every single day.
cues.zh: 还有我的全部心肝，希沃恩，我的女儿，每一天，我都为你骄傲。

cues.en: You know who you are.
cues.zh: 你知道自己是谁。

cues.en: Your talent, your heart, your courage, your compassion, your humor knows no bounds.
cues.zh: 你的才华、真心、勇气、同情心和幽默，无穷无尽。

cues.en: And my proudest accomplishment ever was bringing you into the world and being your mom.
cues.zh: 我最骄傲的成就，就是把你带到这个世界，成为你的母亲。

cues.en: I love you so much, my girl.
cues.zh: 我非常爱你，我的女儿。

cues.en: And tonight, it's hard not to think about my political hero, Paul Wellstone.
cues.zh: 今晚，很难不想起我的政治英雄，保罗·韦尔斯通。

cues.en: Paul's last campaign was my first.
cues.zh: 保罗最后一次竞选，正是我第一次参与竞选。

cues.en: And he used to always say, "I don't represent the big oil companies.
cues.zh: 他常常说：“我不代表大型石油公司。

cues.en: I don't represent the big pharmaceutical companies.
cues.zh: 不代表大型制药公司。

cues.en: I don't represent the Enrons of the world.
cues.zh: 不代表这个世界上的安然公司。

cues.en: But you know what?
cues.zh: 但你们知道吗？

cues.en: They already have great representation in Washington.
cues.zh: 他们在华盛顿早已拥有很好的代表。

cues.en: It's the rest of the people that need it.
cues.zh: 需要代表的，是其他普通人。

cues.en: I represent the people of Minnesota.
cues.zh: 我代表明尼苏达人民。”

cues.en: And so, I will say it the way that Paul did.
cues.zh: 所以，我也要用保罗的方式说这句话。

cues.en: You will always know where I stand and who I stand up for.
cues.zh: 你们始终会知道我的立场，知道我为谁挺身而出。

cues.en: I won't represent the billionaires.
cues.zh: 我不会代表亿万富翁。

cues.en: I won't represent the big drug companies or the big insurance companies.
cues.zh: 不会代表大型药企、大型保险公司。

cues.en: And I sure as hell won't represent Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 更绝不会代表唐纳德·特朗普。

cues.en: I will represent the people of Minnesota whether you voted for me or not.
cues.zh: 我会代表明尼苏达人民，无论你们是否投票给我。

cues.en: Because I have never been more proud to be a Minnesotan than I am right this minute.
cues.zh: 因为此时此刻，身为明尼苏达人的自豪感，胜过以往任何时候。

cues.en: And friends, when I get to Washington, I know I'm not going alone.
cues.zh: 朋友们，前往华盛顿时，我知道自己不是一个人去。

cues.en: I am bringing all of you with me.
cues.zh: 我会带着你们所有人同行。

cues.en: Thank you all so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢大家。

cues.en: Gichi migwech.
cues.zh: 衷心感谢。（奥吉布瓦语）

cues.en: I love you, Minnesota.
cues.zh: 明尼苏达，我爱你们。

subtitleType: 校订英文 / 中文翻译（听不清处已标注）

speaker: Abdul El-Sayed
role: 密歇根州 · 候任参议员
title: Abdul El-Sayed's full victory speech | November 3, 2026

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: All right, friends.
cues.zh: 好的，朋友们。

cues.en: You know how we do.
cues.zh: 大家知道我们的口号。

cues.en: Money out of politics.
cues.zh: 让金钱退出政治。

cues.en: Money in your pocket.
cues.zh: 让人民的口袋充实起来。

cues.en: Medicare for All.
cues.zh: 全民医疗保险。

cues.en: Michigan, we did it.
cues.zh: 密歇根，我们做到了！

cues.en: My name is Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed.
cues.zh: 我叫阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·穆罕默德·埃尔-赛义德。

cues.en: And I am so proud and honored to stand here as your senator elect from the great state of Michigan.
cues.zh: 能作为伟大密歇根州的候任参议员站在这里，我无比自豪、无比荣幸。

cues.en: Up until right about now, you might have noticed I always say inshallah or God willing whenever the outcome of this race was mentioned.
cues.zh: 你们可能注意到，此前每次提到选举结果，我都会说“inshallah”，意思是“如果真主愿意”。

cues.en: But today, tonight, we can turn that inshallah into an alhamdulillah.
cues.zh: 但今天，今晚，我们可以把“如果真主愿意”，变成“alhamdulillah”。

cues.en: For the right-wing ops, that just means praise be to God.
cues.zh: 给那些右翼操盘手解释一下：这句话只是“赞颂真主”的意思。

cues.en: This movement for money out of politics, money in your pocket, and Medicare for All, I just want to thank you everybody who knocked the door,
cues.zh: 对于这场要求金钱退出政治、让人民口袋充实、实行全民医保的运动，我要感谢每一个敲门的人，

cues.en: Made a call, sent a dollar, posted a story, and most importantly, gave us your stake in democracy.
cues.zh: 打电话、捐一美元、发一条动态，以及最重要的，把自己的民主权利托付给我们的人。

cues.en: You took a chance on the unlikeliest of candidates.
cues.zh: 你们愿意相信一个最不被看好的候选人。

cues.en: So thank you.
cues.zh: 所以，谢谢你们。

cues.en: This is all yours.
cues.zh: 这一切都属于你们。

cues.en: Michigan, I cannot wait to serve you with the same big-heartedness, open-mindedness, grit, and earnestness that you've shown me.
cues.zh: 密歇根，我迫不及待要以你们展现给我的宽厚、开放、坚韧和真诚，为你们服务。

cues.en: You welcomed me to your homes, your churches, your synagogues, your VFW and union halls.
cues.zh: 你们欢迎我走进家中、教堂、犹太会堂、退伍军人会馆和工会大厅。

cues.en: You shared moments of frustration and sadness and vulnerability with me.
cues.zh: 与我分享挫折、悲伤和脆弱的时刻。

cues.en: You gave me grace and strength in my lowest moments.
cues.zh: 在我最低落的时候，给予我宽容和力量。

cues.en: And the hope and inspiration that powered my best.
cues.zh: 也给予我希望与鼓舞，让我拿出最好的自己。

cues.en: I love you back.
cues.zh: 我也爱你们。

cues.en: And I hope that I can bring it all with me.
cues.zh: 我希望把这一切都带在身边。

cues.en: I hope I can bring it all with me to Washington in your service.
cues.zh: 把这一切带到华盛顿，为你们服务。

cues.en: Thank you for your trust and your belief and your kindness.
cues.zh: 感谢你们的信任、信念和善意。

cues.en: I'm going to take it all with me and I hope to bring back the kind of leadership that more than earns it.
cues.zh: 我会带着这一切，也希望带回一种真正配得上它们的领导方式。

cues.en: The last month has brought the stakes of this election into sharp relief.
cues.zh: 过去一个月，让这场选举的利害关系变得格外清楚。

cues.en: Ours, this beautiful movement was built over the past year and a half campaigning across Michigan's biggest cities and its smallest towns.
cues.zh: 我们的这场美丽运动，是过去一年半走遍密歇根大城市、小城镇建立起来的。

cues.en: We spoke of a brighter, a bigger, more hopeful Michigan.
cues.zh: 我们谈论一个更光明、更宽广、更有希望的密歇根。

cues.en: Theirs, an astroturfed corporate-funded advertising campaign built to deceive and distract.
cues.zh: 他们的，则是一场由企业出钱、伪装成民间行动，意在欺骗和转移视线的广告攻势。

cues.en: Rather than try to unite us to contend with the crisis of gas or groceries, the opposition decided to try to divide us.
cues.zh: 对手没有团结大家应对油价、食品价格危机，而是选择分裂我们。

cues.en: At first, they pointed to my name and my faith as if to say, you know, he's a little different.
cues.zh: 起初，他们拿我的名字、我的信仰说事，仿佛在说：“他和我们有点不一样。”

cues.en: And when it didn't work, they tried to guilt me by association.
cues.zh: 没有奏效，他们就试图用牵连的方式给我定罪。

cues.en: And when that didn't work, they went all in on one of the ugliest campaigns we've seen in our lifetimes.
cues.zh: 还不奏效，他们便全力发动我们一生中所见最丑恶的竞选攻势之一。

cues.en: They might have been pointing to my name and my faith, but we all know that my name and my faith aren't the reason you can't afford your gas.
cues.zh: 他们针对的也许是我的名字和信仰，但大家都知道，那并不是你加不起油的原因。

cues.en: Not the reason you can't afford your groceries.
cues.zh: 不是你买不起食品的原因。

cues.en: Not the reason you can't see a doctor.
cues.zh: 不是你看不起医生的原因。

cues.en: Now, as I was campaigning, some of you would come up and ask me, how come you don't hit back?
cues.zh: 竞选期间，有些人问我：你为什么不还击？

cues.en: How come you don't call them racist or hateful?
cues.zh: 为什么不说他们种族歧视、充满仇恨？

cues.en: Because here's the thing, I didn't run for myself.
cues.zh: 因为，我不是为了自己才参选。

cues.en: And in truth, they weren't targeting me.
cues.zh: 事实上，他们针对的也不是我。

cues.en: They weren't just attacking me.
cues.zh: 他们不只是在攻击我。

cues.en: They were targeting and attacking you.
cues.zh: 他们针对、攻击的，是你们。

cues.en: They were targeting and attacking the very idea of America.
cues.zh: 是美国这个理念本身。

cues.en: See, they hate the idea of an America big enough for anyone who looks a little different or prays a little different or whose family comes from a different part of the World.
cues.zh: 他们不愿看到一个足够宽广的美国，能够容纳长相不同、祈祷方式不同，或家庭来自世界其他地方的人。

cues.en: That includes me, but it also includes anyone and everyone who doesn't look like them, pray like them,
cues.zh: 这当然包括我，也包括所有长得不像他们、祈祷方式不像他们，

cues.en: Love like them, or isn't rich like them.
cues.zh: 爱得不像他们，或者没有他们富有的人。

cues.en: So they turned this race into a simple choice.
cues.zh: 所以，他们让这场选举变成一个简单的选择。

cues.en: They want an America that is too small for some of us.
cues.zh: 他们想要一个狭小到容不下我们某些人的美国。

cues.en: We know that America is big enough for all of us.
cues.zh: 而我们知道，美国足够宽广，能容下我们所有人。

cues.en: Big enough.
cues.zh: 足够宽广。

cues.en: We're big enough to take on the crises that we face.
cues.zh: 也足够强大，能够应对面前的危机。

cues.en: Day by day, Trump's insults became uglier and coarser.
cues.zh: 一天天地，特朗普的侮辱变得更恶毒、更粗鄙。

cues.en: But I got to spend those days with you, learning about your struggles, your hopes, and the things that inspire you.
cues.zh: 但我却能把那些日子花在和你们相处，了解你们的挣扎、希望，以及给你们力量的事物。

cues.en: A mom of two kids with a genetic lung disease in East Jordan, fighting the system to make sure her kids don't lose the meds that they rely on to stay alive.
cues.zh: 东乔丹的一位母亲，两个孩子都患遗传性肺病；她与体制抗争，确保孩子不会失去赖以维生的药物。

cues.en: Her hope, that they don't have to struggle with health insurance like she has.
cues.zh: 她希望，孩子不必像她一样，为医疗保险苦苦挣扎。

cues.en: A grandma on the East Side fighting to make sure that the violence that took her son doesn't take her grandson, Too.
cues.zh: 东区的一位祖母，努力不让夺走儿子生命的暴力，再夺走她的孙子，再一次发生。

cues.en: Her hope, an America where boys get to grow up.
cues.zh: 她希望，在美国，男孩子们都能平安长大。

cues.en: I met Josh, the UAW auto worker fighting the corporate bosses who hadn't raised their wages in two decades despite billions in profit.
cues.zh: 我遇见了汽车工人乔希，一位汽车工人工会会员；公司利润数十亿，却二十年不涨工资，他正与这些企业老板抗争。

cues.en: And they won that fight.
cues.zh: 而他们赢了。

cues.en: His hope: an America where every single worker gets the right to a union.
cues.zh: 他希望，在美国，每一个工人都有加入工会的权利。

cues.en: I met a small business owner fighting to make sure that a another heart attack doesn't take food off the table for his 30 employees or their families.
cues.zh: 一位小企业主，努力确保即使自己再次心脏病发作，也不会让三十名员工及其家人失去生计。

cues.en: His hope that his workers don't have to worry about how they'll feed their families.
cues.zh: 他希望，员工不必担心如何养活家人。

cues.en: See, I didn't get into this to defend myself.
cues.zh: 我投身政治，并不是为了保护我自己。

cues.en: No, I got into it because their fights are my fight and their hopes are all of our hopes.
cues.zh: 而是因为，他们的奋斗就是我的奋斗，他们的希望就是我们共同的希望。

cues.en: We don't do this work for ourselves.
cues.zh: 我们做这些工作，不是为了自己。

cues.en: We do this work for each other to defend us all from another generation's youth, treasure, and opportunity squandered at the altar of endless war.
cues.zh: 而是为了彼此，保护所有人，不让又一代人的青春、财富和机会，被献祭给无尽的战争。

cues.en: To defend us all from corporate oligarchs who bought and sold our government to rig the system against us.
cues.zh: 保护我们，不受买卖政府、操纵体制的企业寡头侵害。

cues.en: To defend us all from a healthcare system more interested in monetizing our illness than healing our bodies and minds.
cues.zh: 保护我们，不受那种更关心靠疾病赚钱、而非治愈身心的医疗体制侵害。

cues.en: To defend us all from air too putrid to breathe and water too putrid to drink.
cues.zh: 保护我们，免于呼吸恶臭的空气、饮用污浊的水。

cues.en: To defend us all from losing our voting or our reproductive or our human rights.
cues.zh: 保护我们的投票权、生育自主权和人权，不被夺走。

cues.en: See, I ran to defend us all from politicians who want to divide us rather than movements that work to dignify us.
cues.zh: 我参选，是为了保护大家，不受制造分裂的政客伤害，而是建立让我们有尊严的运动。

cues.en: Across our primary and general election campaigns, they spent over Get this.
cues.zh: 初选加上大选，他们花了超过——听好了，

cues.en: $350 million trying to beat us.
cues.zh: 三亿五千万美元，试图击败我们。

cues.en: That is a record here in Michigan.
cues.zh: 这在密歇根创下了纪录。

cues.en: $70 million alone in the primary funded by all the same cats who funded the general election.
cues.zh: 光初选就七千万美元，出钱的还是大选中的同一批人。

cues.en: And that's a record anywhere in this country.
cues.zh: 这在全国任何地方，都是纪录。

cues.en: But y'all, Michigan, we built something bigger than a bank account.
cues.zh: 但是密歇根，我们建立的，比一个银行账户更强大。

cues.en: We built a movement.
cues.zh: 我们建立了一场运动。

cues.en: Government of the people, by the people, and for the people.
cues.zh: 一个民有、民治、民享的政府。

cues.en: We showed that in a battle between the money and the many, that the many really can win.
cues.zh: 我们证明，在金钱与广大民众的较量中，广大民众确实能赢。

cues.en: And so to all the kids who watched this last month, to all the parents who struggled to explain why the president openly mocked someone for their name or how they pray,
cues.zh: 所有观看了过去一个月的孩子们，以及那些苦于解释总统为什么公开嘲弄别人的名字和祈祷方式的父母们，

cues.en: Let them know tomorrow that the bad guys lost.
cues.zh: 明天，请告诉他们：坏人输了。

cues.en: Let them know I want you to let them know.
cues.zh: 告诉他们，我希望你们告诉他们。

cues.en: Let them know that we together, fighting for something bigger, we won.
cues.zh: 我们团结起来，为更大的目标而奋斗，我们赢了。

cues.en: So Mike, enjoy your retirement.
cues.zh: 所以迈克，享受你的退休生活吧。

cues.en: I know you got a house in Florida and two yachts.
cues.zh: 我知道，你在佛罗里达有房，还有两艘游艇。

cues.en: See, you chose hate and Michigan chose hope.
cues.zh: 你选择了仇恨，密歇根选择了希望。

cues.en: May we never have to see the likes of you in this state again.
cues.zh: 愿我们再也不用在这个州见到你这样的人。

cues.en: JD Habibi there is this delicious irony in the fact that you're constitutionally obligated to swear me in in January.
cues.zh: J.D.，亲爱的，有件事讽刺得令人痛快：按照宪法，一月你必须主持我的就职宣誓。

cues.en: So you know what that means?
cues.zh: 知道这意味着什么吗？

cues.en: Wolverine won, Buckeyes zero.
cues.zh: 密歇根狼獾队一分，俄亥俄州立七叶树队零分。

cues.en: Donald, look, I know you you struggled with my name.
cues.zh: 唐纳德，我知道，你一直念不好我的名字。

cues.en: So after JD swears me in in January, you could just go on and call me senator.
cues.zh: 所以一月，J.D.主持我的宣誓之后，你就直接叫我“参议员”好了。

cues.en: To the super PACs and special interests who tried to beat us, we are coming for your system of politics.
cues.zh: 那些试图击败我们的超级政治行动委员会和特殊利益集团：我们将挑战你们这套政治制度。

cues.en: To AIPAC, who spent $42 million against us, thank you for giving me the opportunity to beat you twice.
cues.zh: 还有花了四千二百万美元反对我们的美以公共事务委员会：谢谢你们给我两次击败你们的机会。

cues.en: I do want to say something here.
cues.zh: 在这里，我确实想说几句话。

cues.en: See, they try to call you hateful if you believe that Palestinian kids should get to grow up in the land of their forefathers without being murdered by our tax dollars.
cues.zh: 如果你相信巴勒斯坦的孩子应该在祖辈的土地上长大，而不是被我们的税款资助的武器杀害，他们就试图说你充满仇恨。

cues.en: If you believe in equal rights, to peace, dignity, and self-determination, that's not hate, it's love.
cues.zh: 如果你相信平等的权利、和平、尊严和自决，那不是仇恨，而是爱。

cues.en: Michiganders, we want our taxes spent here, for schools here and health care here and infrastructure here.
cues.zh: 密歇根人民，我们希望税款花在这里，建设这里的学校、医疗和基础设施。

cues.en: We don't want our money sent to do apartheid or genocide or war.
cues.zh: 我们不希望自己的钱被拿去支持种族隔离、种族灭绝或战争。

cues.en: Michiganders believe in Michigan, and I believe in Michiganders, and I am so honored that Michiganders believed in me.
cues.zh: 密歇根人相信密歇根，我也相信密歇根人；能获得你们的信任，是我的荣幸。

cues.en: See, you you took a bet on the least likely of candidates.
cues.zh: 你们相信了一个最不被看好的候选人。

cues.en: I'm not a politician.
cues.zh: 我不是职业政客。

cues.en: I'm a doctor with an 11 letter first name.
cues.zh: 我是一个名字有十一个字母的医生。

cues.en: They told us when I started this campaign, there was no way to beat the money.
cues.zh: 刚开始竞选时，他们告诉我们：绝不可能战胜金钱。

cues.en: They told us that someone with my name and my story, a Muslim, was unelectable.
cues.zh: 他们说，像我这样有着这个名字、这段经历的穆斯林，不可能当选。

cues.en: Let alone in a statewide Senate race in Michigan.
cues.zh: 更不可能在密歇根的全州参议员选举中当选。

cues.en: They told us that old-fashioned politics was dead, that traveling the state to have real conversations with real people in real places was a fool's errand.
cues.zh: 他们说，老式政治已经死了；走遍全州，在真实的地方与真实的人真诚交谈，是傻子的差事。

cues.en: They told us that the establishment was too strong, that DC was going to dictate who won and who lost,
cues.zh: 他们说，建制势力太强大，华盛顿会决定谁输谁赢，

cues.en: That Washington and its special interests didn't want us.
cues.zh: 华盛顿和特殊利益集团不想要我们。

cues.en: They told us that when all the votes had been counted on August 4th and then again on November 3rd,
cues.zh: 他们说，八月四日、再到十一月三日，当全部选票开出时，

cues.en: It would have been time and money and energy wasted.
cues.zh: 我们投入的时间、金钱、精力，都将白费。

cues.en: Guess what?
cues.zh: 猜怎么着？

cues.en: It's November 3rd.
cues.zh: 今天就是十一月三日。

cues.en: And the votes have been counted.
cues.zh: 选票已经开出来了。

cues.en: And guess what we just showed them?
cues.zh: 猜猜我们刚刚证明了什么？

cues.en: That a movement of the people, by the people, and for the people will ultimately win.
cues.zh: 一场民有、民治、民享的运动，最终会赢。

cues.en: Michigan understands the solidarity.
cues.zh: 密歇根懂得团结。

cues.en: It is the people who decide who we send to Washington, and what Washington will do.
cues.zh: 决定把谁送往华盛顿、决定华盛顿做什么的，是人民。

cues.en: We decide, not the big money or their stooges.
cues.zh: 是我们决定，不是大金主或他们的傀儡。

cues.en: The people of Michigan will be heard.
cues.zh: 密歇根人民的声音，一定会被听见。

cues.en: We showed that we together we can defeat a record $70 million outside spending and 11 to 1 money disadvantage in a primary election,
cues.zh: 我们证明，团结起来，就能在初选中战胜创纪录的七千万美元外部支出，以及十一比一的资金劣势，

cues.en: That we can defeat a quarter of a billion dollars in a general election.
cues.zh: 能在大选中战胜两亿五千万美元。

cues.en: We can defeat the cynicism of a politics that preys on our earnestness, undersells our intelligence, and exploits our disagreements.
cues.zh: 能击败那种利用我们的真诚、低估我们的智慧、挑拨我们的分歧的犬儒政治。

cues.en: Tonight, Michigan, we beat a machine.
cues.zh: 今晚，密歇根，我们击败了一部政治机器。

cues.en: And we proved once again just how big America really is.
cues.zh: 再次证明，美国的胸襟究竟有多宽广。

cues.en: Because where else but in America can a doctor named Abdul El-Sayed, a child of immigrants raised by his father and his Daughter of the American Revolution stepmother,
cues.zh: 除了美国，还有哪里能让一个名叫阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德的医生、移民之子，由父亲和一位美国革命先辈后裔的继母抚养长大，

cues.en: Get elected senator from America's greatest state?
cues.zh: 最终成为美国最伟大州的参议员？

cues.en: They tried to confuse you, so let me just set the record straight.
cues.zh: 他们试图迷惑你们，那我就把话说清楚。

cues.en: I love America.
cues.zh: 我爱美国。

cues.en: I know exactly what America gave to me.
cues.zh: 我清楚地知道，美国给了我什么。

cues.en: I saw it up close on trips to my family's native Egypt.
cues.zh: 去家人故乡埃及时，我就近距离看到了这些。

cues.en: In a 15-hour journey, I crossed 10 years difference in life expectancy.
cues.zh: 十五小时的旅程，跨越的是十年的预期寿命差距。

cues.en: I didn't have to go 15 hours.
cues.zh: 其实，我不必走十五小时。

cues.en: I could go 15 minutes to Detroit or Pontiac and cross that same difference.
cues.zh: 只要十五分钟，到底特律或庞蒂亚克，我就会跨越同样的差距。
