cues.en: It's why I became a doctor.
cues.zh: 所以，我成为了一名医生。

cues.en: America vaccinated me against diseases that killed an aunt and uncle I never got to meet.
cues.zh: 美国让我接种疫苗，免于那些夺走我未曾谋面的姑姨和叔伯生命的疾病。

cues.en: It gave me incredible public schools.
cues.zh: 它给了我出色的公立学校。

cues.en: It gave me a public university education.
cues.zh: 给了我公立大学教育。

cues.en: It paid my medical education through the NIH.
cues.zh: 通过美国国立卫生研究院，资助我接受医学教育。

cues.en: I love America.
cues.zh: 我爱美国。

cues.en: But I love America enough to ask her to be America for all her kids.
cues.zh: 正因为深爱，我要求她成为属于所有孩子的美国。

cues.en: See, America is not just a flag, not just our red, white, and blue.
cues.zh: 美国不只是一面旗帜，不只是红、白、蓝三种颜色。

cues.en: It's not a few patriotic songs that we sing or even a landmass we call home.
cues.zh: 不只是我们唱的几首爱国歌曲，甚至不只是一片称作家园的土地。

cues.en: America is about these truths that we hold that all people are created equal.
cues.zh: 美国在于我们坚信的真理：人人生而平等。

cues.en: And the inalienable rights we still struggle to guarantee.
cues.zh: 在于我们仍努力保障的那些不可剥夺的权利。

cues.en: Life, liberty, the pursuit of happiness.
cues.zh: 生命、自由，以及追求幸福。

cues.en: The best of America lives in the audacity of daring a contradiction, a more perfect union.
cues.zh: 美国最美好之处，是敢于追求那个看似矛盾的目标：一个更加完善的联邦。

cues.en: That despite the fact that you can't be more than perfect, we embrace the work of perfecting.
cues.zh: 即使“完美”似乎无法再进步，我们仍选择不断完善。

cues.en: America's greatness lives in the moments when free people come together to expand that field of freedom.
cues.zh: 美国的伟大，存在于自由的人们团结起来、拓展自由边界的时刻。

cues.en: America's greatness is the fight to erase the long-standing consequences of slavery and Jim Crow and segregation.
cues.zh: 在于努力消除奴隶制、吉姆·克劳法与种族隔离留下的长期伤害。

cues.en: America's greatness is the fight to embrace all of her people regardless how they pray or if they pray,
cues.zh: 在于拥抱每一个人，无论怎样祈祷、是否祈祷，

cues.en: Who they love, or how they identify.
cues.zh: 无论爱谁，或如何认同自己。

cues.en: America's greatness is in in the union struggle on a shop floor to push off the yoke of greed.
cues.zh: 在于车间里工会工人的抗争，挣脱贪婪的枷锁。

cues.en: America's greatness is the fight to guarantee all of us the healthcare we need if we get sick.
cues.zh: 在于保障每一个人生病时，都能得到所需的医疗。

cues.en: Our greatness is the fight for clean air, clean water, and a good home.
cues.zh: 在于争取清洁空气、干净饮水和安稳的家。

cues.en: Our greatness is the fight for equal pay, for equal work, and full freedom of our bodies.
cues.zh: 在于争取同工同酬，以及对自己身体的完整自主权。

cues.en: America's greatness is in the belief a new American still has in the hope that America has always represented.
cues.zh: 在于每一位新美国人，仍然相信美国始终代表的那份希望。

cues.en: America's greatness isn't about ignoring our flaws.
cues.zh: 美国的伟大，不在于忽视我们的缺陷。

cues.en: It's the courage that we have to correct them.
cues.zh: 而在于有勇气纠正它们。

cues.en: Michigan, it just shouldn't be this hard.
cues.zh: 密歇根，生活真的不该这么难。

cues.en: Shouldn't be this hard to buy a second bag of groceries or fill your tank.
cues.zh: 不该连多买一袋食品、加满油箱都这么难。

cues.en: Shouldn't be this hard to afford a home.
cues.zh: 不该连买得起房子都这么难。

cues.en: It shouldn't be this hard to see a doctor in the richest, most powerful country in the world.
cues.zh: 在世界上最富有、最强大的国家，看医生不该这么难。

cues.en: It shouldn't be this hard to pay your taxes and know that money is going to be spent on you and your kids instead of dropping bombs on somebody else and their Kids.
cues.zh: 纳税后能确信，这钱将用来照顾自己和孩子，而不是轰炸别人的孩子，这不该这么难。

cues.en: It shouldn't be this hard.
cues.zh: 真的不该这么难。

cues.en: We don't need to be great again.
cues.zh: 我们不需要“再次伟大”。

cues.en: We need to embrace that thing about us that has always made us great.
cues.zh: 我们需要拥抱那种一直让我们伟大的品质。

cues.en: The will to be more perfect.
cues.zh: 那就是不断追求更加完善的意志。

cues.en: And right now that means taking on the corporations and the billionaires, special interests who've rigged the system against us for too long.
cues.zh: 而现在，这意味着挑战那些长期操纵体制、侵害我们利益的公司、亿万富翁和特殊利益集团。

cues.en: Now before I close, I've got some thank yous I've got to get through.
cues.zh: 结束之前，我还必须说一些感谢的话。

cues.en: Sarah, thank you.
cues.zh: 萨拉，谢谢你。

cues.en: Thank you for everything.
cues.zh: 谢谢你所做的一切。

cues.en: There is no doing this without you and I wouldn't want to do it with anyone else.
cues.zh: 没有你，就没有这一切；而我也不愿与任何其他人一起走这段路。

cues.en: I love you and I'm so grateful for you.
cues.zh: 我爱你，也深深感激你。

cues.en: Emmalee and Serene have been my inspiration the entire time.
cues.zh: 埃玛莉和瑟琳，一直是我的灵感与动力。

cues.en: I hope someday that they get to read about this in the history books.
cues.zh: 希望有一天，她们能在历史书上读到这一切。

cues.en: To understand just how big a part of it they really were.
cues.zh: 明白自己其实在其中扮演了多么重要的角色。

cues.en: To my parents and my parents in love, my grandparents, my siblings, my extended family, I can never really repay all that you've poured into me.
cues.zh: 感谢父母、岳父母、祖父母、兄弟姐妹和所有家人；你们给予我的，我永远无法完全报答。

cues.en: Thank you always for having my back even if you'd rather I was a surgeon.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们一直支持我，尽管你们也许更希望我成为一名外科医生。

cues.en: To my incredible campaign team, Y'all we did it.
cues.zh: 我出色的竞选团队，各位，我们做到了。

cues.en: I asked you to lift me up and hold me down and you did both with grace, humility,
cues.zh: 我请你们托举我，也让我脚踏实地；你们以宽厚、谦逊，

cues.en: Kindness, and efficiency.
cues.zh: 善意和高效，做到了这两件事。

cues.en: No one else I'd rather ride with, best team in American politics.
cues.zh: 我最愿意与你们同行，你们是美国政界最好的团队。

cues.en: To all the incredible endorsers who entrusted me with your name, who took time out of your schedule to come campaign with us.
cues.zh: 感谢所有出色的支持者，把自己的声誉托付给我，抽出时间来与我们共同竞选。

cues.en: To the Michigan Dems who threw this event for us tonight.
cues.zh: 感谢密歇根州民主党，为我们组织今晚的活动。

cues.en: Our chair, Curtis Hertel, who has had our back through thick and thin.
cues.zh: 感谢党主席柯蒂斯·赫特尔，无论顺境逆境都支持我们。

cues.en: To the all the council people and mayors, all the commissioners and county leaders, state reps and state senators,
cues.zh: 感谢所有市议员、市长、委员、县级领导、州众议员与州参议员，

cues.en: Congress people, and US senators, thank you for standing with us.
cues.zh: 国会议员和美国参议员，谢谢你们与我们站在一起。

cues.en: And a special thank you to our sisters and brothers in labor.
cues.zh: 也特别感谢劳工界的兄弟姐妹。

cues.en: Your support as a second-generation union member has meant more than you can imagine.
cues.zh: 作为第二代工会会员，你们的支持对我意义之大，超乎想象。

cues.en: I cannot wait to stand with you in the fight for Michigan's working people.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待要与你们一起，为密歇根的劳动人民奋斗。

cues.en: To all the community outreach organizations that came through for us in the final stretch, I cannot imagine doing this without you.
cues.zh: 感谢所有在最后阶段帮助我们的社区组织；没有你们，这一切难以想象。

cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。

cues.en: And to all of us here, this fight is not yet over.
cues.zh: 在场的每一个人，这场斗争还没有结束。

cues.en: The day I jumped into this race, I promised you that I'd put in the work, fight the fights on your behalf.
cues.zh: 参选第一天，我就承诺，为你们努力工作、为你们打该打的仗。

cues.en: I asked you for your time, your energy, your support over the last 19 months.
cues.zh: 过去十九个月，我向你们请求时间、精力和支持。

cues.en: Now I'm asking you to support us for the next 6 years.
cues.zh: 现在，我请求你们，在接下来的六年继续支持我们。

cues.en: This work is bigger than one senator.
cues.zh: 这项工作，比任何一位参议员都更宏大。

cues.en: It's about changing the face of our politics.
cues.zh: 它关乎改变我们的政治面貌。

cues.en: So please, do not send me to DC all by myself.
cues.zh: 所以，请不要把我一个人送到华盛顿。

cues.en: All right, I need you all to come with me.
cues.zh: 我需要你们所有人，和我一起去。

cues.en: Winning a single US Senate seat was never the goal.
cues.zh: 赢得一个美国参议院席位，从来不是最终目标。

cues.en: The goal is to use that seat to transform our politics.
cues.zh: 目标是利用这个席位，改变我们的政治。

cues.en: Because it is high past time that we get money out of politics, put money in your pocket,
cues.zh: 因为我们早就应该让金钱退出政治，让人民的口袋充实起来，

cues.en: And pass Medicare for All.
cues.zh: 通过全民医疗保险。

cues.en: The beauty and soul of America is that we the people are what America is all about.
cues.zh: 美国的美与灵魂就在于：我们人民，才是美国的全部意义。

cues.en: We deserve an America for all her kids.
cues.zh: 我们值得拥有一个属于所有孩子的美国。

cues.en: So Michigan, let's go build it.
cues.zh: 所以密歇根，让我们一起去建设它。

cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Chris Pappas
role: 新罕布什尔州 · 候任参议员
title: Full speech: Chris Pappas projected winner in New Hampshire Senate race

cues.en: Well, good evening, New Hampshire.
cues.zh: 新罕布什尔州，大家晚上好。

cues.en: This has been a long campaign against the backdrop of the chaos, corruption, and costs coming out of Washington.
cues.zh: 这是一场漫长的竞选，背后是华盛顿不断带来的混乱、腐败和高昂生活成本。

cues.en: And New Hampshire showed up today.
cues.zh: 而今天，新罕布什尔州的人民站了出来。

cues.en: You spoke out today.
cues.zh: 你们发出了声音。

cues.en: You said in a resounding voice that America needs a course correction, that Washington needs a new generation at the table to fix things,
cues.zh: 你们响亮地说：美国需要修正方向，华盛顿需要新一代人参与决策、解决问题，

cues.en: And that New Hampshire needs independent leadership to stand up and get stuff done.
cues.zh: 新罕布什尔州需要独立的领导，挺身而出，把事情办成。

cues.en: You know, throughout throughout this campaign, you invited me into your homes, your community centers, and your small businesses.
cues.zh: 整个竞选期间，你们邀请我走进家中、社区中心和小企业。

cues.en: You shared with me your challenges, your fears, and your hopes for the future.
cues.zh: 向我倾诉挑战、担忧，以及对未来的希望。

cues.en: And tonight, I am honored beyond words to have earned your votes, to fight for you in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 今晚，能够赢得你们的选票，到美国参议院为你们奋斗，我的荣幸难以言表。

cues.en: A few minutes ago, I just got a very gracious call from John Sununu.
cues.zh: 就在几分钟前，约翰·苏努努给我打来了一个非常友善的电话。

cues.en: He wished us and our team well, and I wish the same for him and his family.
cues.zh: 他祝福我们和我们的团队，我也祝福他和他的家人。

cues.en: And I think we all owe John Sununu a big debt of gratitude for his public service for the people of New Hampshire.
cues.zh: 我们都应该感谢约翰·苏努努为新罕布什尔州人民所作的公共服务。

cues.en: So tonight, whether you're a Republican, an independent, or a Democrat, tonight's victory is for you because this is a victory for team New Hampshire over the broken status quo that is
cues.zh: 今晚，无论你是共和党人、独立人士还是民主党人，这场胜利都属于你；这是新罕布什尔州全体民众战胜失灵现状的胜利，

cues.en: Hurting all of us just the same.
cues.zh: 因为那种现状，同样伤害着我们所有人。

cues.en: Tonight's results are a wake-up call for corporate special interests and billionaires who have been rigging the economy,
cues.zh: 今晚的结果，为操纵经济的大企业利益集团和亿万富翁敲响了警钟，

cues.en: For the cowards in Congress who have enabled healthcare cuts, tariffs, and war, and for the incompetent president who can't even be bothered to care how people are being hurt.
cues.zh: 也为放任医疗削减、关税和战争的国会懦夫，以及那个无能、甚至懒得关心人民如何受苦的总统敲响了警钟。

cues.en: So tonight, voters in New Hampshire and all across the country simply have had enough enough and are demanding a change in direction.
cues.zh: 今晚，本州乃至全国的选民都已受够，要求改变方向。

cues.en: And I am ready to fight with everything I've got to deliver the change that we need.
cues.zh: 我已准备好，倾尽全力，为我们需要的改变而战。

cues.en: So here in New Hampshire here in New Hampshire, we are clear-eyed about the scale of the challenges that we face and the hard work that it will take to move forward.
cues.zh: 在新罕布什尔州，我们清楚地知道，挑战有多大，以及前进需要付出怎样的艰苦努力。

cues.en: Whether it's building the housing New Hampshire needs, expanding access to healthcare and childcare, saving Social Security, protecting our planet,
cues.zh: 无论是建设本州需要的住房、扩大医疗和托育服务、守护社会保障、保护地球，

cues.en: Restoring reproductive freedom, rooting out corruption, or holding this administration accountable, we don't have a moment to waste, Do we?
cues.zh: 还是恢复生育自主权、根除腐败、追究本届政府的责任，我们一刻都不能浪费，对不对？

cues.en: But there will, of course, be moments that test our resolve.
cues.zh: 当然，总会有考验我们决心的时候。

cues.en: There will be times when we hit roadblocks and get frustrated with the pace of progress, but we can never give up and we must be committed to renewing the purpose of
cues.zh: 我们会遇到阻碍，会因进展太慢而沮丧；但我们绝不能放弃，必须致力于重振

cues.en: American democracy and working with persistence and urgency each and every day.
cues.zh: 美国民主的使命，每一天都坚持不懈、时不我待地工作。

cues.en: I'll be honored to stand with the people of New Hampshire shoulder to shoulder in that work, and I'll work with anyone who can deliver a better life for Granite Staters,
cues.zh: 能够与新罕布什尔州人民并肩承担这项工作，是我的荣幸；我会与任何能为本州居民带来更好生活的人合作，

cues.en: And I will stand up to anyone who will take us back.
cues.zh: 也会挺身对抗任何试图让我们倒退的人。

cues.en: You know, across this state, Granite Staters are showing the fighting spirit, the resilience, and the determination that we're known for,
cues.zh: 在全州各地，居民们正展现着我们一贯的斗志、韧性和决心，

cues.en: Protesting against the reckless policies coming out of Washington, organizing against corporate landlords buying up homes and jacking up the rent,
cues.zh: 抗议华盛顿鲁莽的政策，组织起来反对企业房东抢购住房、抬高房租，

cues.en: Opposing big data centers that harm our communities and our well-being, and stopping an ICE detention center from being built in the state of New Hampshire.
cues.zh: 反对损害社区与福祉的大型数据中心，阻止移民与海关执法局在本州建设拘留中心。

cues.en: We're also a state we're also a state that shows compassion, mobilizing for our friends and neighbors, for veterans,
cues.zh: 我们也是一个富有同情心的州，愿意为朋友和邻居、为退伍军人，

cues.en: For folks struggling with addiction, or families who are in need of food or shelter.
cues.zh: 为正与成瘾作斗争的人，为缺少食物或住所的家庭行动起来。

cues.en: That's how we do things in the state of New Hampshire.
cues.zh: 这就是新罕布什尔州的做事方式。

cues.en: We step up.
cues.zh: 我们挺身而出。

cues.en: We roll up our sleeves and we make it happen.
cues.zh: 我们卷起袖子，把事情办成。

cues.en: And that's the spirit I'll bring to my work in the United States Senate for all of you.
cues.zh: 我将带着这样的精神，到美国参议院为各位工作。

cues.en: So tonight tonight we don't celebrate a victory for any one political party.
cues.zh: 所以，今晚我们庆祝的，不是某一个政党的胜利。

cues.en: We celebrate a victory for anyone, left, right, or center, struggling with the skyrocketing costs of living from gas to groceries to housing.
cues.zh: 而是所有人的胜利：无论左派、右派还是中间派，只要你正被汽油、食品和住房等飞涨的生活成本压得喘不过气。

cues.en: Anyone who's sick of the tariffs, the endless war, the tax breaks for big corporations paid for by cuts to your healthcare.
cues.zh: 属于每一个受够关税、无休止的战争，以及拿削减你们医疗保障来给大公司减税的人。

cues.en: Anyone who's fed up with the most corrupt president in our history, who has failed in his way of governing.
cues.zh: 属于每一个受够了美国历史上最腐败、治理彻底失败的总统的人。

cues.en: And anyone who knows that we can do so much better if we work together.
cues.zh: 也属于每一个知道，只要团结合作，我们就能做得更好的人。

cues.en: So we know this was a hard-fought victory tonight.
cues.zh: 我们知道，今晚的胜利来之不易。

cues.en: It was made even harder by the tens and tens of millions of dollars that poured into New Hampshire from Donald Trump,
cues.zh: 特朗普向新罕布什尔州倾注的数千万美元，让这场战斗更加艰难，

cues.en: Elon Musk, and corporate special interests who are just fine with the way things are going right now.
cues.zh: 还有埃隆·马斯克，以及那些对现状非常满意的企业利益集团。

cues.en: They threw money, attack ads, and outright lies at us every day for months.
cues.zh: 连续数月，他们每天都向我们砸钱，投放攻击广告，散播赤裸裸的谎言。

cues.en: But we beat them anyway, didn't we?
cues.zh: 但我们还是击败了他们，对不对？

cues.en: We were never the big money campaign.
cues.zh: 我们从来不是靠大金主撑起来的竞选。

cues.en: We're the people people-powered campaign, a campaign of 200,000 individual donors and not a dime from corporate PACs.
cues.zh: 我们依靠人民的力量：二十万名个人捐款者，没有拿企业政治行动委员会的一分钱。

cues.en: And we showed what happens when we stick together, stand up for what's right, and never lose hope even when the odds are long.
cues.zh: 我们证明了：团结起来，坚持正义，即使胜算渺茫也不放弃希望，就能做到什么。

cues.en: It was 579 days ago that we gathered in this very room, a place where we've celebrated many victories with more to come tonight.
cues.zh: 五百七十九天前，我们就聚在这间屋子里。这里见证过许多胜利，今晚还会有更多。

cues.en: And a place that has taught me everything about serving the community that I know and love, that has given me so many opportunities in my life.
cues.zh: 这个地方教会我，如何服务我熟悉、热爱的社区；这个社区给了我人生中那么多机会。

cues.en: Nearly 20 months ago I said I knew we were living in deeply uncertain times.
cues.zh: 将近二十个月前，我说过，我知道我们正处于极度不确定的时代。

cues.en: But I knew something else, that Granite Staters don't flinch.
cues.zh: 但我还知道一件事：新罕布什尔州的人不会退缩。

cues.en: We don't give in.
cues.zh: 我们不会屈服。

cues.en: We stand and fight.
cues.zh: 我们会站起来，去奋斗。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we did in this campaign.
cues.zh: 这正是我们在这场竞选中所做的。

cues.en: The fight we started in this room and took to every corner of New Hampshire is now headed to Washington to get our state and our country on the right track for The future.
cues.zh: 从这间屋子出发、走遍本州每个角落的奋斗，如今将走向华盛顿，让我们的州和国家重新走上正确的道路，迎接未来。

cues.en: And so I'll end tonight by saying this.
cues.zh: 所以，今晚最后，我想说这些。

cues.en: I am so grateful for everyone in this room and beyond who made this win possible.
cues.zh: 我无比感谢在场以及未能到场的每一个人，是你们让这场胜利成为可能。

cues.en: I want to thank my extended family who has always shown up for me each and every day,
cues.zh: 感谢我的大家庭，每一天都始终支持着我，

cues.en: To my amazing parents who have set the best example of public service and hard work and giving back to the community and unconditional love.
cues.zh: 感谢我了不起的父母，在公共服务、勤奋工作、回馈社区和无条件的爱上，为我树立了最好的榜样。

cues.en: I want to thank the guy next to me, my amazing husband Vann.
cues.zh: 感谢站在我身旁的人，我了不起的丈夫范恩。

cues.en: How about it?
cues.zh: 大家说，是不是？

cues.en: All right, the wrong person was on the ballot apparently.
cues.zh: 看来，选票上的人好像选错了。

cues.en: But he's always been by my side.
cues.zh: 但他一直都在我身边。

cues.en: And look, tonight win, lose or draw, I'm the luckiest guy because I'm married to a man that I love.
cues.zh: 今晚无论胜、负还是平局，我都是最幸运的人，因为我嫁给了我深爱的人。

cues.en: And despite all the negative attacks and the lies, it's nice to know that love and truth prevailed tonight.
cues.zh: 尽管面对种种恶意攻击与谎言，知道今晚最终获胜的是爱与真相，真好。

cues.en: I want to thank my amazing campaign staff led by our campaign manager Rachel Petri who ran the most effective campaign our state has seen.
cues.zh: 感谢我出色的竞选团队，以及竞选经理雷切尔·佩特里；你们组织了本州最有效的一场竞选。

cues.en: I want to thank Beth Kunnuff and all the organizers at Organizing for New Hampshire for the work you did to get out the vote.
cues.zh: 感谢贝丝·库纳夫，以及“为新罕布什尔州组织起来”的所有组织者，感谢你们的投票动员工作。

cues.en: You worked hard over the past year communicating with voters on the issues that matter and you got it done.
cues.zh: 过去一年，你们辛勤工作，就重要议题与选民沟通；你们做到了。

cues.en: I want to thank our friends in organized labor who stood shoulder to shoulder with us in this campaign.
cues.zh: 感谢工会组织的朋友们，在这场竞选中与我们并肩而立。

cues.en: And I cannot wait to continue to work with all of you to build a fairer future for everyone who calls New Hampshire home.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待要继续与大家合作，为每一个以新罕布什尔州为家的人，创造更公平的未来。

cues.en: Thank you to all the volunteers, the folks who chipped in, who knocked on doors, who made phone calls,
cues.zh: 感谢所有志愿者，感谢捐款、敲门、打电话的人，

cues.en: Who got voters rides to the polls, who talked to your friends and neighbors about the stakes.
cues.zh: 感谢接送选民投票、向亲友邻居讲清这场选举重要性的人。

cues.en: I wouldn't be standing before you giving this speech tonight if it weren't for the thousands of folks who have stepped up for this campaign.
cues.zh: 如果没有成千上万挺身支持这场竞选的人，我今晚就不会站在这里发表这篇讲话。

cues.en: Thanks for being a part of this.
cues.zh: 感谢你们参与其中。

cues.en: And I want to thank the team in my congressional office too, led by Steven Carlson and Carrie Thurman.
cues.zh: 也感谢我的国会办公室团队，由史蒂文·卡尔森和凯莉·瑟曼带领。

cues.en: They've they've spent the past eight years stepping up for Granite Staters and meeting the needs of our constituents and the entire district,
cues.zh: 过去八年，他们始终为本州居民挺身而出，回应选区每个地方和每位选民的需要，

cues.en: And I just salute them for all their hard work on behalf of New Hampshire.
cues.zh: 我向他们为新罕布什尔州付出的所有努力致敬。

cues.en: I want to thank my friend of the New Hampshire delegation, the amazing Senator Maggie Hassan for joining us here tonight.
cues.zh: 感谢本州国会代表团中的朋友、出色的玛吉·哈桑参议员，今晚来到这里。

cues.en: It's going to be an honor to be with her as part of the team in United States Senate working closely together for the people of this state.
cues.zh: 能够与她一起在美国参议院组成团队、密切合作，为这个州的人民服务，将是我的荣幸。

cues.en: And I want to send my best wishes to my friend Maggie Goodlander on her victory tonight.
cues.zh: 也祝贺我的朋友玛吉·古德兰德，今晚赢得胜利。

cues.en: And my friend, who I think you will be hearing from shortly, Stefany Shaheen.
cues.zh: 还有我的朋友斯蒂芬妮·沙欣，我想各位很快就会听到她的讲话。

cues.en: Look, before I close, I just want to recognize someone who's important to all of us here in this room and who's made an immeasurable difference for the people of New Hampshire
cues.zh: 结束之前，我还想致敬一个对在座所有人都很重要的人；她在公共服务生涯中，为新罕布什尔州人民作出了不可估量的贡献，

cues.en: Throughout her time in public service, and that's the great Senator Jeanne Shaheen.
cues.zh: 她就是伟大的珍妮·沙欣参议员。

cues.en: Senator Shaheen has set the standard we should all strive for in public service, and I couldn't be more grateful to call her a colleague and a friend.
cues.zh: 沙欣参议员树立了我们都应该努力追求的公共服务标准；能称她为同事、朋友，我无比感激。

cues.en: We know that New Hampshire is a better place because of the work she's done throughout her career and her impact on education,
cues.zh: 她一生的工作，让新罕布什尔州变得更好；她在教育，

cues.en: On health care, on the environment, the economy, and so many other crucial issues will stand the test of time.
cues.zh: 医疗、环境、经济和其他众多关键议题上的影响，将经得起时间检验。

cues.en: So know this, no one will ever fill her shoes, but we all have got to carry on her good work, Don't we?
cues.zh: 请相信，谁也无法取代她，但我们每个人都必须延续她的工作，对不对？

cues.en: So tonight we celebrate.
cues.zh: 所以，今晚让我们庆祝。

cues.en: And as we celebrate, let's think about the brighter future that we can all build together.
cues.zh: 庆祝之时，也想一想，我们能共同创造怎样更光明的未来。

cues.en: Let's remember what is possible when we join with common purpose and fight for a fairer, freer New Hampshire.
cues.zh: 记住，只要怀着共同目标，争取一个更公平、更自由的新罕布什尔州，就没有什么不可能。

cues.en: Today you all did your part.
cues.zh: 今天，你们尽了自己的力量。

cues.en: We all did our part to put our state and our country on a better path.
cues.zh: 我们每个人都为让这个州和国家走上更好的道路，尽了一份力。

cues.en: And tomorrow we've got to get to work to fight for what's right and deliver the solutions that are desperately needed.
cues.zh: 明天，我们就必须投入工作，坚持正确的事，拿出人民迫切需要的解决办法。

cues.en: So my my words to you tonight are thank you and let's keep going.
cues.zh: 今晚，我想说的就是：谢谢你们，让我们继续向前。

cues.en: Let's keep going.
cues.zh: 继续向前。

cues.en: Let's keep going and fighting and working for the people of this great state.
cues.zh: 继续为这个伟大州的人民奋斗、工作。

cues.en: Thank you all for being here tonight.
cues.zh: 感谢大家今晚来到这里。

cues.en: I really appreciate it.
cues.zh: 我真的非常感激。

speaker: Josh Turek
role: 艾奥瓦州 · 候任参议员
title: FULL | Josh Turek delivers victory speech in 2026 Iowa race for US Senate

cues.en: Iowa, we have done it.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦，我们做到了！

cues.en: What they said was impossible.
cues.zh: 做到了他们说不可能做到的事。

cues.en: Together, Iowa, we have proven that the impossible was possible.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦，我们一起证明了：不可能，也能成为可能。

cues.en: And as we said in the primary, and I'll say it again, Iowa, you sure do love an underdog.
cues.zh: 正如初选时我们说过的，我还要再说一次：艾奥瓦，你们真喜欢不被看好的人。

cues.en: After 448 days of hard work, pushing up hills, knocking doors, visiting all 99 counties, visiting small and midsize communities all across this state,
cues.zh: 四百四十八天里，我们努力上坡、挨家敲门、走遍全部九十九个县，走进全州的中小社区，

cues.en: And preaching the message of a better future for Iowa.
cues.zh: 宣讲艾奥瓦可以拥有更美好未来的愿景。

cues.en: Together, we have made history.
cues.zh: 我们一起创造了历史。

cues.en: For the first time in 20 years, Iowa will have representation in the United States Senate for the people of Iowa.
cues.zh: 二十年来，艾奥瓦人民首次将在美国参议院拥有真正为他们发声的代表。

cues.en: As I have said all along, my story is truly the American dream.
cues.zh: 正如我一直说的，我的故事，就是美国梦。

cues.en: Only in America could someone born into a working-class family in Council Bluffs, Iowa, who went through the economic and health care struggle that I went through ultimately be able to represent
cues.zh: 只有在美国，一个出生于艾奥瓦康瑟尔布拉夫斯劳动家庭、经历过我所经历的经济与医疗困境的人，最终才能代表

cues.en: My country in four Paralympic games, win two gold medals, represent my community in the Iowa legislature, and as of tonight,
cues.zh: 国家参加四届残奥会、赢得两枚金牌，在艾奥瓦州议会代表自己的社区，并在今晚，

cues.en: Be elected to represent the state I was born and raised in in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 当选美国参议员，代表这个生我养我的州。

cues.en: Only in America is this possible.
cues.zh: 只有在美国，这一切才有可能。

cues.en: And as your next United States Senator, Iowa, I promise to protect the American dream for future generations.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦，作为你们下一任美国参议员，我承诺为子孙后代守护美国梦。

cues.en: I just got off the phone with Ashley Hinson and commended her on running a strong campaign.
cues.zh: 我刚刚和阿什莉·欣森通了电话，赞扬她进行了一场有力的竞选。

cues.en: Campaigns, they are brutal.
cues.zh: 竞选确实很残酷。

cues.en: I wish her and her family all the best.
cues.zh: 我祝福她和她的家人一切顺利。

cues.en: I have deep respect for anyone who steps up to run.
cues.zh: 我深深敬重每一个愿意站出来参选的人。

cues.en: Yeah, it's worth it.
cues.zh: 是的，她值得。

cues.en: Give her a clap.
cues.zh: 给她一点掌声。

cues.en: I appreciate her service to Iowa for the last few years.
cues.zh: 我感谢她过去几年为艾奥瓦付出的服务。

cues.en: Our campaign finance system is broken and nasty campaign commercials bought by billionaires trying to buy off our elections make it even worse.
cues.zh: 我们的竞选筹款体制已经失灵，而那些试图买下选举的亿万富翁出资投放的恶毒广告，更让情况雪上加霜。

cues.en: But tonight, Iowa, we outvoted the billionaires.
cues.zh: 但今晚，艾奥瓦，我们用选票击败了亿万富翁。

cues.en: We outworked the corporate PACs, and we told every single corrupt politician, enough is enough.
cues.zh: 我们以行动胜过企业政治行动委员会，告诉每一个腐败政客：够了，就是够了。

cues.en: Here's my promise to each and every one of you.
cues.zh: 这是我对你们每一个人的承诺。

cues.en: First and foremost, in the United States Senate, I will fight to end this war in Iran.
cues.zh: 首先，我会在美国参议院努力结束这场伊朗战争。

cues.en: Yes, I will fight to end these chaotic tariffs because they are decimating markets, killing farmers, and hurting our rural communities.
cues.zh: 我会努力结束这些混乱的关税；它们摧毁市场、伤害农民，重创我们的农村社区。

cues.en: I am going to the U.S. Senate to fight for a livable wage, because $7.25 is not a livable wage for Iowans.
cues.zh: 我要到参议院争取足以维生的工资，因为七美元二十五美分，根本不足以让艾奥瓦人维持生活。

cues.en: I am going to the Senate to fight for affordable housing, to drive private equity out of housing,
cues.zh: 我要争取负担得起的住房，让私募股权资本退出住房领域，

cues.en: Out of healthcare, and out of nursing homes.
cues.zh: 退出医疗，退出养老院。

cues.en: I'm going up there to fight for affordable and accessible health care because I believe that health care is a human right and a part of that human right is also women's Reproductive freedom.
cues.zh: 我要争取人人用得上、付得起的医疗服务，因为我相信，医疗是一项人权，而这项人权也包括女性的生育自主权。

cues.en: I'm also going up to the US Senate to fight for affordable and accessible prescription drugs because far too often as I've traveled this state I've heard over and over this month
cues.zh: 我要争取负担得起、获得得到的处方药；走遍这个州时，我一再听见人们说，这个月，

cues.en: It's either taking my pills or paying my bills that is wrong in the richest country on earth.
cues.zh: 不是吃药，就是付账单；在世上最富有的国家，这不应该发生。

cues.en: And I'm going to the US Senate to fight for our public schools because I believe public money belongs in our public schools.
cues.zh: 我要为公立学校而战，因为我相信，公共资金就应该用于公立学校。

cues.en: I am going up to the United States Senate to pass a farm bill and a farm bill for small family farmers in rural communities,
cues.zh: 我要推动一部农业法案，一部服务农村社区和小型家庭农场的法案，

cues.en: Not just Big Ag.
cues.zh: 而不只是服务大型农业企业。

cues.en: And I am going to fight and address the cancer crisis because it is wrong that Iowa leads the nation in cancer.
cues.zh: 我要应对癌症危机，因为艾奥瓦在癌症问题上位居全国前列，是不应该的。

cues.en: And I'm going to fight to address the root cause of that cancer crisis, which is our water quality crisis.
cues.zh: 我要解决这场癌症危机的根源，也就是我们的水质危机。

cues.en: Every Iowan deserves when they turn on their tap to ensure that their water is not giving them cancer.
cues.zh: 每一个艾奥瓦人打开水龙头时，都应当能够确信，这水不会让自己患上癌症。

cues.en: And maybe most importantly, I am going up to DC to end the corruption that we are seeing on both sides of the aisle.
cues.zh: 也许最重要的是，我要到华盛顿结束我们在两党都看到的腐败。

cues.en: We need to have campaign finance reform.
cues.zh: 我们需要竞选资金改革。

cues.en: And I am going to DC to overturn Citizens United because in Iowa, Elon Musk does not decide our elections.
cues.zh: 我要到华盛顿推翻“联合公民案”判决，因为在艾奥瓦，选举不是由埃隆·马斯克决定。

cues.en: Iowans do and we proved it tonight.
cues.zh: 而是由艾奥瓦人决定，今晚我们已经证明了。

cues.en: I also want to fight for ethics reforms, term limits, banning members of Congress from owning and trading stocks.
cues.zh: 我还要争取道德规范改革、任期限制，禁止国会议员持有和交易股票。

cues.en: And I want to pass a bill to mandate members of Congress to have at least one in-person town hall annually because members of Congress should be accountable to the people,
cues.zh: 我要推动立法，要求国会议员每年至少举行一次面对面的市民大会，因为议员应当向人民负责，

cues.en: To the constituents, not just to their donors and lobbyists.
cues.zh: 向选民负责，而不只是向捐款人和说客负责。

cues.en: This is what I'm going to the United States Senate to fight for.
cues.zh: 这就是我要去美国参议院争取的东西。

cues.en: All of you.
cues.zh: 为了你们所有人。

cues.en: 15 months ago, we launched this campaign because we believed that Iowa deserved representation in the Senate, a senator who works for the people of Iowa.
cues.zh: 十五个月前，我们开始这场竞选，因为我们相信，艾奥瓦值得拥有一位真正为人民工作的参议员。

cues.en: So, we began our push for change.
cues.zh: 于是，我们开始推动改变。

cues.en: The beginning of this, they said we were crazy.
cues.zh: 刚开始，他们说我们疯了。

cues.en: They said winning a state that Trump had won by 13 points was impossible.
cues.zh: 他们说，不可能赢下一个特朗普曾领先十三个百分点的州。

cues.en: That running against someone like Ashley Hinson with her corporate PAC friends and super PAC allies was impossible.
cues.zh: 不可能打败阿什莉·欣森，以及她的企业政治行动委员会朋友和超级政治行动委员会盟友。

cues.en: But I've heard the impossible my whole life.
cues.zh: 但我这一生，一直在听别人说“不可能”。

cues.en: Doctors told me and my parents it was impossible for me to live a fulfilled life after I was born with spina bifida.
cues.zh: 我出生时患有脊柱裂，医生告诉我和父母，我不可能过上充实的人生。

cues.en: Proved them wrong then.
cues.zh: 那一次，我证明他们错了。

cues.en: They told me it was impossible to win gold medals after I was cut from the US national team six straight times.
cues.zh: 当我连续六次被美国国家队淘汰时，他们说我不可能拿到金牌。

cues.en: Proved them wrong then.
cues.zh: 那一次，我证明他们错了。

cues.en: They told me it was impossible to win my western Iowa district as a Democrat.
cues.zh: 他们说，民主党人不可能赢下我所在的艾奥瓦西部选区。

cues.en: Well, we proved them wrong then.
cues.zh: 那一次，我们证明他们错了。

cues.en: And they told me it was impossible to win this Senate race.
cues.zh: 他们说，不可能赢下这场参议员竞选。

cues.en: But tonight, Iowa, we have once again proved that the impossible is possible.
cues.zh: 但今晚，艾奥瓦，我们再次证明：不可能，也能成为可能。

cues.en: I spent the last 448 days crisscrossing this beautiful state, going to all 99 counties, urban areas, rural areas,
cues.zh: 过去四百四十八天，我走遍这个美丽州的全部九十九个县，城市、乡村，

cues.en: NASCAR tracks, county fairs, RAGBRAI, tailgates, small family farms, health clinics, rural pharmacies, meeting people wherever they are.
cues.zh: 赛车赛道、县集市、环艾奥瓦自行车骑行活动、赛前聚会、家庭农场、诊所、乡村药房；人在哪里，我就去哪里。

cues.en: And wherever I went, I heard the same thing.
cues.zh: 无论走到哪儿，我听到的都是同样的话。

cues.en: They would say, "Josh, I'm struggling just to keep food on the table, keep a roof above my head,
cues.zh: 人们说：“乔希，我正努力维持一家人的吃饭、居住，

cues.en: Pay my electric bill, and with this war in Iran, I'm struggling just to keep gas in my tank."
cues.zh: 努力付电费；因为这场伊朗战争，我连给油箱加油都快负担不起。”

cues.en: Over those 448 days, I heard a lot of hurting.
cues.zh: 那四百四十八天，我听到了许多痛苦。

cues.en: But I also heard a lot of hope.
cues.zh: 但我也听到了许多希望。

cues.en: Hope that change was coming.
cues.zh: 希望改变即将到来。

cues.en: Hope that we'd find our way back to the Iowa I grew up in, where you could afford to go to your doctor and where you were proud to send your kids
cues.zh: 希望我们能找回我成长时的艾奥瓦：你看得起医生，也能自豪地把孩子送进

cues.en: To some of the nation's best public schools.
cues.zh: 全国最好的公立学校之一。

cues.en: And tonight, we have done it.
cues.zh: 而今晚，我们做到了。

cues.en: All along I have said that Iowa was the center of the political universe.
cues.zh: 我一直说，艾奥瓦是美国政治的中心。

cues.en: And man, did we prove that true tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们确实证明了这一点。

cues.en: Not only our victory here tonight, but Rob's victory, Sarah's victory, Lindsay's victory, Christina's victory that has been made crystal clear.
cues.zh: 不只是我们这里的胜利，还有罗布、萨拉、林赛和克里斯蒂娜的胜利；这一点已经再清楚不过。

cues.en: We have changed the state of Iowa tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们改变了艾奥瓦。

cues.en: Rob Sand is going to be a tremendous governor.
cues.zh: 罗布·桑德会是一位出色的州长。

cues.en: He will undo the privatization of Medicaid and strengthen our public schools.
cues.zh: 他会扭转医疗补助私有化，强化我们的公立学校。

cues.en: So every Iowan has the opportunity to receive a world-class education right here in Iowa.
cues.zh: 让每一个艾奥瓦孩子，都有机会在家乡接受世界一流的教育。

cues.en: And I am so excited to join these three amazing women, Lindsay, Christina, and Sarah.
cues.zh: 我非常期待与这三位出色的女性一同工作：林赛、克里斯蒂娜和萨拉。

cues.en: They will be excellent representation who will fight for the people of Iowa.
cues.zh: 她们会成为为艾奥瓦人民奋斗的优秀代表。

cues.en: And I look forward to serving alongside these amazing women to fight for Iowans.
cues.zh: 我期待与她们并肩，为艾奥瓦人民而战。

cues.en: So now Iowa, let us be the city on a hill.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦，让我们成为那座“山巅之城”。

cues.en: The Iowa that we grew up in that was the envy of the nation.
cues.zh: 找回我们成长时、曾让全国羡慕的艾奥瓦。

cues.en: Where a mom and a dad don't have to work two to three jobs just to keep food on the table and gas in the tank.
cues.zh: 父母不必打两三份工，才能让家人吃饱、给车加油。

cues.en: Where our farmers can afford to keep working the land their grandfathers did.
cues.zh: 农民能够继续耕耘祖辈留下的土地。

cues.en: And where every Iowa child has access to world-class education.
cues.zh: 每一个艾奥瓦孩子，都能接受世界一流的教育。

cues.en: Where we fix our broken health care system.
cues.zh: 我们将修复失灵的医疗体系。

cues.en: So where you live doesn't determine if you live, where our young people want to and can afford to stay in Iowa,
cues.zh: 让你的住处不再决定你的生死；让年轻人愿意、也负担得起留在艾奥瓦，

cues.en: Have a family, buy a house, and start a life.
cues.zh: 成家、买房，开始自己的人生。

cues.en: Iowa, this is where our comeback begins.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦，我们的复兴将从这里开始。

cues.en: Let us do it together.
cues.zh: 让我们携手去做。

cues.en: Like what Abraham Lincoln said, guided by the better angels of our nature and do what is right for Iowa and Iowans.
cues.zh: 正如亚伯拉罕·林肯所说，让人性中善良的天使指引我们，为艾奥瓦人民做正确的事。

cues.en: Whether you voted for me today or not, I will always fight for Iowa and Iowans and I pledge to be a senator for all of you,
cues.zh: 无论你今天是否投票给我，我都会为艾奥瓦和艾奥瓦人奋斗；我承诺做所有人的参议员，

cues.en: Regardless of political affiliation.
cues.zh: 无论党派归属。

cues.en: My political North Star has always been about what is best for the people, not about party.
cues.zh: 我的政治方向，始终以人民的最大利益为准绳，而非党派。

cues.en: What is best for our working families, our small family farms, and our small businesses.
cues.zh: 以劳动家庭、家庭农场和小企业的最大利益为准绳。

cues.en: And I will always be accountable to you, the people.
cues.zh: 我将始终向你们，向人民负责。

cues.en: Since I began this, I've been saying that it's going to be something beautifully poetic that the man who is coming to get Senator Harkin's seat back is only there because of
cues.zh: 从竞选开始，我就说过，这将是多么有诗意的一幕：那个夺回哈金参议员席位的人，之所以能走到这里，正因为

cues.en: The work that he did in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 哈金当年在参议院所做的工作。

cues.en: I would love for Senator Harkin to join me up here on the stage for a moment.
cues.zh: 我想邀请哈金参议员，到台上来和我站一会儿。

cues.en: I know that for far too long DC has been broken, that the Senate has been broken, but but I believe to my core that the United States Senate is the single
cues.zh: 我知道，华盛顿、参议院失灵已经太久；但我打心底相信，美国参议院是推动社会改变最

cues.en: Greatest vehicle to make societal change.
cues.zh: 有力的工具。

cues.en: And I believe that ability for a a good senator to change lives.
cues.zh: 我相信，一个好参议员有能力改变人的生命。

cues.en: I've seen it because one senator changed mine.
cues.zh: 我亲眼见过，因为就有一位参议员改变了我的人生。

cues.en: When I was 11 years old, when I was 11 years old, disabled boy living in Council Bluffs Iowa,
cues.zh: 十一岁时，我是一个住在艾奥瓦康瑟尔布拉夫斯的残障男孩，

cues.en: The great Tom Harkin changed my life and gave me and so many other disabled Americans an on-ramp to society.
cues.zh: 伟大的汤姆·哈金改变了我的人生，为我和许多其他美国残障人士铺就了融入社会的道路。

cues.en: Had it not been for this man who represents the epitome of what is good and what is good in public service,
cues.zh: 如果没有这位体现了善、体现了公共服务最高品质的人，

cues.en: My life would have looked very very different.
cues.zh: 我的人生会非常、非常不同。

cues.en: One one senator's ability to work across the aisle and pass good public policy changed my life.
cues.zh: 一位参议员跨党派合作、通过良好公共政策的能力，就改变了我的人生。

cues.en: And for 30 years, he represented Iowa and fought for the working class, the small businesses, the small family farms.
cues.zh: 三十年里，他代表艾奥瓦，为劳动者、小企业和家庭农场奋斗。

cues.en: He fought for the little guy, the same people I am fighting for, those that cannot afford to make a political donation.
cues.zh: 他为普通人而战；也正是我现在要为之奋斗的人，那些连政治捐款都负担不起的人。

cues.en: Thank you, sir.
cues.zh: 先生，谢谢您。

cues.en: For 448 days, I have said it is going to be beautifully poetic when the man who takes back Senator Harkin's seat is only there because of his work.
cues.zh: 四百四十八天来，我一直说：那个夺回哈金参议员席位的人，正是因为他的工作才走到这里，这将是多么有诗意。

cues.en: Well, Iowa, tonight we made history, and we wrote beautiful poetry.
cues.zh: 而今晚，艾奥瓦，我们创造了历史，也写下了美丽的诗篇。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Now, can everyone in my family come join me?
cues.zh: 现在，我的家人都可以上台来吗？

cues.en: I would like to bring my family up here.
cues.zh: 我想请家人一起上来。

cues.en: You got a big family.
cues.zh: 你家人可真多。

cues.en: I got a big family and a tall family.
cues.zh: 我有一个大家庭，而且大家都很高。

cues.en: So to each and every person that knocked doors, made phone calls, donated money, put up a sign,
cues.zh: 感谢每一个敲门、打电话、捐款、竖起支持标牌的人，

cues.en: And most importantly entrusted me with your vote.
cues.zh: 最重要的，感谢每一个用选票把信任托付给我的人。

cues.en: Genuinely, thank you.
cues.zh: 发自内心地，谢谢你们。

cues.en: I want to thank everyone that has supported me.
cues.zh: 我想感谢每一个支持过我的人。

cues.en: To my wife, my family, my friends.
cues.zh: 我的妻子、家人、朋友。

cues.en: Thank you all for your support and thank you all for believing in me.
cues.zh: 感谢你们的支持，也感谢你们相信我。

cues.en: To my staff, our volunteers who put their lives on pause because they believed in what we were doing.
cues.zh: 我的工作人员、志愿者，因为相信我们所做的事，而暂停了自己的生活。

cues.en: From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
cues.zh: 我从心底感谢你们。

cues.en: Tonight, Iowa, we have done something truly historic, and I am proud to be your senator elect.
cues.zh: 今晚，艾奥瓦，我们做了一件真正具有历史意义的事；我为成为你们的候任参议员而自豪。

cues.en: And now the real work begins.
cues.zh: 现在，真正的工作开始了。

cues.en: And together we are going to change this state and change our country.
cues.zh: 我们将一起改变这个州，改变我们的国家。

cues.en: God bless Iowa.
cues.zh: 愿上帝保佑艾奥瓦。

cues.en: God bless you all.
cues.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们所有人。

cues.en: And God bless the greatest country on the earth, United States of America.
cues.zh: 愿上帝保佑世界上最伟大的国家，美利坚合众国。

cues.en: Thank you all.
cues.zh: 感谢大家。

cues.en: Thanks everybody.
cues.zh: 谢谢各位。

cues.en: USA.
cues.zh: 美国！

speaker: Juliana Stratton
role: 伊利诺伊州 · 候任参议员
title: Juliana Stratton addresses supporters after winning Illinois’ open U.S. Senate seat

cues.en: So, how we feeling, Illinois?
cues.zh: 伊利诺伊州，大家感觉怎么样？

cues.en: Oh, can we just take a second to take it all in?
cues.zh: 我们能不能花一点时间，感受眼前这一刻？

cues.en: Love you back.
cues.zh: 我也爱你们。

cues.en: Illinois, I wish that you could see the view that I see from up here tonight.
cues.zh: 伊利诺伊，我真希望你们能看到，今晚我从台上看到的景象。

cues.en: I see a room full of familiar faces, friends old and new, loved ones from every stage of my life,
cues.zh: 满屋熟悉的面孔，新老朋友，生命中每个阶段的亲人，

cues.en: People that have been by my side since day one.
cues.zh: 以及从第一天起就站在我身旁的人。

cues.en: Look at the people standing beside you.
cues.zh: 看看站在你旁边的人。

cues.en: We are making history and this is the team that made it possible.
cues.zh: 我们正在创造历史，而这就是让历史成为可能的团队。

cues.en: Now, if you've seen me on the campaign trail, you probably heard me reference an African proverb that I love.
cues.zh: 在竞选路上见过我的人，可能听过我引用一句我很喜欢的非洲谚语。

cues.en: It says, "If you want to go fast, go alone.
cues.zh: 它说：“想走得快，就独自走。

cues.en: If you want to go far, go together."
cues.zh: 想走得远，就一起走。”

cues.en: Well, Illinois, look how far we've come.
cues.zh: 伊利诺伊，看看我们已经走了多远。

cues.en: And we did it together.
cues.zh: 而我们是一起做到的。

cues.en: Together we did what so many told us was impossible.
cues.zh: 一起做到许多人曾说不可能的事。

cues.en: Together we built a movement that reached every corner of this state.
cues.zh: 一起建立了一场遍及全州每个角落的运动。

cues.en: Together we showed that we can center a campaign on the people, not the powerful.
cues.zh: 一起证明，一场竞选可以以人民、而非权贵为中心。

cues.en: And together we made it clear that Illinois is not going backwards.
cues.zh: 一起明确表示：伊利诺伊不会倒退。

cues.en: No.
cues.zh: 绝不会。

cues.en: Let me tell you something about this campaign.
cues.zh: 让我告诉你们，这场竞选的一些事。

cues.en: It was never supposed to be easy and it wasn't.
cues.zh: 它从一开始就不可能轻松，事实也确实如此。

cues.en: There were low lows, and days when we needed to dig deep.
cues.zh: 我们有过低谷，有过必须拼尽最后力气的日子。

cues.en: None of us could have walked this path alone.
cues.zh: 没有人能够独自走完这条路。

cues.en: But, we linked arms.
cues.zh: 但我们挽起了手臂。

cues.en: We leaned on one another, and together, we have not only won this seat, but we have won it decisively.
cues.zh: 我们彼此依靠；最终，我们不仅赢得这个席位，而且赢得干脆、赢得明确。

cues.en: We did that.
cues.zh: 我们做到了。

cues.en: So, tonight, I'm really here to celebrate each and every one of you.
cues.zh: 所以今晚，我来到这里，是为你们每一个人庆祝。

cues.en: This campaign wasn't mine, it was ours, and this victory belongs to all of us.
cues.zh: 这不是我一个人的竞选，而是我们的竞选；这场胜利，属于所有人。

cues.en: I owe a debt of gratitude to so many of you.
cues.zh: 我欠你们许多人一份深深的感谢。

cues.en: First and foremost, I want to give honor to God, who makes all things possible.
cues.zh: 首先，我要荣耀上帝，是他让一切皆有可能。

cues.en: Thank you, God, for instilling us with a righteous fight, and for walking with us on this path.
cues.zh: 感谢上帝，赋予我们正义的斗志，并与我们一路同行。

cues.en: To my campaign manager, [name unclear], And my amazing campaign team, Tyler, Allison, Marguerite, Morgan, Nicole, Alexis, Anna Lee,
cues.zh: 感谢我的竞选经理[姓名听不清]，以及出色的竞选团队：泰勒、艾莉森、玛格丽特、摩根、妮科尔、亚历克西斯、安娜莉，

cues.en: Charles, Daniel, Fiona, Zena, and Reverend Stan.
cues.zh: 查尔斯、丹尼尔、菲奥娜、泽娜，以及斯坦牧师。

cues.en: Thank you for bringing your all each and every day.
cues.zh: 感谢你们每一天都全力以赴。

cues.en: You are truly the A-team, and I've been so blessed to be on this journey with you.
cues.zh: 你们是真正的王牌团队，能与你们同行，是我的福分。

cues.en: To the team at Magnify Strategies, Caitlin, Paul, Aaron, Emily, and Leah.
cues.zh: 感谢 Magnify Strategies 团队：凯特琳、保罗、亚伦、埃米莉和莉娅。

cues.en: And to Katie Langenfeld and Associates.
cues.zh: 感谢凯蒂·兰根费尔德及其团队。

cues.en: And everyone who has supported me along the way, including my chief of staff Natashia Scott and the entire office of the Lieutenant Governor.
cues.zh: 感谢一路支持我的每一个人，包括办公厅主任娜塔莎·斯科特，以及副州长办公室全体同事。

cues.en: I could not have done this without each and every one of you.
cues.zh: 没有你们每一个人，我做不到这一切。

cues.en: To my incredible friends, every person who volunteered, who endorsed me, who showed up any and every time you were called upon,
cues.zh: 感谢我了不起的朋友，感谢每一个做志愿者、给予支持，以及每次受到召唤就出现的人，

cues.en: You lifted me up and pushed me forward when I needed it the most.
cues.zh: 在我最需要的时候，你们扶起我，推着我向前。

cues.en: You believed in this campaign even on days when the path ahead wasn't clear.
cues.zh: 即使前路不明，你们仍相信这场竞选。

cues.en: To Senator Durbin and Senator Duckworth, thank you for your kind and inspirational words tonight.
cues.zh: 感谢德宾参议员、达克沃思参议员，今晚给予温暖而鼓舞人心的讲话。

cues.en: I cannot wait to join our incredible soon-to-be senior senator Tammy Duckworth in Washington.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待要去华盛顿，与即将成为本州资深参议员的塔米·达克沃思一起工作。

cues.en: And it's truly humbling that the people of Illinois have entrusted me to succeed a true public servant and personal hero of mine,
cues.zh: 伊利诺伊人民托付我，在美国参议院接替一位真正的公仆、我个人心中的英雄，

cues.en: Senator Dick Durbin, in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 迪克·德宾参议员，这让我倍感谦卑。

cues.en: And of course, to my family, my husband Brian, my rock, my person, my greatest source of strength,
cues.zh: 当然，还要感谢家人，感谢丈夫布赖恩；我的磐石、我的伴侣、我最大的力量来源，

cues.en: Who didn't just support me on this journey, but every day encouraged me, prayed over me, bolstered me up and shouldered the burden with me.
cues.zh: 你不仅支持这段旅程，还每天鼓励我、为我祈祷、给我力量，与我一起承担重担。

cues.en: I love you so much.
cues.zh: 我非常爱你。

cues.en: To my brilliant and beautiful daughters, Tyler, Cassidy, Ryan, McKenzie, you are the reason why I fight.
cues.zh: 感谢我聪明、美丽的女儿们：泰勒、卡西迪、赖恩、麦肯齐。你们是我奋斗的原因。

cues.en: You are my greatest joy and out of every title I could possibly hold, it is the greatest honor of my life to have the title mom.
cues.zh: 你们是我最大的快乐；在我能拥有的所有头衔中，“妈妈”是我一生最珍惜的荣誉。

cues.en: I love you back.
cues.zh: 我也爱你们。

cues.en: To my parents who are smiling down on us tonight and who have been looking over my shoulder every single day.
cues.zh: 感谢我的父母，他们今晚正在天上微笑着看着我们，每一天都在守望我。

cues.en: Thank you for paving the way.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们，为我铺平道路。

cues.en: I lost my mom Velma the day before I launched my first campaign for state representative after caring for her during her battle with Alzheimer's.
cues.zh: 在我第一次宣布竞选州众议员的前一天，母亲维尔玛去世了；此前，我一直照顾着与阿尔茨海默病抗争的她。

cues.en: And I lost my dad Henry last November in the middle of this campaign.
cues.zh: 去年十一月，在这场竞选进行之中，父亲亨利也去世了。

cues.en: There were moments over the past 2 years when I wished more than anything that I could just pick up the phone and hear them on the other side.
cues.zh: 过去两年，有些时刻，我无比渴望拿起电话，就能再次听见他们的声音。

cues.en: But in a way I have because their voices, their stories, and everything that they poured into me,
cues.zh: 但某种意义上，我确实听见了：他们的声音、故事，以及倾注给我的一切，

cues.en: Their love, their faith, their commitment to service have been woven into the DNA of this campaign since the very start.
cues.zh: 他们的爱、信仰、服务他人的承诺，从一开始就融入了这场竞选的血脉。

cues.en: My mother, a public school teacher, taught me to believe in the power of education and opportunity.
cues.zh: 母亲是公立学校教师，她教会我相信教育和机会的力量。

cues.en: My father, a Navy veteran who marched from Selma to Montgomery in 1965, taught me that when you see an injustice,
cues.zh: 父亲是海军退伍军人，一九六五年曾参加从塞尔玛到蒙哥马利的游行。他教会我：看到不公，

cues.en: You have a responsibility to do something about it.
cues.zh: 就有责任采取行动。

cues.en: And I know that they are so proud because tonight we sent a message loud and clear for them to hear all the way in Washington, D.C.
cues.zh: 我知道，他们会无比自豪，因为今晚，我们发出的信息如此响亮，连华盛顿都能听见，连首都都能听见。

cues.en: That this seat belongs to the people of Illinois.
cues.zh: 这个席位，属于伊利诺伊人民。

cues.en: Listen, 2 months from now, when I walk into the United States capitol, I intend to remember exactly who sent me there,
cues.zh: 两个月后，当我走进美国国会大厦，我会清楚记得，是谁把我送到那里，

cues.en: Each and every one of you.
cues.zh: 是你们每一个人。

cues.en: I'll remember the people who looked me in the eye and trusted me to bring their voices to Washington.
cues.zh: 我会记得那些直视我的眼睛、信任我能把他们的声音带到华盛顿的人。

cues.en: I'll remember the people who shared their fears, their hopes, their struggles, and their dreams.
cues.zh: 记得那些与我分享恐惧、希望、挣扎与梦想的人。

cues.en: Over the course of this campaign, I met people who reminded me why this work matters, who reminded me what truly makes a democracy.
cues.zh: 竞选中，我遇到许多人，让我想起这份工作为什么重要，什么才真正构成民主。

cues.en: You see, democracy is not about Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 民主，不是唐纳德·特朗普。

cues.en: It's not about Congress.
cues.zh: 不是国会。

cues.en: It's not any one politician, one political party, or one seat in the Senate.
cues.zh: 不是某个政客、某个政党，或参议院中的一个席位。

cues.en: Democracy isn't something that we sit back and watch.
cues.zh: 民主，不是我们坐着旁观的东西。

cues.en: Democracy is something we do.
cues.zh: 民主，是我们亲手实践的事情。

cues.en: It's something we build brick by brick, conversation by conversation, neighbor by neighbor.
cues.zh: 是我们一砖一瓦、一次次交谈、一个个邻里地建立起来的东西。

cues.en: It's Angel who brought his grandparents to vote for the very first time after they became naturalized citizens.
cues.zh: 是安赫尔，在祖父母入籍后，带他们第一次去投票。

cues.en: It's Ms. Williams who served our country and now spends every day serving her community, making sure her neighbors have the resources they need to thrive.
cues.zh: 是威廉姆斯女士，曾服务国家，如今每天服务社区，确保邻居获得生活发展所需的资源。

cues.en: It's the mom with the whistle making sure every child in her neighborhood gets home from school safely.
cues.zh: 是那个拿着哨子、确保街区每个孩子都能安全放学回家的母亲。

cues.en: It's the student fellows who organized their campuses and made sure that young people had a seat at the table in this campaign.
cues.zh: 是那些在校园组织同学、确保年轻人在这场竞选中拥有一席之地的学生。

cues.en: It's the pastors I met in Carbondale, the healthcare providers in Peoria, the caregivers in Chicago, the small business owners in Edwardsville,
cues.zh: 是我在卡本代尔遇见的牧师、皮奥里亚的医护人员、芝加哥的照护者、爱德华兹维尔的小企业主，

cues.en: The farmers in Abingdon.
cues.zh: 阿宾登的农民。

cues.en: I'll never forget those moments or those people.
cues.zh: 我永远不会忘记那些时刻、那些人。

cues.en: The people who make up the rich fabric of this great state, who make me proud to be an Illinoisan,
cues.zh: 他们织成这个伟大州丰富的生活图景，让我为身为伊利诺伊人而骄傲，

cues.en: And who reminded me that democracy is alive wherever neighbors refuse to give up on each other.
cues.zh: 也提醒我：只要邻里不放弃彼此，民主就活着。

cues.en: They reminded me that democracy is also the joy we found along the way.
cues.zh: 他们提醒我，民主也是我们沿途发现的快乐。

cues.en: The recognition that we're in this together, the hope that we will wake up tomorrow feeling just a little bit lighter.
cues.zh: 是明白我们同舟共济，是期待明天醒来，心头能稍微轻松一些。

cues.en: The reminder that from chaos can come community and coalition and change.
cues.zh: 是记住：混乱之中，也能生出社区、联盟和改变。

cues.en: And yes, for me joy is also lacing up a pair of roller skates or making it clear that your next United States Senator is in fact a house head who loves To dance.
cues.zh: 对我来说，快乐也可以是系好轮滑鞋，或让大家知道，你们下一任美国参议员，其实是一位热爱跳舞的浩室音乐迷。

cues.en: Listen, there's a lot to be scared about.
cues.zh: 眼下，确实有很多令人害怕的事。

cues.en: There's a lot to be angry about, but joy is resistance.
cues.zh: 有很多令人愤怒的事，但快乐本身就是抵抗。

cues.en: And I believe in my soul that the joy that I have the world didn't give it.
cues.zh: 我发自灵魂深处地相信：我的快乐，不是这个世界赐予的。

cues.en: So, the world can't take it away.
cues.zh: 所以，这个世界也夺不走。

cues.en: We can never let anyone steal our joy from us.
cues.zh: 我们永远不能让任何人偷走自己的快乐。

cues.en: Because if we want to be ready for the fight ahead we're going to need that joy and we're going to need the strength that we find in one another.
cues.zh: 要准备好面对前方的斗争，我们需要这份快乐，也需要从彼此身上汲取的力量。

cues.en: For 2 years we've been hard at work organizing and showing up nonstop.
cues.zh: 两年来，我们努力组织、不断行动，从不停歇。

cues.en: But this campaign was never about election day.
cues.zh: 但这场竞选从来不只关乎选举日。

cues.en: It's about every day that comes after because now we get to work.
cues.zh: 它关乎此后的每一天，因为现在，我们要开始工作了。

cues.en: Since day one of this campaign you've told me that the status quo isn't working.
cues.zh: 从竞选第一天起，你们就告诉我，现状行不通。

cues.en: Some months you're wondering whether you can afford groceries, rent, and child care without having to choose which bill goes unpaid.
cues.zh: 有些月份，你们不知道能否同时支付食品、房租和托育，而不必拖欠某一张账单。

cues.en: Despite working full-time and doing everything right, you're still wondering if you can actually get ahead.
cues.zh: 即使全职工作、做对所有该做的事，你们仍在怀疑，自己到底能否过上更好的生活。

cues.en: You're watching the chaos and the dysfunction coming out of Washington and asking whose side are they on?
cues.zh: 你们看着华盛顿的混乱与失能，问：他们究竟站在哪一边？

cues.en: None of it is by accident.
cues.zh: 这一切，都不是偶然。

cues.en: The corruption in Washington is directly connected to the struggles people face around their kitchen tables.
cues.zh: 华盛顿的腐败，与人们家中餐桌旁面对的生活困境，直接相连。

cues.en: Working families have been left to pick up the tab for the wealthy and well-connected, while the crook in the oval office enriches himself and his allies.
cues.zh: 劳动家庭被迫替富人和权贵买单，而椭圆形办公室里的骗子，却让自己和盟友不断致富。

cues.en: And then those same corrupt politicians have the nerve to tell people to be patient.
cues.zh: 随后，那些腐败政客居然还有脸叫人民耐心等候。

cues.en: Well, I'm here to tell you that we are done waiting.
cues.zh: 而我要告诉你们：我们不再等了。

cues.en: When I became a state representative in 2017, people told me, "Don't ruffle too many feathers.
cues.zh: 二〇一七年，我成为州众议员时，人们对我说：“别得罪太多人。

cues.en: Don't make too many waves.
cues.zh: 别掀起太大风浪。

cues.en: You're a freshman.
cues.zh: 你还是新人。

cues.en: Sit back.
cues.zh: 先坐在后面。

cues.en: Just learn."
cues.zh: 好好学着。”

cues.en: Well, I ignored that advice then.
cues.zh: 当时，我没有听从这些建议。

cues.en: And I certainly won't be sitting back and listening quietly when I get to Washington, D.C.
cues.zh: 到了华盛顿，我当然更不会坐在后面，安静地听着。

cues.en: I'm going to fight loudly for affordable health care, for reproductive freedom, for workers' rights, for voting rights,
cues.zh: 我会大声争取负担得起的医疗、生育自主权、劳动者权利和投票权，

cues.en: And for the families who are doing everything right and still struggling to get ahead.
cues.zh: 也会为那些做对一切、却仍在艰难谋生的家庭而战。

cues.en: I'm going to fight boldly for our farmers, our caregivers, our small businesses, our public schools, our immigrant communities,
cues.zh: 我会勇敢地为农民、照护者、小企业、公立学校、移民社区，

cues.en: And the next generation of Illinoisans who deserve the opportunity to build a good life right here at home.
cues.zh: 以及下一代伊利诺伊人而战；他们值得在家乡拥有建立美好生活的机会。

cues.en: And I'm going to fight compassionately for each and every one of you, including including those who didn't vote for me.
cues.zh: 我会心怀同理，为你们每一个人奋斗，也包括没有投票给我的人。

cues.en: Never forget this.
cues.zh: 永远不要忘记。

cues.en: There is more that unites us than divides us.
cues.zh: 让我们团结的东西，远多于使我们分裂的东西。

cues.en: We are united in our struggles, and we can be united in our solutions, too.
cues.zh: 我们有共同的困境，也能一起找到共同的解决办法。

cues.en: And when I'm voting in the Senate, it will be on behalf of all 12.8 million Illinoisans who I have been given the privilege of representing.
cues.zh: 在参议院投票时，我将代表我有幸服务的全部一千二百八十万伊利诺伊人。

cues.en: Now, I can't promise that we're going to agree on everything, but I can promise that I will never stop listening,
cues.zh: 我无法保证我们在每件事上都意见一致，但我保证，我永远不会停止倾听，

cues.en: Never stop showing up, and never stop fighting for you.
cues.zh: 不会停止出现，更不会停止为你们奋斗。

cues.en: And I will never confuse being elected with being entitled to this job.
cues.zh: 我绝不会把“当选”，误当成自己理所当然拥有这份工作。

cues.en: I'm headed to Washington to do the people's business.
cues.zh: 我去华盛顿，是为了处理人民的事务。

cues.en: Your business.
cues.zh: 你们的事务。

cues.en: So, I ask you to hold me accountable.
cues.zh: 所以，请你们监督我，要求我负责。

cues.en: You knocked on doors to get me here.
cues.zh: 你们敲门，把我送到这里。

cues.en: You can knock on my door to make sure I'm doing the job.
cues.zh: 你们也可以敲我的门，确保我在好好工作。

cues.en: You made calls for my campaign.
cues.zh: 你们为我的竞选打过电话。

cues.en: You can call my office.
cues.zh: 你们也可以给我的办公室打电话。

cues.en: You can tell me when we're getting it right and when we're getting it wrong.
cues.zh: 告诉我，哪些事做对了，哪些事做错了。

cues.en: You can challenge me.
cues.zh: 你们可以质疑我。

cues.en: You can push me because, like I said, this seat belongs to you.
cues.zh: 可以督促我，因为正如我所说，这个席位属于你们。

cues.en: Senator Durbin reminded me last week that it was this very seat that Abraham Lincoln and Stephen Douglas debated for.
cues.zh: 德宾参议员上周提醒我，亚伯拉罕·林肯和斯蒂芬·道格拉斯，当年争夺的正是这个席位。

cues.en: And those debates boiled down to one issue, slavery.
cues.zh: 那些辩论归结起来，关乎一个问题：奴隶制。

cues.en: That debate set into motion a chain of events that would lead Lincoln to become president and one day issue the Emancipation Proclamation,
cues.zh: 那场辩论引发了一连串事件，最终让林肯成为总统，并有一天颁布《解放奴隶宣言》，

cues.en: Freeing my great-great-grandfather, William Stevens, allowing him and his brother to build a town in Mississippi.
cues.zh: 解放了我的高祖父威廉·史蒂文斯，让他和兄弟得以在密西西比州建立一个小镇。

cues.en: And enabling his great-great-granddaughter to become the first black lieutenant governor of Illinois.
cues.zh: 也让他的玄孙女，得以成为伊利诺伊州第一位黑人副州长。

cues.en: And now now the seat where the future of slavery was once debated will be held by a descendant of someone who was enslaved.
cues.zh: 而如今，这个曾经辩论奴隶制未来的席位，将由一位被奴役者的后代担任。

cues.en: That progress was possible because people not only believed that things could change but demanded that they did.
cues.zh: 这样的进步之所以可能，是因为人们不仅相信事情能改变，更要求改变真正发生。

cues.en: It was possible because of the courage of people who refused to accept the limits placed on them because of the relentless work to ensure that the next generation would go further
cues.zh: 因为人们勇敢地拒绝接受强加在自己身上的限制，坚持不懈地努力，确保下一代能够走得更远，

cues.en: Than the last.
cues.zh: 超越上一代。

cues.en: I don't take the history of this seat lightly because I know that I did not get here alone.
cues.zh: 我不会轻视这个席位的历史，因为我知道，自己绝非独自走到这里。

cues.en: I stand on the shoulders of William Stevens who built a town and a future.
cues.zh: 我站在威廉·史蒂文斯的肩膀上；他建设了一个小镇，也建设了一个未来。

cues.en: I stand on the shoulders of Velma, who taught, and Henry, who marched.
cues.zh: 站在教书的维尔玛、参加游行的亨利的肩膀上。

cues.en: I stand on the shoulders of Carol Moseley Braun.
cues.zh: 站在卡罗尔·莫斯利·布劳恩的肩膀上。

cues.en: Who overcame all the odds.
cues.zh: 她克服了重重艰难。

cues.en: I stand on the shoulders of everyone who came before me, who fought for opportunities they would never live to see.
cues.zh: 站在所有先行者的肩膀上；他们为那些自己一生都无法亲见的机会而奋斗。

cues.en: And look how far we've come together.
cues.zh: 看看我们一起，已经走了多远。

cues.en: That is the promise of America.
cues.zh: 这就是美国的承诺。

cues.en: That is the promise of democracy and that is the promise we have to keep honoring every single day.
cues.zh: 这就是民主的承诺，是我们必须每一天继续兑现的承诺。

cues.en: Illinois our story is far from finished.
cues.zh: 伊利诺伊，我们的故事还远没有结束。

cues.en: And our chapters are still ahead.
cues.zh: 新的篇章，还在前方。

cues.en: We have each other.
cues.zh: 我们拥有彼此。

cues.en: We have our voices.
cues.zh: 我们拥有自己的声音。

cues.en: We have our joy.
cues.zh: 我们拥有自己的快乐。

cues.en: And we have a sacred responsibility to make tomorrow better than today.
cues.zh: 我们也肩负神圣的责任，让明天比今天更好。

cues.en: So, let's get to work.
cues.zh: 所以，让我们开始工作。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: God bless you.
cues.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们。

cues.en: And God bless Illinois.
cues.zh: 愿上帝保佑伊利诺伊州。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Now, Connie and I and our family were uh standing backstage and somebody walked up and I got to say, "Governor Acton."
cues.zh: 刚才，康妮、我和家人站在后台，有人走过来，我就不得不喊她，“阿克顿州长！”

cues.en: I actually called her Governor Acton during all these rallies, one-on-one, because I knew she was going to win.
cues.zh: 事实上，在这些集会私下见面时，我一直都叫她“阿克顿州长”，因为我知道她会赢。

cues.en: But still calling her Governor Acton after she speaks to all of you.
cues.zh: 但在她刚刚向大家讲话之后，真的这样称呼她，感觉还是不同。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: This is your victory.
cues.zh: 这是你们的胜利。

cues.en: Corporations, billionaires tried to buy this election.
cues.zh: 大公司、亿万富翁，曾试图买下这场选举。

cues.en: You know that.
cues.zh: 你们都知道。

cues.en: But as it turns out, as it turns out, there are a whole lot more of us than there are of them.
cues.zh: 但事实证明，我们的人数，远远多于他们。

cues.en: This campaign, this election are about you, the people who make our state and our country work.
cues.zh: 这场竞选、这场选举，关乎你们，关乎让这个州和这个国家运转起来的人。

cues.en: Maybe maybe you put groceries back at the register when you see the total ticking up and up.
cues.zh: 也许你在收银台看着总价不断上涨，只好把买好的食品放回去。

cues.en: Maybe your anxiety spikes as you drive up to the gas station wondering how much you are going to have to pay this week for gas.
cues.zh: 也许你每次开进加油站，就焦虑起来，不知道这个星期又得花多少钱加油。

cues.en: You work hard every single day and you work.
cues.zh: 你每天辛勤工作，一直工作。

cues.en: So often you feel like it's never enough to afford groceries, to afford health care and gas and utilities, Everything.
cues.zh: 却常常觉得，无论如何都不够支付食品、医疗、汽油、水电，以及一切生活开支。

cues.en: Your work, your talent, your ingenuity, your determination, your work ethic power our state and fuel our country.
cues.zh: 你们的劳动、才华、创造力、决心与勤劳，推动着这个州，支撑着整个国家。

cues.en: And the only reason that corporations are making billions and billions in profit, the only reason is because of you.
cues.zh: 那些公司之所以能赚取数十亿、上百亿的利润，唯一的原因，就是你们。

cues.en: We've not had an economy and we've not had a government that works for you, that fights for you until now.
cues.zh: 过去，我们没有一个真正为你们工作、为你们奋斗的经济体制与政府；但从现在起，不同了。

cues.en: You sent an undeniable message tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚，你们发出了无法否认的信息。

cues.en: Ohio is not for sale.
cues.zh: 俄亥俄州，绝不出售。

cues.en: Ohio Ohio Ohio is not giving up on the dream of this country.
cues.zh: 俄亥俄州没有放弃这个国家的梦想。

cues.en: That we're a place where anyone who works hard can get ahead.
cues.zh: 那就是：只要努力工作，任何人都能够出人头地。

cues.en: That what matters is not your wealth.
cues.zh: 真正重要的，不是财富。

cues.en: It is not your connections.
cues.zh: 不是关系。

cues.en: It's not your last name.
cues.zh: 不是你的姓氏。

cues.en: It's not the circumstances of your birth.
cues.zh: 不是你的出身。

cues.en: It's your ingenuity.
cues.zh: 而是你的创造力。

cues.en: It's your talent.
cues.zh: 你的才华。

cues.en: It's your Yes.
cues.zh: 是你的——没错。

cues.en: It's your work ethic.
cues.zh: 是你勤恳工作的精神。

cues.en: Our our government should work for you, for Ohio, for the American people, not just the wealthy, not just the well-connected.
cues.zh: 我们的政府，应该为你们、为俄亥俄、为美国人民工作，而不只是为富人和权贵。

cues.en: That is what we voted for today.
cues.zh: 这就是我们今天投票所支持的东西。

cues.en: It's why It's why one of the first things I'm going to do in in the Senate is ban members of Congress from trading stocks.
cues.zh: 因此，回到参议院后，我首先要做的事情之一，就是禁止国会议员交易股票。

cues.en: And you all know how corruption is woven into everything.
cues.zh: 你们知道，腐败如何渗透到方方面面。

cues.en: Working people pay for this corruption.
cues.zh: 而为腐败买单的，是劳动人民。

cues.en: Higher utility bills, higher grocery prices, higher drug prices.
cues.zh: 更高的水电账单、更贵的食品、更高的药价。

cues.en: Starting today, Ohioans have a senator who puts working people first.
cues.zh: 从今天起，俄亥俄人民拥有了一位将劳动者放在第一位的参议员。

cues.en: Ohioans voted for change because we all know the system is rigged.
cues.zh: 俄亥俄人投票要求改变，因为大家都知道，这套体制被操纵了。

cues.en: And my pledge to all Ohioans, whether you voted for me or you didn't, is that I will always be on your side.
cues.zh: 我向所有俄亥俄人承诺：无论你有没有投票给我，我都会始终站在你们这一边。

cues.en: Always.
cues.zh: 始终如此。

cues.en: I do not work for the utility companies.
cues.zh: 我不为公用事业公司工作。

cues.en: I do not work for data centers.
cues.zh: 不为数据中心工作。

cues.en: I do not work for Wall Street.
cues.zh: 不为华尔街工作。

cues.en: I work for you.
cues.zh: 我为你们工作。

cues.en: I work for Ohio.
cues.zh: 我为俄亥俄工作。

cues.en: So, we will fight to end these tariffs.
cues.zh: 所以，我们将努力结束这些关税。

cues.en: We will end this war.
cues.zh: 我们将结束这场战争。

cues.en: We will fight to lower your costs and increase your paychecks and open up paths to the middle class.
cues.zh: 我们将努力降低你们的生活成本、提高你们的工资，为更多人打开通往中产阶层的道路。

cues.en: And as I have always done, I will take on anyone who stands in the way.
cues.zh: 正如我一直所做的，我会挑战任何挡在前面的人。

cues.en: Because when you love this state, when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work.
cues.zh: 因为热爱这个州、热爱这个国家，就应该为那些让它运转的人奋斗。

cues.en: So, I want to take a few want to take a moment to thank a few people.
cues.zh: 现在，我想花一点时间，感谢一些人。

cues.en: I mean, all of you I look through this crowd and I you showed up.
cues.zh: 也就是你们所有人。我看着这满屋的人，你们来了。

cues.en: You all got off the sidelines.
cues.zh: 你们走下了观望的看台。

cues.en: You showed up.
cues.zh: 你们站了出来。

cues.en: You fought like hell.
cues.zh: 你们全力以赴地奋战。

cues.en: You've made such a difference.
cues.zh: 你们带来了如此巨大的改变。

cues.en: And you're the reason that Amy and I and so many that were were on the ticket this year have been successful.
cues.zh: 艾米、我，以及今年名单上的许多候选人之所以成功，正是因为你们。

cues.en: So, thank you.
cues.zh: 所以，谢谢你们。

cues.en: I want to thank the union staff at the Hilton serving us tonight.
cues.zh: 我要感谢今晚在希尔顿酒店为我们服务的工会工作人员。

cues.en: Thank you for the work you do.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们所做的工作。

cues.en: I want to thank the law enforcement officers keeping us safe today and every day.
cues.zh: 感谢今天，以及每一天守护我们安全的执法人员。

cues.en: Thank you for your sacrifices and for your public service.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们的牺牲与公共服务。

cues.en: Now, let me talk about my family for a moment on stage with me, Connie Schultz.
cues.zh: 现在说说我的家人。和我一起站在台上的，是康妮·舒尔茨。

cues.en: Wonderful, wonderful wife, wonderful mother.
cues.zh: 一位出色的妻子，一位出色的母亲。

cues.en: Wonderful grandmother and oh yeah, one of the most talented and best writers in the nation Over the last two years,
cues.zh: 一位出色的祖母；当然，也是全国最有才华、最优秀的作家之一。过去两年，

cues.en: And you have seen it, Connie inspired all of us pretty much every day with her fierce belief in hope.
cues.zh: 你们都看到了，康妮几乎每天都用她对希望的坚定信念激励我们。

cues.en: Connie often quotes the author Nick Cave: an optimist with a broken heart.
cues.zh: 她常引用作家尼克·凯夫的话：一个心碎了，却依然乐观的人。

cues.en: And that's um I you know go back a long time and go back a short time think about two years when all of us began this journey to to fix this
cues.zh: 这让我想到过去，想到两年前，我们所有人一起踏上修复这个州的旅程，

cues.en: State and fix this country.
cues.zh: 也修复这个国家。

cues.en: And there wasn't a lot of hope from a lot of people but there's a whole lot of hope from people I know in this crowd and from Connie.
cues.zh: 那时，很多人没有多少希望；但我知道，这间屋子里有很多人，还有康妮，始终怀有巨大的希望。

cues.en: So thank you.
cues.zh: 所以，谢谢。

cues.en: Our children and our grandchildren are here.
cues.zh: 我们的孩子和孙辈们都在这里。

cues.en: And bear with me, there are a lot of them as you can see.
cues.zh: 请容我多说一会儿，你们看，人确实不少。

cues.en: Um, Emily, Elizabeth, Caitlyn, Andy, Stina, Alejandro, Matt, Clayton, Leo, Jackie, Carolyn, Ella, Milo, Russell, Marbel.
cues.zh: 埃米莉、伊丽莎白、凯特琳、安迪、斯蒂娜、亚历杭德罗、马特、克莱顿、利奥、杰姬、卡罗琳、埃拉、迈洛、拉塞尔、马贝尔。

cues.en: How lucky we are.
cues.zh: 我们何其幸运。

cues.en: You know, I hate I'm going to acknowledge something.
cues.zh: 我要承认一件事，虽然我不太想承认。

cues.en: And I shouldn't, but I have all the grandchildren's names on the teleprompter only because you just never know.
cues.zh: 我本不该这样，但提词器上确实写着所有孙辈的名字，因为谁知道呢。

cues.en: I'm a little nervous.
cues.zh: 我有一点紧张。

cues.en: I don't do this kind of speech very often.
cues.zh: 毕竟，我不是经常发表这种讲话。

cues.en: If I left out one of them, you know the price that Connie and I would pay.
cues.zh: 如果漏掉其中一个，你们知道，康妮和我会付出怎样的代价。

cues.en: So, right, Carol.
cues.zh: 对吧，卡罗尔？

cues.en: Especially if it were Jackie or Carol.
cues.zh: 尤其如果漏掉的是杰姬或卡罗尔。

cues.en: And I want to talk about our extended family all throughout this room.
cues.zh: 我也想说说，今晚遍布这间屋子的另一个大家庭。

cues.en: All the staff on this campaign who gave everything to this cause and I mean everything.
cues.zh: 这场竞选中为共同事业付出一切的工作人员；我说的是一切。

cues.en: The commitment they had, the hours they worked over the last two years and all of the staff who gave so much to the state for years before that.
cues.zh: 过去两年他们的投入、他们工作的无数小时，以及在此前多年里同样为这个州倾尽心力的所有工作人员。

cues.en: So many of you are here tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚，你们很多人都在这里。

cues.en: It says so much.
cues.zh: 这本身就说明了很多。

cues.en: All the staff, come join us on stage.
cues.zh: 所有工作人员，请一起上台来。

cues.en: And as they join us, it includes the some of them came uh were in my office before when I was in Washington or were the previous campaign.
cues.zh: 正在走上来的这些人中，有些曾在我的华盛顿办公室工作，有些参与过过去的竞选。

cues.en: Uh many of them came from elsewhere now and so many of them traveled here tonight to be part of this for me to thank and for us to thank them.
cues.zh: 还有很多人后来从其他地方加入；今晚，许多人特地赶来，让我、让我们有机会感谢他们。

cues.en: So keep on coming.
cues.zh: 继续往上来。

cues.en: They're still coming.
cues.zh: 他们还在上来。

cues.en: Sorry.
cues.zh: 抱歉。

cues.en: I didn't know it was going to take this long.
cues.zh: 我不知道要花这么久。

cues.en: Sorry.
cues.zh: 抱歉。

cues.en: Everybody up.
cues.zh: 大家都上来。

cues.en: Ann, come on.
cues.zh: 安，来吧。

cues.en: Ann, I can move down.
cues.zh: 安，我可以往下站一点。

cues.en: Just up.
cues.zh: 上来就好。

cues.en: Tomorrow the work begins.
cues.zh: 明天，工作开始。

cues.en: Thank you, Ohio.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，俄亥俄州。

subtitleType: 校订英文 / 中文翻译（听不清处已标注）

speaker: Rob Sand
role: 艾奥瓦州 · 候任州长
title: 'Thank you, Iowa': Rob Sand delivers victory speech after winning race for Iowa governor

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。

cues.en: Iowa.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦州。

cues.en: I love you, Iowa.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦，我爱你们。

cues.en: We have got a family up here of Republicans and Democrats and independents.
cues.zh: 台上这个大家庭，有共和党人、民主党人，也有独立人士。

cues.en: I want to first thank my wife, Christine, and our two boys, Tate and Axel.
cues.zh: 首先，我要感谢妻子克里斯汀，以及我们的两个儿子泰特和阿克塞尔。

cues.en: For your support and for the sacrifices that you shared in our effort.
cues.zh: 感谢你们的支持，以及为了我们的共同努力而作出的牺牲。

cues.en: I couldn't have done it without you.
cues.zh: 没有你们，我做不到这一切。

cues.en: Truly.
cues.zh: 真的。

cues.en: Christine, you've carried [inaudible].
cues.zh: 克里斯汀，你承担了……[此处听不清]。

cues.en: You've offered helpful advice.
cues.zh: 你给了我许多有益的建议。

cues.en: You deserve just as much credit for this as I do.
cues.zh: 这份功劳，你和我一样值得拥有。

cues.en: My parents, my parents, Leslie and Kevin, my sister Jen, my in-laws.
cues.zh: 我的父母莱斯利和凯文，我的姐姐珍，以及我的岳父母。

cues.en: Nix.
cues.zh: 尼克斯。

cues.en: Your help was invaluable in deciding which tie to wear for the third debate.
cues.zh: 你在帮我决定第三场辩论该戴哪条领带这件事上，帮了大忙。

cues.en: Thank you for that.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Really appreciate that, Augie.
cues.zh: 真的很感谢你，奥吉。

cues.en: Thank you for being my [inaudible].
cues.zh: 谢谢你做我的……[此处听不清]。

cues.en: And most importantly, Walter, rest in peace.
cues.zh: 还有最重要的，沃尔特，愿你安息。

cues.en: The energy and the excitement that he brought to the campaign was irreplaceable.
cues.zh: 他为这场竞选带来的活力与激情，无可替代。

cues.en: Christine said something profound the other day.
cues.zh: 克里斯汀前几天说了一句很深刻的话。

cues.en: She had been bracing for a difficult October, and yet everything that we imagined it would be was nothing compared to how hard it has been losing Walter.
cues.zh: 她原本已准备好面对艰难的十月，但我们想象中的一切困难，都远远比不上失去沃尔特的痛苦。

cues.en: There are countless other family members and friends who have been with me every step of the way.
cues.zh: 还有无数亲朋好友，在每一步都陪伴着我。

cues.en: It has been a long 18 months on the campaign trail, and I could not have gotten here without your support.
cues.zh: 竞选路上的这十八个月很漫长；没有你们的支持，我走不到这里。

cues.en: You know who you are.
cues.zh: 你们知道我说的是谁。

cues.en: Thank you to my running mate and Iowa's next lieutenant governor, Dave Muhlbauer.
cues.zh: 感谢我的竞选搭档，艾奥瓦下一任副州长，戴夫·米尔鲍尔。

cues.en: We love Dave, don't we?
cues.zh: 我们爱戴夫，对不对？

cues.en: Love this guy.
cues.zh: 我喜欢这个人。

cues.en: When I asked him to join the ticket, we were actually at his mom's house with his mom.
cues.zh: 当我邀请他加入竞选搭档时，我们其实正和他的母亲一起，在她家里。

cues.en: I looked around the house and I could tell that he had the same kind of upbringing that I did.
cues.zh: 我环顾那间房子，就知道他的成长环境和我很像。

cues.en: Raised by good people with good values.
cues.zh: 都是由善良、拥有良好价值观的人抚养长大。

cues.en: Same kinds of sayings on the wall, same kinds of decoration.
cues.zh: 墙上挂着相似的箴言，家里有着相似的装饰。

cues.en: And I have got to say, anyone who can get elected in a county that goes 75 percent for the other party in the race for president has to be a peacemaker
cues.zh: 我得说，一个人在总统选举中有百分之七十五选民支持另一党的县里，还能胜选，他一定是一个善于促成和解的人，

cues.en: And a public servant.
cues.zh: 一个真正的公仆。

cues.en: Amen for that.
cues.zh: 为此说一声“阿门”。

cues.en: Literally.
cues.zh: 我是认真的。

cues.en: No wonder why we had multiple Republican elected officials who endorsed me just because I picked Dave.
cues.zh: 难怪好几位共和党民选官员，仅仅因为我选择了戴夫，就支持了我。

cues.en: I had not talked to them.
cues.zh: 我没有跟他们谈过。

cues.en: I had not called them.
cues.zh: 没有给他们打过电话。

cues.en: I had not asked for their endorsement.
cues.zh: 也没有要求他们背书。

cues.en: They just saw that I picked Dave Muhlbauer, and they were like, well, me too, then.
cues.zh: 他们只是看到我选了戴夫·米尔鲍尔，就说：“那我也支持。”

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是啊。

cues.en: So we got a good one here.
cues.zh: 所以，我们找到了一位好搭档。

cues.en: Iowa, a really good one.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦，是一位非常好的搭档。

cues.en: He brings along a great family, too.
cues.zh: 他还带来了一个很棒的家庭。

cues.en: Thank you to Linda as well and the kids for letting Dave help me get here today.
cues.zh: 也感谢琳达和孩子们，让戴夫能够帮助我走到今天。

cues.en: Very excited for our partnership ahead and to have his work ethic especially added to serve Iowans.
cues.zh: 我非常期待今后的合作，尤其期待以他勤恳的工作精神，一起服务艾奥瓦人民。

cues.en: To Republican and independent public endorsers of this campaign: for your courage and for your leadership.
cues.zh: 感谢那些公开支持这场竞选的共和党人和独立人士，感谢你们的勇气和领导力。

cues.en: Genuinely.
cues.zh: 发自内心地感谢。

cues.en: We do live in a broken, two-choice political system where it requires real listening to learn that a candidate who is in the other party does not see you as the enemy.
cues.zh: 我们确实生活在一个失灵的、只有两种党派选择的政治体系中；只有认真倾听，才能明白另一党的候选人并没有把你视作敌人。

cues.en: You listened.
cues.zh: 你们选择了倾听。

cues.en: You knew that you would receive some negative reaction for endorsing across party lines.
cues.zh: 你们知道，跨党派支持会招来一些负面反应。

cues.en: But you knew that the angriest ones are the loudest, and you knew that you were willing to stand publicly on principle to support returning our state to balanced government.
cues.zh: 但你们也知道，最愤怒的人往往声音最大；你们仍愿意公开坚持原则，支持让这个州重新拥有相互制衡的政府。

cues.en: We have to have bigger hearts and minds than just our party.
cues.zh: 我们的胸襟与视野，必须超越自己的党派。

cues.en: And everyone who did that across party lines with a public endorsement showed that.
cues.zh: 每一个跨越党派、公开表达支持的人，都证明了这一点。

cues.en: And we thank you for it.
cues.zh: 我们为此感谢你们。

cues.en: To Iowa Democrats: you have had a hard few years here in Iowa.
cues.zh: 艾奥瓦的民主党人，过去几年，你们过得很艰难。

cues.en: But balanced government has been restored.
cues.zh: 但现在，相互制衡的政府恢复了。

cues.en: You stayed strong.
cues.zh: 你们坚持住了。

cues.en: You worked hard.
cues.zh: 你们付出了努力。

cues.en: So many of you feel what I feel about the divisiveness of our political system.
cues.zh: 很多人和我一样，感受到我们政治体制中的严重分裂。

cues.en: And you were excited to have somebody as a candidate in your party who was actually talking about that and focusing on it.
cues.zh: 当自己党内终于有一位候选人认真谈论、关注这个问题时，你们感到振奋。

cues.en: But even among those of you who do not like that part as much, well, the vast majority of you understood that the smallest party has to appeal to reasonable-minded people in
cues.zh: 即使有些人不那么认同这部分主张，绝大多数人仍明白：一个规模最小的政党，必须争取其他党派中愿意理性思考的人，

cues.en: Other parties if it wants to build a coalition that reaches a majority.
cues.zh: 才能建立获得多数支持的联盟。

cues.en: Because of all of us coming together, in January no Iowan has to fear their government anymore.
cues.zh: 因为大家团结起来，到一月，任何艾奥瓦人都不必再害怕自己的政府。

cues.en: To those who did not vote for me, I am going to listen to you and serve you just the same.
cues.zh: 对于没有投票给我的人，我同样会倾听你们、为你们服务。

cues.en: I hope you already know that I had senior leaders in the auditor's office who were an independent and a Republican who had made campaign contributions to my opponent in 2018.
cues.zh: 希望你们知道：在审计长办公室，我曾任用一位独立人士，以及一位在二〇一八年向我的对手捐过竞选款的共和党人担任高级领导。

cues.en: I am going to continue a similar approach.
cues.zh: 我会继续采取类似的做法。

cues.en: I hope, if you see me out and about in our state — I mean, I am going to be out and about,
cues.zh: 如果你们在州内各处遇到我——我确实会常常到各地去，

cues.en: And I know that there are plenty of Iowans who did not vote for me.
cues.zh: 我知道，有很多艾奥瓦人没有投票给我。

cues.en: So you are going to see me out and about.
cues.zh: 所以，你们会在各地见到我。

cues.en: I hope that you stop me.
cues.zh: 我希望你们叫住我。

cues.en: I hope you introduce yourself, and I hope you kindly tell me why you did not vote for me.
cues.zh: 希望你们介绍自己，也希望你们友善地告诉我，为什么没有投票给我。

cues.en: I hope you also keep an open mind, because you are going to get to know me better over the next four years,
cues.zh: 也希望你们保持开放的心态，因为接下来四年，你们会更加了解我，

cues.en: And maybe you will feel differently the next time.
cues.zh: 也许下一次，你们就会有不同的看法。

cues.en: Bottom line is this: again, for the folks who did not vote for me, I am going to work just as hard for you as I do for anyone else.
cues.zh: 归根结底，对于没有投票给我的人，我会和为其他任何人一样，全力为你们工作。

cues.en: Thank you also for voting and for being a part.
cues.zh: 也感谢你们投票，感谢你们参与其中。

cues.en: Appreciate that.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们。

cues.en: Now, given that we are here tonight, Democrats and independents and Republicans together, as we did at 200 town halls and countless rallies across this state,
cues.zh: 今晚，民主党人、独立人士和共和党人齐聚这里，就像我们在全州两百场市民大会和无数集会中那样，

cues.en: Who is going to start us in singing America the Beautiful?
cues.zh: 谁来带领我们唱《美丽的阿美利加》？

cues.en: You know what?
cues.zh: 你们知道吗？

cues.en: Hold on.
cues.zh: 等一下。

cues.en: We did not have anybody go yet, right?
cues.zh: 还没有人开始，对吧？

cues.en: All right, I am going to step aside.
cues.zh: 好，我先让到一旁。

cues.en: And just so that we have a clear note and one person who we can all join in,
cues.zh: 为了有一个清楚的起音，让大家能跟着一个人一起唱，

cues.en: Virginia will start us off.
cues.zh: 就请弗吉尼娅带我们开头。
