speaker: Jon Ossoff
role: 佐治亚州 · 连任参议员
title: Sen. Jon Ossoff (D-GA) Full Victory Speech

cues.en: Hello Atlanta!
cues.zh: 你好亚特兰大！

cues.en: Thank you Georgia.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们，佐治亚州的人民。

cues.en: Georgia, you did it.
cues.zh: 佐治亚州，你们做到了。

cues.en: And let me be the first to offer public congratulations to the governor-elect of the state of Georgia, Keisha Lance Bottoms.
cues.zh: 让我第一个向佐治亚州当选州长表示公开祝贺，凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯。

cues.en: To every volunteer who poured your heart and soul into this effort and everyone who chipped in so we could face down
cues.zh: 感谢每一位全心全意投入的志愿者，也感谢每一位捐款的人，让我们能够直面

cues.en: The dark money super PACs, thank you.
cues.zh: 那些以黑钱支持的超级政治行动委员会。谢谢你们。

cues.en: To Charlie Bailey and his crew at the strongest Democratic Party of Georgia in a generation, Thank you.
cues.zh: 对于查理·贝利（Charlie Bailey）和他的团队，佐治亚州一代人中最强大的民主党，谢谢你。

cues.en: To my staff, to Ellen and Keenan and Ray and Miriam and Chandra and the best team in American politics, Thank you.
cues.zh: 我的工作人员，艾伦、基南、雷、米里亚姆、钱德拉以及美国政界最好的团队，谢谢你。

cues.en: To my wonderful wife Alisha and my daughters Eva and Lyla, my parents and my entire family,
cues.zh: 感谢我出色的妻子艾丽莎、我的女儿伊娃和莱拉、我的父母和我的整个家庭，

cues.en: Thank you for your unconditional love and support.
cues.zh: 感谢您无条件的喜爱和支持。

cues.en: And to the people of the great state of Georgia for the trust you've invested in me to continue representing you in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 感谢伟大的佐治亚州人民对我的信任，让我继续在美国代表你们州参议院。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Now, Georgia Thank you.
cues.zh: 现在，佐治亚州，谢谢你。

cues.en: I love you, too.
cues.zh: 我也爱你。

cues.en: And listen, in sweeping and decisive victories, the American people have rebuked the depravity,
cues.zh: 听着，美国人民在全面而决定性的胜利中谴责了这种堕落，

cues.en: Corruption, and incompetence of the failed lame-duck President Donald J.
cues.zh: 失败的跛脚鸭总统唐纳德·J·特朗普的腐败和无能。

cues.en: Trump.
cues.zh: 特朗普。

cues.en: And if at times these last 2 years, amidst the ceaseless onslaught of brutality and indecency,
cues.zh: 如果在过去的两年里，有时在残酷和不雅的不断袭击中，

cues.en: You doubted whether our republic would survive, let tonight's results give you courage that the first light of dawn is on the horizon.
cues.zh: 你怀疑我们的共和国能否生存，让今晚的结果给你勇气，黎明的第一缕曙光即将出现。

cues.en: But remember that in living rooms and backyards and at rallies across Georgia these last 2 years,
cues.zh: 但请记住，在过去的两年里，在佐治亚州的客厅、后院以及集会上，

cues.en: Together we've affirmed that our task is not just to contain one president's wickedness,
cues.zh: 我们共同确认，我们的任务不仅仅是遏制一位总统的邪恶，

cues.en: But to heal the brokenness beneath.
cues.zh: 而是为了治愈内心的破碎。

cues.en: That this moment is an opening not for restoration, but for reformation.
cues.zh: 这一刻不是恢复的机会，而是改革的机会。

cues.en: And so amidst our celebration tonight, we must acknowledge that the underlying crisis gripping our republic remains and that therefore our most vital work Lies ahead.
cues.zh: 因此，在今晚的庆祝活动中，我们必须承认，困扰我们共和国的根本危机仍然存在，因此我们最重要的工作就在前方。

cues.en: Because while the wealthy and well-lobbied feast on inside information and official favors,
cues.zh: 因为虽然富人和游说广泛的人享受内幕信息和官方恩惠，

cues.en: America's forgotten families are treated to systemic corporate disrespect and official indifference, working harder and harder while the treadmill just gets faster and steeper
cues.zh: 美国被遗忘的家庭面临着系统性的企业不尊重和官方的冷漠，他们工作越来越努力，而跑步机却变得越来越快、越来越陡。

cues.en: And the bills get higher and higher.
cues.zh: 而且账单越来越高。

cues.en: Instead of reading your daughter her favorite book, that precious spare hour after work,
cues.zh: 与其在下班后宝贵的空闲时间里给女儿读她最喜欢的书，

cues.en: You're on the phone begging the insurance company to cover the medicine that prevents her seizures.
cues.zh: 您在电话中恳求保险公司支付预防她癫痫发作的药物费用。

cues.en: You report the black mold to your landlord who doesn't fix the leak and the ambulance for your toddler's asthma attack is followed by A $3,000 bill.
cues.zh: 你向房东反映家里长了黑霉，房东却不修漏水处；幼儿哮喘发作，叫来救护车后又收到一张三千美元的账单。

cues.en: For too many home ownership's a fantasy.
cues.zh: 对于太多人来说，拥有住房只是一个幻想。

cues.en: Family farms face ruin and while health care's never cost more, plastics invade our bodies,
cues.zh: 家庭农场面临毁灭，虽然医疗保健成本从未如此高，但塑料侵入我们的身体，

cues.en: Blood and breast milk, toxic forever chemicals taint half the country's drinking water and polluters have been granted fresh license to poison our air.
cues.zh: 血液和母乳、永远有毒的化学物质污染了该国一半的饮用水，污染者已获得新的许可证来毒害我们的空气。

cues.en: Abroad.
cues.zh: 国外。

cues.en: American credibility and leadership are in decay and the world is rearming for global conflict.
cues.zh: 美国的信誉和领导力正在衰退，世界正在为全球冲突重新武装。

cues.en: And at our grave peril, humanity is fast forgetting the terrible lessons of two world wars and the Holocaust.
cues.zh: 在我们面临严重危险的情况下，人类正在迅速忘记两次世界大战和大屠杀的可怕教训。

cues.en: Meanwhile, the titans of Silicon Valley dig bunkers for themselves and warn that the artificial intelligence they're creating risks human extinction.
cues.zh: 与此同时，硅谷巨头们为自己挖掘掩体，并警告他们正在创造的人工智能面临着人类灭绝的风险。

cues.en: And amidst these challenges of unprecedented consequence and complexity, though we rightly celebrate tonight's historic victory,
cues.zh: 在这些具有前所未有的后果和复杂性的挑战中，尽管我们正确地庆祝今晚的历史性胜利，

cues.en: The fact is we've been too long mired in a small and selfish politics,
cues.zh: 事实上，我们已经太长时间陷入狭隘自私的政治之中，

cues.en: Bought by big money, unmoored from fixed moral principles, and resigned to intractable division.
cues.zh: 被大笔资金收购，脱离了固定的道德原则，并屈服于棘手的分歧。

cues.en: In other words, the United States has been adrift in a gale.
cues.zh: 换句话说，美国已经在狂风中漂流了。

cues.en: But Georgia, we can and will reclaim control over our own destiny.
cues.zh: 但佐治亚州，我们能够而且将会重新掌控自己的命运。

cues.en: Tonight we've struck a necessary and undeniable blow on behalf of justice and progress.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们为了正义和进步而做出了必要且不可否认的打击。

cues.en: And tonight in Georgia, we've proven not just that unity is possible, but that we can overcome division without sacrificing clarity of purpose.
cues.zh: 今晚在佐治亚州，我们不仅证明了团结是可能的，而且我们可以在不牺牲明确目标的情况下克服分歧。

cues.en: In every corner of Georgia, this campaign urged the necessity of banning corporate and secret money from politics,
cues.zh: 在佐治亚州的每个角落，这场运动敦促必须禁止企业和秘密资金参与政治，

cues.en: Of American leadership for peace and human rights around the world, and of guaranteeing health care for every single American.
cues.zh: 美国在世界各地的和平与人权方面发挥的领导作用，以及保障每一个美国人的医疗保健。

cues.en: We committed to continuing the work of bringing big pharma, big insurance, and big tech to heel in the defense of struggling Georgia families.
cues.zh: 我们致力于继续努力，让大型制药公司、大型保险公司和大型科技公司齐心协力，保护陷入困境的佐治亚州家庭。

cues.en: And on that basis, we built a new majority that extends far beyond party lines.
cues.zh: 在此基础上，我们建立了远远超出党派界限的新多数派。

cues.en: And the foundation for that new majority has been trust.
cues.zh: 新多数的基础是信任。

cues.en: Trust built through years of phone calls to mayors, pastors, and farmers.
cues.zh: 通过多年与市长、牧师和农民的电话建立的信任。

cues.en: And trust measured in problems solved together without concern for ideology or party affiliation.
cues.zh: 信任是通过共同解决问题来衡量的，而不考虑意识形态或党派关系。

cues.en: I thank Republican mayors Matheson, Smith, and Fry of Valdosta, Tifton, and Toccoa,
cues.zh: 我感谢瓦尔多斯塔、蒂夫顿和托科阿的共和党市长马西森、史密斯和弗莱，

cues.en: And the countless other Republican leaders who joined our team.
cues.zh: 还有无数其他加入我们团队的共和党领导人。

cues.en: And I thank the hundreds of thousands of independent and Republican voters who joined our winning coalition.
cues.zh: 我感谢加入我们获胜联盟的数十万独立选民和共和党选民。

cues.en: Never doubt that unity is possible.
cues.zh: 永远不要怀疑团结的可能性。

cues.en: Even in his final months, Congressman Lewis always reminded us that we all live in one American house.
cues.zh: 即使在他的最后几个月，国会议员刘易斯也总是提醒我们，我们都住在一栋美国房子里。

cues.en: Do you remember?
cues.zh: 你是否记得？

cues.en: In one world house.
cues.zh: 在同一个世界的房子里。

cues.en: He called it the inevitable truth that we're all members of one human family.
cues.zh: 他称这是不可避免的事实：我们都是人类大家庭的成员。

cues.en: And I know many of you have poured yourselves into this campaign not for my sake or for the sake of the Democratic Party,
cues.zh: 我知道你们中的许多人投入到这场竞选中并不是为了我，也不是为了民主党，

cues.en: But because you're so deeply troubled by the pain our fellow human beings are enduring right now.
cues.zh: 但因为你对我们人类同胞目前所承受的痛苦深感困扰。

cues.en: The terror of a child watching ICE take away her mother.
cues.zh: 一个孩子看着 ICE 带走她母亲的恐惧。

cues.en: The despair of a cancer patient losing coverage mid-treatment.
cues.zh: 癌症患者在治疗过程中失去保险的绝望。

cues.en: But that ache in your heart, that pit in your stomach, that feeling is what reminds us we're all in this together.
cues.zh: 但你心里的那种疼痛，你胃里的那种痛苦，那种感觉提醒我们我们都在一起。

cues.en: That we're not just one United States, we're one united people.
cues.zh: 我们不仅仅是一个美国，我们还是一个团结的人民。

cues.en: E pluribus unum, out of many, one.
cues.zh: E pluribus unum，众中之一。

cues.en: And over centuries, despite our sins and through courageous struggle, the flame of American freedom has grown brighter and bolder and given hope to The whole world.
cues.zh: 几个世纪以来，尽管我们犯下了罪孽，但通过勇敢的斗争，美国自由的火焰变得更加明亮和大胆，给人类带来了希望。整个世界。

cues.en: We've stumbled.
cues.zh: 我们绊倒了。

cues.en: We almost lost our way.
cues.zh: 我们几乎迷失了方向。

cues.en: But Georgia, for all our troubles, let me assure you tonight that propelled by this historic and undeniable victory,
cues.zh: 但佐治亚州，尽管我们遇到了种种麻烦，今晚让我向你们保证，在这场历史性的、不可否认的胜利的推动下，

cues.en: I have no doubt we will overcome them.
cues.zh: 我毫不怀疑我们会克服它们。

cues.en: And now our task is to reawaken that great national spirit that defeated fascism and established Social Security,
cues.zh: 现在我们的任务是重新唤醒战胜法西斯主义并建立社会保障的伟大民族精神，

cues.en: That put men on the moon and passed civil rights laws in order to meet the challenges and obligations of our time.
cues.zh: 这让人类登上了月球，并通过了民权法，以应对我们这个时代的挑战和义务。

cues.en: Because I refuse to accept that my two little girls will grow up in a world as dark and dangerous and cruel as this
cues.zh: 因为我拒绝接受我的两个小女儿将在一个如此黑暗、危险和残酷的世界中长大

cues.en: One threatens to become.
cues.zh: 一个人有可能成为。

cues.en: I refuse to accept that Eva and Layla will grow up with artificial friends and teachers in a society where the sick die not
cues.zh: 我拒绝接受伊娃和莱拉将在一个病人不死的社会中与人造朋友和老师一起长大

cues.en: Because there's no cure, but because they have no money.
cues.zh: 因为无药可救，但因为他们没有钱。

cues.en: Where we have enough nuclear weapons to destroy the world a thousandfold, but we refuse to guarantee health care for every citizen.
cues.zh: 我们拥有足够的核武器来摧毁世界一千倍，但我们拒绝保证每个公民的医疗保健。

cues.en: On a poisoned planet rearming for World War where human life is cheap and might makes right.
cues.zh: 在一个为世界大战重新武装的有毒星球上，人的生命是廉价的，强权就是正义。

cues.en: See, when Eva is old enough to ask why I let this happen,
cues.zh: 瞧，当伊娃大到可以问我为什么让这种事发生时，

cues.en: I'm determined to answer truthfully that I didn't.
cues.zh: 我决心如实回答我没有。

cues.en: I'll tell her how the same year she turned five, Georgia overcame every doubt and dirty trick not just to win,
cues.zh: 我会告诉她在她五岁那年，佐治亚如何克服一切怀疑和肮脏的伎俩，不仅仅是为了获胜，

cues.en: But to set a new course for our state and our country and our world.
cues.zh: 而是为我们的州、本州和我们的世界设定新的路线。

cues.en: That we defended voting rights and civil rights at home.
cues.zh: 我们在国内捍卫投票权和公民权利。

cues.en: That we restored American leadership toward peace and human rights around the world.
cues.zh: 我们重新发挥了美国的领导作用，推动全世界的和平与人权。

cues.en: That we finally acted to ban corporate money and secret money from our politics.
cues.zh: 我们最终采取行动禁止公司资金和秘密资金参与我们的政治。

cues.en: And that we guaranteed health care for every single American.
cues.zh: 我们保证为每个美国人提供医疗保健。

cues.en: Thank you, Georgia.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，佐治亚州。

cues.en: Tonight we celebrate this victory and tomorrow we get back to work.
cues.zh: 今晚我们庆祝这一胜利，明天我们重新开始工作。

cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 太感谢了。

cues.en: Thank you, Georgia.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，佐治亚州。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

title: Annie Andrews (D-SC) Full Victory Speech

cues.en: I think we just made some history.
cues.zh: 我认为我们刚刚创造了一些历史。

cues.en: So, South Carolina, you have shown the nation what is possible.
cues.zh: 所以，南卡罗来纳州，你们向全国展示了一切皆有可能。

cues.en: Possible.
cues.zh: 可能的。

cues.en: You have shown the nation that in this era of partisan divides, of vitriol and name-calling,
cues.zh: 你们向全国展示了在这个党派分歧、尖酸刻薄和谩骂的时代，

cues.en: In a politics dominated by billionaires and special interest groups and insiders in Washington D.C.
cues.zh: 在华盛顿特区由亿万富翁、特殊利益集团和内部人士主导的政治中

cues.en: That we will not bow down.
cues.zh: 我们不会低头。

cues.en: That we will not back down and we will chart our own course.
cues.zh: 我们不会退缩，我们将制定自己的路线。

cues.en: You have shown the nation that we can come together to defend South Carolina.
cues.zh: 你们向全国展示了我们可以团结起来保卫南卡罗来纳州。

cues.en: And today you have elected a senator that will always put South Carolina first.
cues.zh: 今天，你们选出了一位永远把南卡罗来纳州放在第一位的参议员。

cues.en: Not only that, but you have elected the first pediatrician to the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 不仅如此，您还选举了美国参议院第一位儿科医生。

cues.en: That's right.
cues.zh: 这是正确的。

cues.en: The first woman that South Carolina has ever sent to the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 南卡罗来纳州派往美国参议院的第一位女性议员。

cues.en: So, from the bottom of my heart, thank you.
cues.zh: 所以，我从心底里谢谢你们。

cues.en: I want to start by thanking Darla Graham for her public service and her love for South Carolina,
cues.zh: 首先，我要感谢达拉·格雷厄姆（Darla Graham）的公共服务和对南卡罗来纳州的热爱，

cues.en: And I wish her her family well.
cues.zh: 我祝愿她的家人一切安好。

cues.en: And I just spoke with her and she congratulated me on our victory tonight.
cues.zh: 我刚刚和她交谈过，她祝贺我今晚取得了胜利。

cues.en: And to the heartbeat, the heartbeat of our campaign, our volunteers who worked their tails off and never stopped believing,
cues.zh: 伴随着心跳，我们竞选活动的心跳，我们的志愿者们竭尽全力，从未停止相信，

cues.en: Thank you, thank you, thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢，谢谢，谢谢。

cues.en: And to our state party chairwoman, Crystal Spain, the first black woman to lead our state's party,
cues.zh: 我们的州党主席水晶西班牙，第一位领导我们州党的黑人女性，

cues.en: Who invested in this race, who believed in us, who believed in me and worked tirelessly,
cues.zh: 谁投资了这场比赛，谁相信我们，谁相信我并不知疲倦地工作，

cues.en: Tirelessly to build a stronger South Carolina across all 46 counties.
cues.zh: 不懈地在所有 46 个县建设一个更强大的南卡罗来纳州。

cues.en: Thank you, Crystal.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，水晶。

cues.en: And to my dear friend Jamie Harrison, we would not be here without you.
cues.zh: 我亲爱的朋友杰米·哈里森，如果没有你，我们就不会在这里。

cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 太感谢了。

cues.en: To all of our incredible staff who poured their hearts and souls into this race, Thank you.
cues.zh: 对于我们所有为这场比赛倾注心血的出色工作人员，谢谢你。

cues.en: To the thousands of people who welcomed us into their homes, their churches,
cues.zh: 对于成千上万欢迎我们进入他们的家中、他们的教堂的人们，

cues.en: Their businesses, and onto their front porches, thank you so much.
cues.zh: 他们的生意，以及他们的前廊，非常感谢你们。

cues.en: And to the Republicans, Independents, and Democrats who took a chance on a pediatrician and a mom of three,
cues.zh: 对于那些在儿科医生和三个孩子的母亲身上冒险的共和党人、独立人士和民主党人，

cues.en: Because you believed that South Carolina should come first, thank you.
cues.zh: 因为您认为南卡罗来纳州应该排在第一位，谢谢。

cues.en: South Carolina, my name may have been on the ballot, but this victory doesn't belong to me,
cues.zh: 南卡罗来纳州，我的名字可能出现在选票上，但这场胜利不属于我，

cues.en: It belongs to all of you.
cues.zh: 它属于你们所有人。

cues.en: Because tonight we here in South Carolina sent a clear message that this Senate seat does not belong to one family,
cues.zh: 因为今晚我们在南卡罗来纳州发出了一个明确的信息，即这个参议院席位不属于一个家庭，

cues.en: One party, or to Washington DC.
cues.zh: 一场聚会，或者去华盛顿特区。

cues.en: It belongs to you and it always will.
cues.zh: 它属于你，并且永远属于你。

cues.en: We embarked on this journey over 18 months ago and while it was long and exhausting and there were plenty of days when I
cues.zh: 我们在 18 个月前踏上了这段旅程，虽然漫长而疲惫，但有很多日子我

cues.en: Was running on nothing but protein bars, coffee, and giant Diet Cokes from gas stations,
cues.zh: 除了蛋白质棒、咖啡和加油站的巨型健怡可乐之外，什么都没有，

cues.en: It truly has been the journey of a lifetime.
cues.zh: 这确实是一生难忘的旅程。

cues.en: We took this campaign to every single one of our 46 counties from small towns and main streets to farms and our rural communities
cues.zh: 我们将这一活动推广到 46 个县的每一个县，从小城镇和主要街道到农场和农村社区

cues.en: From the Blue Ridge Mountains in the upstate to the swamps, the literal swamps in the Midlands,
cues.zh: 从北部的蓝岭山脉到沼泽，中部地区名副其实的沼泽，

cues.en: To the beaches here in the Low Country.
cues.zh: 前往低地国家的海滩。

cues.en: I sat on the back of a pickup truck with an eighth generation farmer in Barnwell who told me that it now costs her $1,900.
cues.zh: 我和巴恩韦尔的一位第八代农民坐在一辆皮卡车的后座上，她告诉我现在这让她付出了代价1,900 美元。

cues.en: Y'all, I thought my farmer friend was here.
cues.zh: 你们，我以为我的农民朋友在这里。

cues.en: She told me it cost $1,900 to fill up her tractor with diesel and that tank of gas will only last her for 3 Days.
cues.zh: 她告诉我给她的拖拉机加满柴油要花 1,900 美元，而一箱汽油只能维持她 3 小时天。

cues.en: And that farm that's been in her South Carolina family for eight generations might not last another year or two if things don't change.
cues.zh: 如果情况不改变，那个在她南卡罗来纳州家族经营了八代的农场可能就撑不过一两年了。

cues.en: I've stood shoulder to shoulder with veterans in Ridgeland, tears in their eyes as they told me that they've lost friends to suicide,
cues.zh: 我曾与里奇兰的退伍军人肩并肩站着，当他们告诉我他们因自杀而失去朋友时，他们眼含泪水，

cues.en: That their fight for their benefits that they've earned and their fear of another generation being sent off to a reckless war.
cues.zh: 他们为自己赢得的利益而战，并担心下一代会被送去一场鲁莽的战争。

cues.en: I've spoken to seniors who've worked their entire lives, raised their family, and did everything right,
cues.zh: 我和那些一生工作、养家糊口、做事都正确的老年人交谈过，

cues.en: Only to find themselves struggling to get by on their Social Security checks.
cues.zh: 结果却发现自己靠社会保障支票勉强度日。

cues.en: I've seen neighbors looking out for each other regardless of political party, families coming together to help each other through hard times,
cues.zh: 我看到邻居们无论党派如何都互相关心，家庭成员团结在一起互相帮助度过困难时期，

cues.en: And church congregations opening their hearts and doors to anyone who needs a helping hand.
cues.zh: 教会会众向任何需要帮助的人敞开心扉和大门。

cues.en: This is the South Carolina that I know.
cues.zh: 这就是我所认识的南卡罗来纳州。

cues.en: This is the South Carolina that I am proud to call home.
cues.zh: 这是我自豪地称之为家的南卡罗来纳州。

cues.en: And this is the South Carolina that I will fight for every single day in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 这就是我每天在美国参议院为之奋斗的南卡罗来纳州。

cues.en: And to the South Carolinians who did not vote for me, I know we may not agree on everything,
cues.zh: 对于那些没有投票给我的南卡罗来纳州人，我知道我们可能不会在所有事情上都达成一致，

cues.en: And I may not have earned your vote today, but I want you to know this,
cues.zh: 我今天可能没有赢得你们的投票，但我想让你们知道这一点，

cues.en: I will be your senator too.
cues.zh: 我也将成为你们的参议员。

cues.en: I will listen to you, I will show up for you, and I will fight just as hard for you and your children as
cues.zh: 我会听你的，我会为你出现，我会像你一样为你和你的孩子而努力奋斗

cues.en: I would my own.
cues.zh: 我会自己的。

cues.en: That's the kind of senator that I'll be.
cues.zh: 我就是这样的参议员。

cues.en: I'll be an independent voice who will work with anyone, Republican or Democrat,
cues.zh: 我将成为一个独立的声音，愿意与任何人合作，无论是共和党还是民主党，

cues.en: To do what's right for South Carolina.
cues.zh: 做对南卡罗来纳州有利的事情。

cues.en: I will be a brick wall between Washington D.C.
cues.zh: 我将成为华盛顿特区之间的一堵砖墙

cues.en: And South Carolina, even when it means standing up to my own party.
cues.zh: 还有南卡罗来纳州，即使这意味着要反抗我自己的政党。

cues.en: Nobody in Washington recruited me to run.
cues.zh: 华盛顿没有人招募我参选。

cues.en: Nobody handed me a seat in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 没有人给我在美国参议院的席位。

cues.en: And nobody wrote me a script.
cues.zh: 没有人给我写剧本。

cues.en: I owe no one in Washington anything.
cues.zh: 我不欠华盛顿任何人任何东西。

cues.en: I owe South Carolina everything.
cues.zh: 我欠南卡罗来纳州一切。

cues.en: And that's exactly who I'm going to answer to.
cues.zh: 这正是我要回答的人。

cues.en: Now, I never imagined that I would end up in politics.
cues.zh: 现在，我从未想过我最终会进入政界。

cues.en: Since I was four, I've only ever dreamed of becoming a doctor, and for the past 20 years,
cues.zh: 从四岁起，我就梦想成为一名医生，在过去的 20 年里，

cues.en: I've dedicated my life to caring for sick and injured children.
cues.zh: 我一生致力于照顾生病和受伤的儿童。

cues.en: But what I saw as a pediatrician and what I've experienced raising my own three children made me realize that I couldn't just sit
cues.zh: 但我作为一名儿科医生的所见所闻以及我抚养自己的三个孩子的经历让我意识到我不能只是坐着

cues.en: On the sidelines anymore.
cues.zh: 已经在场边了。

cues.en: I watched as insurance companies stood between sick children and the care that they need.
cues.zh: 我看到保险公司站在生病的孩子和他们需要的护理之间。

cues.en: I've seen how decisions made in Washington affect the lives of the children and families I've cared for.
cues.zh: 我亲眼目睹了华盛顿做出的决定如何影响我所照顾的儿童和家庭的生活。

cues.en: And that's why I decided to run, because I believe we have a responsibility to leave our children something better than what we inherited.
cues.zh: 这就是我决定参选的原因，因为我相信我们有责任给我们的孩子留下比我们继承的更好的东西。

cues.en: A South Carolina where a family can afford to fill up a gas tank,
cues.zh: 南卡罗来纳州，一个家庭有能力加满油箱，

cues.en: Put groceries on the table, and get the child care they need without worrying about going broke.
cues.zh: 将食品杂货放在桌子上，并获得他们所需的儿童保育服务，而不必担心破产。

cues.en: When decisions where decisions about our communities are made by the people who live in our communities,
cues.zh: 当有关我们社区的决定是由居住在我们社区的人们做出时，

cues.en: Not the billionaires or data center companies in Washington DC.
cues.zh: 不是华盛顿特区的亿万富翁或数据中心公司。

cues.en: And where the next generation can afford to build a life and raise a family here.
cues.zh: 下一代有能力在这里建立生活并建立家庭。

cues.en: That's the future that I'm fighting for.
cues.zh: 这就是我为之奋斗的未来。

cues.en: And I know that the work ahead won't be easy, but after 18 months and 46 counties and everything we've been through together,
cues.zh: 我知道未来的工作并不容易，但经过 18 个月、46 个县以及我们共同经历的一切之后，

cues.en: I've never been more certain of one thing.
cues.zh: 我从未如此确定过一件事。

cues.en: South Carolina's best days are still ahead of US.
cues.zh: 南卡罗来纳州最好的日子仍然领先于美国。

cues.en: And I promise you I'm going to give you everything I have to make sure we get there.
cues.zh: 我向你保证，我会为你提供一切，以确保我们能够实现这一目标。

cues.en: To build a South Carolina you can afford, a South Carolina you can always be proud to call home,
cues.zh: 建设一个你买得起的南卡罗来纳州，一个你永远可以自豪地称之为家的南卡罗来纳州，

cues.en: And a South Carolina that will always come first.
cues.zh: 南卡罗来纳州永远是第一位的。

cues.en: So thank you for believing in me.
cues.zh: 所以谢谢你相信我。

cues.en: Thank you for making history with me tonight.
cues.zh: 谢谢你今晚和我一起创造历史。

cues.en: And and most importantly, we had to move this part to the end so I wouldn't be a blubbering idiot up here.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，我们必须把这部分移到最后，这样我就不会在这里成为一个哭泣的白痴。

cues.en: Most importantly, thank you to my family.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，感谢我的家人。

cues.en: To my parents who have stood by me every step of the way.
cues.zh: 感谢我的父母，他们一路支持我。

cues.en: And to my three children.
cues.zh: 还有我的三个孩子。

cues.en: Thank you for every hug, every word of encouragement.
cues.zh: 谢谢你的每一个拥抱，每一句鼓励。

cues.en: I love you more than words Henry than words will ever express.
cues.zh: 我爱你胜过言语，亨利无法用言语表达。

cues.en: I'm so proud of you guys.
cues.zh: 我为你们感到骄傲。

cues.en: And being your mom will always be the most important job I have.
cues.zh: 做你的妈妈永远是我最重要的工作。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: And I hope that when you look back on this moment, all three of you,
cues.zh: 我希望当你们回顾这一刻时，你们三个，

cues.en: I hope that you remember something.
cues.zh: 我希望你能记住一些事情。

cues.en: That you can stand up for what you believe in.
cues.zh: 你可以坚持你所相信的事情。

cues.en: That you can speak out when something isn't right.
cues.zh: 当事情不对时你可以说出来。

cues.en: And no matter how big the challenge, you should never be afraid to try to make things better.
cues.zh: 无论挑战有多大，你都不应该害怕尝试让事情变得更好。

cues.en: Because you never know what's possible if you're willing to try.
cues.zh: 因为你永远不知道如果你愿意尝试的话会发生什么。

cues.en: South Carolina, I love you.
cues.zh: 南卡罗来纳州，我爱你。

cues.en: Thank you and good night.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，晚安。

cues.en: How did this happen?
cues.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

cues.en: So, I want to share with you a little bit about the answer to that question.
cues.zh: 所以，我想与大家分享一下这个问题的答案。

cues.en: So, I want to say first of all that I think the people in Kansas,
cues.zh: 所以，我首先想说的是，我认为堪萨斯州的人们，

cues.en: Republicans, Independents, and Democrats are saying what's happening in Washington is not okay.
cues.zh: 共和党人、独立人士和民主党人都说华盛顿发生的事情不好。

cues.en: I want to list a few things we already know.
cues.zh: 我想列出一些我们已经知道的事情。

cues.en: Of course, a war nobody wanted, tariffs.
cues.zh: 当然，没有人想要一场战争，关税。

cues.en: These two things together have added $250 a month to the cost of the average family in Kansas.
cues.zh: 这两件事加在一起，使堪萨斯州普通家庭每月的开支增加了 250 美元。

cues.en: And you know what?
cues.zh: 你知道吗？

cues.en: There's a whole lot of people in Kansas, hundreds of thousands of people are living paycheck to paycheck,
cues.zh: 堪萨斯州有很多人，成千上万的人靠工资生活，

cues.en: And this is not okay.
cues.zh: 这是不行的。

cues.en: Decisions made in Washington that are hurting people in our own state who are struggling already.
cues.zh: 华盛顿做出的决定正在伤害我们州已经陷入困境的人们。

cues.en: Farmers, businesses, ranchers, every Kansan hurt by the tariffs.
cues.zh: 农民、企业、牧场主，每个堪萨斯人都受到关税的伤害。

cues.en: Then I think about the 60,000 Kansans who a year and a half ago had health insurance,
cues.zh: 然后我想到一年半前有医疗保险的 60,000 名堪萨斯人，

cues.en: They don't have it anymore because of decisions made in Washington, D.C.
cues.zh: 由于华盛顿特区做出的决定，他们不再拥有它了。

cues.en: That is not okay.
cues.zh: 那不行。

cues.en: That's not who we are.
cues.zh: 我们不是这样的人。

cues.en: I think about thousands of children who have been taken off snap benefits,
cues.zh: 我想到了成千上万被取消临时福利的孩子，

cues.en: And I've been to a lot of food pantries across the state of Kansas.
cues.zh: 我去过堪萨斯州的很多食品储藏室。

cues.en: Now, at Resurrection, the church I pastor, we have a food mobile that distributes food free 20 days a month and food deserts Second
cues.zh: 现在，在我牧师的复活教会，我们有一辆食品流动车，每月 20 天免费分发食物，还有第二次食物沙漠

cues.en: Largest source of food in Kansas City for people who struggle after harvesters.
cues.zh: 堪萨斯城为收割机后苦苦挣扎的人们提供的最大食物来源。

cues.en: When you visit these places, they say we don't have enough food for all the people who need it anymore because the cuts that
cues.zh: 当你访问这些地方时，他们会说我们没有足够的食物来满足所有需要的人，因为削减

cues.en: The government made to people who are struggling.
cues.zh: 政府为那些陷入困境的人们做出了贡献。

cues.en: That's not okay.
cues.zh: 那不行。

cues.en: That's not who we are in Kansas.
cues.zh: 那不是我们堪萨斯州的人。

cues.en: But I want to say a few other things.
cues.zh: 但我还想说几句话。

cues.en: Kansans are also fed up with the way politicians divide us.
cues.zh: 堪萨斯人也厌倦了政客分裂我们的方式。

cues.en: Mary in greensburg told me she's in her 70s.
cues.zh: 格林斯堡的玛丽告诉我她已经 70 多岁了。

cues.en: She came up to me when I was there and she said last time I was in Greensburg,
cues.zh: 当我在那儿时，她向我走来，她说上次我在格林斯堡时，

cues.en: By the way, was 15 years ago when I got to deliver a fire truck to them after the tornadoes took theirs out,
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，15 年前，龙卷风摧毁了他们的消防车后，我给他们送了一辆消防车，

cues.en: And our church purchased a fire truck from them.
cues.zh: 我们教会从他们那里购买了一辆消防车。

cues.en: That was such a joy.
cues.zh: 那真是太高兴了。

cues.en: But I want to say I was talking to Mary and she said I'd like my next senator,
cues.zh: 但我想说我正在和玛丽谈话，她说我想要我的下一任参议员，

cues.en: In addition to helping people who are struggling to feed their families and people who don't have health insurance,
cues.zh: 除了帮助那些努力养家糊口的人和没有健康保险的人，

cues.en: I want my next senator to try to help us not to dislike people in the other party.
cues.zh: 我希望我的下一任参议员尽力帮助我们不要讨厌对方的人。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: Our politicians are so divided.
cues.zh: 我们的政客分歧如此之大。

cues.en: She said I have family members I can't talk to anymore.
cues.zh: 她说我不能再和我的家人说话了。

cues.en: I have kids I grew up going to school with who we're no longer friends.
cues.zh: 我有一些从小一起上学的孩子，但我们不再是朋友了。

cues.en: I just want somebody to look at us and to try to bring us together.
cues.zh: 我只是希望有人看着我们并尝试让我们走到一起。

cues.en: Now here's what we need.
cues.zh: 现在这就是我们所需要的。

cues.en: I think Kansas are saying, even deeply red Kansas, Democrats and Republicans are both saying,
cues.zh: 我认为堪萨斯州在说，即使是深红色的堪萨斯州，民主党人和共和党人都在说，

cues.en: Look, the rest of the country on the coast, they look at us as flyover country.
cues.zh: 看，这个国家的其他沿海地区，他们把我们视为立交桥国家。

cues.en: We are not flyover country.
cues.zh: 我们不是立交桥国家。

cues.en: We are the heart of America.
cues.zh: 我们是美国的心脏。

cues.en: That message truly is we are better together than we are divided.
cues.zh: 这个信息确实是我们在一起比分裂更好。

cues.en: I'm going to tell you I'm proud to be a Democrat and proud of all the Democrats who support me,
cues.zh: 我要告诉你，我为自己是一名民主党人感到自豪，并为所有支持我的民主党人感到自豪，

cues.en: Like 97% of them.
cues.zh: 就像他们中97%的人一样。

cues.en: But you know what?
cues.zh: 但你知道吗？

cues.en: Every rally I went to, there were 30 or 40% who were Republicans who came up to me and said,
cues.zh: 我参加的每次集会，都有 30% 或 40% 的共和党人走过来对我说：

cues.en: Look, we're with you.
cues.zh: 看，我们和你在一起。

cues.en: You have our values.
cues.zh: 你有我们的价值观。

cues.en: I'll tell you about I'll tell you one of those guys.
cues.zh: 我会告诉你我会告诉你其中一个人。

cues.en: So a week ago we were in Pittsburg, Kansas, uh Southeast Kansas.
cues.zh: 一周前，我们在堪萨斯州匹兹堡，呃堪萨斯州东南部。

cues.en: And uh they have two world famous chicken places there.
cues.zh: 呃，他们那里有两家世界著名的炸鸡店。

cues.en: There's Chicken Annie's and Chicken Mary's.
cues.zh: 有安妮鸡和玛丽鸡。

cues.en: Chicken Annie's was closed, so I wasn't going to stop there for an appetizer,
cues.zh: Chicken Annie's 关门了，所以我不会在那里停下来吃开胃菜，

cues.en: But we went to Chicken Mary's.
cues.zh: 但我们去了鸡肉玛丽店。

cues.en: Had a great event there.
cues.zh: 那里举办了一场盛大的活动。

cues.en: Room was packed out.
cues.zh: 房间挤满了人。

cues.en: And as I was leaving they said, you got to get the onion rings.
cues.zh: 当我离开时他们说，你必须得到洋葱圈。

cues.en: So I ordered some onion rings to go.
cues.zh: 所以我点了一些洋葱圈。

cues.en: And a guy came up to me.
cues.zh: 一个人向我走来。

cues.en: He wasn't at my rally.
cues.zh: 他没有参加我的集会。

cues.en: And he coveralls, he came up to me.
cues.zh: 他穿着工作服，向我走来。

cues.en: He said and I don't know how old he was.
cues.zh: 他说，我不知道他多大了。

cues.en: I'm thinking, well, maybe in his 80s, maybe late 70s.
cues.zh: 我在想，嗯，也许是 80 多岁，也许是 70 多岁。

cues.en: He said, I've voted in 46 elections in Kansas, and I've never voted for a Democrat.
cues.zh: 他说，我在堪萨斯州参加了 46 次选举，但从未投票给民主党。

cues.en: And I thought that was the end of the story.
cues.zh: 我以为故事就这样结束了。

cues.en: But he said, I voted for you.
cues.zh: 但他说，我投票给你了。

cues.en: This guy said he said what's happening in Washington D.C.
cues.zh: 这家伙说他说的是华盛顿特区正在发生的事情

cues.en: Is immoral.
cues.zh: 是不道德的。

cues.en: This is not who we are as Americans.
cues.zh: 这不是我们作为美国人的样子。

cues.en: It's not who we are as Republicans or Democrats.
cues.zh: 这不是我们作为共和党人或民主党人的身份。

cues.en: This is not okay with me.
cues.zh: 这对我来说不行。

cues.en: And he said, you're moral, you're decent, you're kind.
cues.zh: 他说，你是有道德的，你是正派的，你是善良的。

cues.en: You stand up for the values that I have in my own life.
cues.zh: 你捍卫我在生活中所拥有的价值观。

cues.en: I voted for you, and I told all my friends to vote for Adam Kinzinger.
cues.zh: 我投票给你，我还告诉我所有的朋友投票给亚当·金辛格。

cues.en: I think about a few weeks ago in Dodge City in southwestern Kansas where I showed up.
cues.zh: 我想起几周前我在堪萨斯州西南部的道奇城出现的情景。

cues.en: Now listen, I support ICE for doing what they were commissioned to do,
cues.zh: 现在听着，我支持 ICE 做他们被委托做的事情，

cues.en: And that is to keep dangerous people from blowing up buildings and hurting people.
cues.zh: 那就是防止危险分子炸毁建筑物并伤害人员。

cues.en: But that's they were not commissioned to arrest preschool teachers in front of their children.
cues.zh: 但他们并没有被委托在孩子面前逮捕学前班老师。

cues.en: There were nine So one one woman told me, she said when they showed up,
cues.zh: 有九个人 所以一位女士告诉我，当他们出现时她说，

cues.en: Parents didn't come and pick up their children at elementary school because they were too afraid.
cues.zh: 小学时家长没有来接孩子，因为他们太害怕了。

cues.en: Those children just just stayed there at school.
cues.zh: 那些孩子只是呆在学校里。

cues.en: This was not okay.
cues.zh: 这不行。

cues.en: And nine These were all Republicans telling me this.
cues.zh: 九这些都是共和党人告诉我的。

cues.en: And nine state Republican legislators wrote a letter to the President saying this is not okay.
cues.zh: 九名州共和党议员写信给总统说这是不行的。

cues.en: This is not who we are in Kansas.
cues.zh: 这不是堪萨斯州的我们。

cues.en: This is not normal.
cues.zh: 这是不正常的。

cues.en: I'm told Warren Buffett said something to this effect.
cues.zh: 我听说沃伦·巴菲特说过类似的话。

cues.en: He said, it's hard to lead the free world when most of your allies aren't sure they can trust you anymore.
cues.zh: 他说，当你的大多数盟友不确定他们是否可以再信任你时，领导自由世界是很困难的。

cues.en: Now I love the buttons.
cues.zh: 现在我喜欢这些按钮。

cues.en: Some of you have these buttons on that say decency is on the ballot.
cues.zh: 你们中的一些人身上有这些按钮，表明选票上有礼貌。

cues.en: Anybody have one of those buttons on here?
cues.zh: 有人在这里有这些按钮之一吗？

cues.en: I've seen them floating around in different places.
cues.zh: 我见过它们在不同的地方漂浮。

cues.en: Decency is on the ballot.
cues.zh: 正派就在选票上。

cues.en: Now I'm running on I'm running in addition to addressing uh the cost of living for people in healthcare.
cues.zh: 现在，我除了解决医疗保健领域人们的生活成本问题外，还继续跑步。

cues.en: I'm running on two other big ideas.
cues.zh: 我正在考虑另外两个伟大的想法。

cues.en: One of those is that we are better together, Republicans and Democrats, thoughtful Republicans,
cues.zh: 其中之一是我们在一起会更好，共和党人和民主党人，有思想的共和党人，

cues.en: Thoughtful Democrats choosing to come together and solve problems like it used to be,
cues.zh: 有思想的民主党人选择像以前一样团结起来解决问题，

cues.en: Bob Dole and George McGovern who gave us the Nancy working with Ted Kennedy to solve really big problems.
cues.zh: 鲍勃·多尔和乔治·麦戈文为我们提供了南希与特德·肯尼迪合作解决真正大问题的机会。

cues.en: That's how it's supposed to be.
cues.zh: 事情就应该这样。

cues.en: I'm going to tell you a little secret.
cues.zh: 我要告诉你一个小秘密。

cues.en: I want to become Jerry Moran's best friend.
cues.zh: 我想成为杰里·莫兰最好的朋友。

cues.en: I'm going to do everything I can for us to model for the rest of the United States States in deeply red Kansas,
cues.zh: 我将尽我所能为我们在深红色的堪萨斯州为美国其他地区做模特，

cues.en: The heart of America.
cues.zh: 美国的心脏。

cues.en: I want us to model what it looks like when thoughtful people actually work together to solve problems instead of slinging mud at each Other.
cues.zh: 我希望我们能够模拟，当有思想的人们真正共同努力解决问题而不是相互指责时的样子其他。

cues.en: And instead of deciding, you know, who's going to get the credit You've heard this before.
cues.zh: 你知道，而不是决定谁将获得荣誉，你以前听过这个。

cues.en: You can a whole lot done if you don't care who gets the credit.
cues.zh: 如果你不在乎谁获得功劳，你可以做很多事情。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 正确的？

cues.en: We're going to be that kind of state.
cues.zh: 我们将成为那样的状态。

cues.en: Now, the second thing is decency.
cues.zh: 现在，第二件事是礼貌。

cues.en: And when I think about what does decency look like, I think about Matthew 7:12.
cues.zh: 当我想到什么是正派时，我就会想到马太福音 7 章 12 节。

cues.en: I want you to finish this for me if you will.
cues.zh: 如果你愿意的话，我希望你能帮我完成这件事。

cues.en: You learned it from your grandma.
cues.zh: 你是从你奶奶那里学来的。

cues.en: Do unto others as you would do unto you.
cues.zh: 己所不欲，勿施于人。

cues.en: Yeah, you all do that.
cues.zh: 是的，你们都这样做。

cues.en: You see it in every religion.
cues.zh: 你在每个宗教中都能看到它。

cues.en: It's in Matthew chapter 7 verse 12 in the Sermon on the Mount.
cues.zh: 这是马太福音第 7 章第 12 节登山宝训中的内容。

cues.en: Do unto others as you'd have them do unto you.
cues.zh: 己所不欲，勿施于人。

cues.en: What does it look like in Washington if they actually did that?
cues.zh: 如果他们真的这么做了，华盛顿会是什么样子？

cues.en: How would our policies and our politics change if we treated people this way?
cues.zh: 如果我们这样对待人民，我们的政策和政治会发生什么变化？

cues.en: Or I think about Micah 6:8.
cues.zh: 或者我想到弥迦书 6:8。

cues.en: You don't have to believe in God to find this verse very powerful.
cues.zh: 你不必相信上帝就会发现这节经文非常强大。

cues.en: But the prophet says to his people, what does the Lord require of you?
cues.zh: 但先知对他的子民说，主对你们有什么要求？

cues.en: Not what does he suggest, what does he require of you, but to do justice.
cues.zh: 不是他建议什么，他对你有什么要求，而是要伸张正义。

cues.en: Justice is is fairness for people who are powerless.
cues.zh: 正义是对弱者的公平。

cues.en: To do justice, to love kindness, and to walk humbly before God.
cues.zh: 行公义、好仁慈、谦卑地行走在神面前。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 正确的？

cues.en: I mean, these are attributes that everybody needs to model in our world.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，这些是我们世界中每个人都需要塑造的属性。

cues.en: I think about something that Jesus said in Matthew 25.
cues.zh: 我想起耶稣在马太福音 25 章中所说的话。

cues.en: He was describing the Last Judgment.
cues.zh: 他正在描述最后的审判。

cues.en: He said, here's how it's going to go down in the end.
cues.zh: 他说，这就是最终的结局。

cues.en: I'm going to look at all of you and I'm going to say this to those who are the sheep.
cues.zh: 我会看着你们所有人，然后对那些羊们说这些。

cues.en: I'm going to say to you, I was hungry and you gave me something to eat.
cues.zh: 我要对你说，我饿了，你给了我吃的。

cues.en: I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink.
cues.zh: 我渴了，你给了我喝的东西。

cues.en: I was a stranger and the Greek word is immigrant actually.
cues.zh: 我是一个陌生人，希腊词实际上是移民。

cues.en: I was a stranger and you welcomed me.
cues.zh: 我是一个陌生人，而你欢迎我。

cues.en: I was naked and you clothed me.
cues.zh: 我赤身露体，你给我穿了衣服。

cues.en: I was sick and in prison and you visited me.
cues.zh: 我生病了，在监狱里，你来看望了我。

cues.en: And as much as you've done it for the least of these, you've done it for me.
cues.zh: 尽管你为其中最微不足道的事情做了这件事，但你也是为我做的。

cues.en: That's what decency looks like.
cues.zh: 这就是正派的样子。

cues.en: I had a man in Holton, Kansas say to me a couple of months ago.
cues.zh: 几个月前，堪萨斯州霍尔顿的一个人对我说。

cues.en: He said, hey preacher, I'm a one-issue voter.
cues.zh: 他说，嘿，牧师，我是一名单一议题选民。

cues.en: And I'm like, great, tell me your one issue.
cues.zh: 我想，太好了，告诉我你的一个问题。

cues.en: He said, I refuse to vote for anybody who doesn't believe.
cues.zh: 他说，我拒绝投票给任何不相信的人。

cues.en: And then he paused.
cues.zh: 然后他停了下来。

cues.en: I refuse to vote for anybody who doesn't believe that we should love our neighbor as we love ourselves.
cues.zh: 我拒绝投票给任何不相信我们应该像爱自己一样爱邻居的人。

cues.en: That's decency.
cues.zh: 这就是礼貌。

cues.en: Now listen, this kind of decency doesn't belittle people.
cues.zh: 听着，这种礼貌并不贬低人。

cues.en: It doesn't benefit the rich at the expense of the poor.
cues.zh: 它不会以牺牲穷人为代价来造福富人。

cues.en: It doesn't ignore the cries of the needy.
cues.zh: 它不会忽视有需要的人的呼声。

cues.en: It's not cruel or unkind.
cues.zh: 这并不残忍或不友善。

cues.en: Now when you speak of loving your neighbors as you love yourself, I want to remind you of a passage of scripture in the
cues.zh: 现在，当您谈到爱邻居如爱自己时，我想提醒您圣经中的一段经文

cues.en: Gospel of Luke chapter 10.
cues.zh: 路加福音第10章。

cues.en: This is 25 through 37.
I've preached this passage dozens of times in the last 38 years as a pastor.
cues.zh: 在过去 38 年的牧师生涯中，我已经多次宣讲过这段经文。

cues.en: There was a lawyer who approached Jesus and some pastor Scott preached on this not long ago.
cues.zh: 不久前，有一位律师来找耶稣，斯科特牧师也曾宣讲过这一点。

cues.en: There was a lawyer who approached Jesus and said, what must I do to inherit eternal life?
cues.zh: 有一位律法师来问耶稣，我必须做什么才能承受永生？

cues.en: And Jesus said, you're a religious leader.
cues.zh: 耶稣说，你是一位宗教领袖。

cues.en: What do you think?
cues.zh: 你怎么认为？

cues.en: And he said, love God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind,
cues.zh: 他说，要尽心、尽性、尽力、尽意地爱神，

cues.en: And love your neighbor as you love yourself.
cues.zh: 并像爱自己一样爱你的邻居。

cues.en: And Jesus said, that's right.
cues.zh: 耶稣说，没错。

cues.en: Go and do likewise or go and do this and you'll live.
cues.zh: 去做同样的事情或者去做这个，你就会活下去。

cues.en: But then the man followed up with a question.
cues.zh: 但随后那人又提出了一个问题。

cues.en: And he said, yeah, but Jesus, who is my neighbor?
cues.zh: 他说，是的，但是天哪，谁是我的邻居？

cues.en: And you know what he was asking was, tell me who I don't have to love.
cues.zh: 你知道他问的是什么，告诉我我不必爱谁。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 正确的？

cues.en: I just want to know I can love these people, but who don't I have to love?
cues.zh: 我只是想知道我可以爱这些人，但我不必爱谁呢？

cues.en: And that's when Jesus tells a story that all of you have heard before or at least you know the title of it.
cues.zh: 就在那时，耶稣讲述了一个你们以前都听过的故事，或者至少你们知道它的标题。

cues.en: The story of the parable of the good Samaritan.
cues.zh: 好撒玛利亚人的寓言故事。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: He said there was a certain man going from Jerusalem to Jericho and I've taken this route at least a dozen times when I've
cues.zh: 他说有一个人从耶路撒冷去耶利哥，我走过这条路至少十几次了。

cues.en: Been in the Holy Land.
cues.zh: 曾经在圣地。

cues.en: A certain man going from Jerusalem to Jericho and while he was going he was accosted by thieves.
cues.zh: 有一个人从耶路撒冷去耶利哥，路上被盗贼搭讪。

cues.en: He was beaten, he was stripped naked, he was robbed, and he was left for dead.
cues.zh: 他被殴打，他被剥光衣服，他被抢劫，他被留下等死。

cues.en: Now the text doesn't tell us anything about who did the robbing and stealing.
cues.zh: 现在文本没有告诉我们任何关于谁进行了抢劫和偷窃的信息。

cues.en: They just mentioned this happened that there was some group of people who were willing to rob from ordinary people and try to enrich
cues.zh: 他们只是提到这件事发生了，有一群人愿意从普通人那里抢劫并试图发财

cues.en: Themselves in this way.
cues.zh: 自己就这样。

cues.en: And so he says this is what's going on and then he says what happened next is there was a religious man who came
cues.zh: 所以他说这就是正在发生的事情然后他说接下来发生的是有一个宗教人士来了

cues.en: Along and he saw the man on the side of the road and instead of stopping to help he went to the other side Of the road.
cues.zh: 一路上，他看到那个人在路边，他没有停下来帮忙，而是走到了另一边道路的。

cues.en: He ignored him and he walked on to Jericho.
cues.zh: 他没有理睬他，径直朝耶利哥走去。

cues.en: Then there was a second religious man who came along.
cues.zh: 然后有第二位宗教人士出现。

cues.en: He saw the man on the side of the road.
cues.zh: 他看到了路边的那个人。

cues.en: He ignored him and he walked on the other side of the road and went on to Jericho.
cues.zh: 他没有理睬他，而是走到路的另一边，继续前往耶利哥。

cues.en: Finally there is a third man who comes along.
cues.zh: 最后，第三个人出现了。

cues.en: He is a Samaritan.
cues.zh: 他是一个撒玛利亚人。

cues.en: Now just to remind you, the Samaritans and the Jews didn't get along very well at the time.
cues.zh: 现在提醒你一下，当时撒玛利亚人和犹太人相处得不太好。

cues.en: If Jesus were telling this parable to a room filled with Democrats he'd say,
cues.zh: 如果耶稣向满屋子的民主党人讲这个比喻，他会说：

cues.en: And there was a Republican who came along and stopped and helped the man.
cues.zh: 有一位共和党人走过来拦住并帮助了那个人。

cues.en: If he was talking to a room filled with Republicans he'd say, and there was a Democrat who came along and stopped to help The man.
cues.zh: 如果他正在和一个满是共和党人的房间谈话，他会说，有一个民主党人过来并停下来提供帮助那个男人。

cues.en: Or a liberal or a conservative or you pick the person who feels different from you.
cues.zh: 或者是自由派或保守派，或者你选择感觉与你不同的人。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 正确的？

cues.en: And it was this person who came along and he saw the man and what did he do?
cues.zh: 就是这个人过来了，他看到了那个人，他做了什么？

cues.en: He stopped and he helped him.
cues.zh: 他停下来并帮助了他。

cues.en: He bandaged his wounds.
cues.zh: 他包扎了伤口。

cues.en: He wrapped him in his own cloak.
cues.zh: 他用自己的斗篷把他包裹起来。

cues.en: He put him on his own donkey, and he took him down to Jericho.
cues.zh: 他让他骑上自己的驴，带他下到耶利哥。

cues.en: Then he provided logic for him, and he provided for his care.
cues.zh: 然后他为他提供逻辑，并为他提供照顾。

cues.en: And Jesus said, okay, so which one was the neighbor?
cues.zh: 耶稣说，好吧，那么谁是邻居呢？

cues.en: Who actually did what what both Moses and Jesus are teaching to do?
cues.zh: 谁实际上做了摩西和耶稣所教导的事情？

cues.en: And of course, the legal scholar said, well, it was of course the Samaritan.
cues.zh: 当然，法律学者说，好吧，这当然是撒玛利亚人。

cues.en: And Jesus says, go and do likewise.
cues.zh: 耶稣说，你也去照样做吧。

cues.en: I love the fact that Dr. King preached from this text in his last sermon ever.
cues.zh: 我喜欢金博士在他最后一次讲道中根据这段经文进行讲道的事实。

cues.en: He went to Memphis, Tennessee.
cues.zh: 他去了田纳西州的孟菲斯。

cues.en: He was there protesting for sanitation workers.
cues.zh: 他在那里为环卫工人抗议。

cues.en: And uh he had death threats, and he was sick when he got there.
cues.zh: 呃，他收到了死亡威胁，而且当他到达那里时他病了。

cues.en: And he's teaching this this parable.
cues.zh: 他正在用这个寓言来教导这一点。

cues.en: And as he's doing that, he said, you know, the question I have in my mind is like why did the two religious people
cues.zh: 当他这样做时，他说，你知道，我脑子里的问题是为什么这两个宗教人士

cues.en: Not stop to help?
cues.zh: 不停下来帮忙吗？

cues.en: And and he says, it's possible that they didn't maybe they were in a hurry.
cues.zh: 他说，他们可能没有，也许他们很匆忙。

cues.en: Uh maybe they didn't stop to help because they were worried the thieves were still around,
cues.zh: 呃，也许他们没有停下来帮忙，因为他们担心小偷还在附近，

cues.en: And the thieves would come and and attack them too.
cues.zh: 小偷也会来攻击他们。

cues.en: So they were afraid.
cues.zh: 所以他们害怕了。

cues.en: So they went to the outside of the road and they went on down to Jericho and left the man to die.
cues.zh: 于是他们走到路外，继续下到耶利哥，留下那人等死。

cues.en: And they and he said, but the Samaritan, he came along, he stopped and helped.
cues.zh: 他们和他说，但是撒玛利亚人，他过来了，他停下来帮忙。

cues.en: And he said, you know what happened was the first two religious people I'm not saying a lot of religious people do this.
cues.zh: 他说，你知道发生的事情是前两个宗教人士，我并不是说很多宗教人士都这样做。

cues.en: So the question they asked was, what's going to happen to us if we stop and help him?
cues.zh: 所以他们问的问题是，如果我们停下来帮助他，我们会发生什么？

cues.en: But the Samaritan asked this question, what's going to happen to him if I don't stop and help him?
cues.zh: 但撒玛利亚人问了这个问题，如果我不停下来帮助他，他会发生什么？

cues.en: And that's the question we have to ask when we're trying to be But I do want to say there are three types of
cues.zh: 这就是我们在努力做到这一点时必须问的问题 但我确实想说，存在三种类型

cues.en: People mentioned in this story.
cues.zh: 这个故事里提到的人。

cues.en: There are the people who don't mind hurting other people to get to embrace themselves.
cues.zh: 有些人不介意伤害别人来拥抱自己。

cues.en: And there are some of those people in our world today.
cues.zh: 今天我们的世界上就有这样的一些人。

cues.en: And and then there are people who know it's wrong, but they don't say anything.
cues.zh: 还有一些人知道这是错误的，但他们什么也没说。

cues.en: They're cowardly lions, if you will.
cues.zh: 如果你愿意的话，他们是胆怯的狮子。

cues.en: Unafraid to say anything.
cues.zh: 什么都不怕说。

cues.en: And then there are the people like the Samaritan who stop and help.
cues.zh: 还有像撒玛利亚人这样停下来提供帮助的人。

cues.en: I just want to ask you, which one will you be?
cues.zh: 我只想问你，你会是哪一种呢？

cues.en: Which one will I be?
cues.zh: 我会是哪一位呢？

cues.en: Which one will the Congress be from this time forward?
cues.zh: 从现在开始，国会将是哪一届？

cues.en: And how I got elected today.
cues.zh: 以及我今天是如何当选的。

cues.en: I think I got elected after getting in the race just 6 months ago.
cues.zh: 我认为我在 6 个月前参加竞选后就当选了。

cues.en: I think I got elected because Kansans were saying we're tired of the bullies.
cues.zh: 我想我当选是因为堪萨斯人说我们厌倦了恶霸。

cues.en: We're tired of the chaos.
cues.zh: 我们厌倦了混乱。

cues.en: We're tired of the We are no longer going to pay the pain of our neighbors.
cues.zh: 我们厌倦了我们不再为邻居的痛苦付出代价。

cues.en: There are a lot of Kansans saying let's love our neighbors as we love ourselves.
cues.zh: 有很多堪萨斯人说，让我们像爱自己一样爱我们的邻居。

cues.en: See, Kansans are decent people.
cues.zh: 看吧，堪萨斯人都是正派的人。

cues.en: They're good people.
cues.zh: 他们是好人。

cues.en: They're pragmatic.
cues.zh: 他们很务实。

cues.en: They care about each other.
cues.zh: 他们互相关心。

cues.en: That's who we are in Kansas.
cues.zh: 这就是我们在堪萨斯州的情况。

cues.en: Now, I want to mention just one more word.
cues.zh: 现在，我想再提一句。

cues.en: I'm a United Methodist pastor.
cues.zh: 我是联合卫理公会的牧师。

cues.en: I've been a United Methodist pastor for 40 years, nearly 40 years.
cues.zh: 我担任联合卫理公会牧师已经四十年了，快四十年了。

cues.en: We have this vision statement in the United Methodist Church.
cues.zh: 我们在联合卫理公会有这样的愿景声明。

cues.en: We put it on a coffee mug at Church of the Resurrection.
cues.zh: 我们把它放在复活教堂的咖啡杯上。

cues.en: It says, and I love this, it's it just tells you a little bit about our denomination,
cues.zh: 它说，我喜欢这个，它只是告诉你一些关于我们教派的信息，

cues.en: But it also is just a good cry for every human being, whether you're a person of faith or not.
cues.zh: 但这对每个人来说也是一个美好的呼喊，无论你是否有信仰。

cues.en: This is what we're called to do.
cues.zh: 这就是我们蒙召要做的事。

cues.en: Love boldly, serve joyfully, and lead courageously.
cues.zh: 大胆地爱，快乐地服务，勇敢地领导。

cues.en: I was preaching a sermon series on that on those three things in last October when I began feeling this sense of okay,
cues.zh: 去年十月，当我开始感到这种感觉良好时，我正在就这三件事进行系列讲道，

cues.en: What does it look like for you, preacher, to love boldly, to serve joyfully,
cues.zh: 传道人，勇敢地去爱，喜乐地服务，对你来说是什么样子的？

cues.en: And to lead courageously?
cues.zh: 并勇敢地领导？

cues.en: And I couldn't get out of my mind that maybe that meant running for the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 我一直在想，也许这意味着竞选美国参议员。

cues.en: I want to thank you, the people of Kansas who voted for me,
cues.zh: 我要感谢投票给我的堪萨斯人民

cues.en: All of those of you who volunteered and worked so hard.
cues.zh: 你们所有自愿并努力工作的人。

cues.en: You put signs up.
cues.zh: 你贴上标语。

cues.en: You made calls.
cues.zh: 你打过电话。

cues.en: You knocked on doors.
cues.zh: 你敲了门。

cues.en: You gave.
cues.zh: 你给了。

cues.en: You contributed to my campaign.
cues.zh: 你为我的竞选活动做出了贡献。

cues.en: You told all of your friends.
cues.zh: 你告诉了你所有的朋友。

cues.en: I would not be here were it not for you.
cues.zh: 如果没有你，我就不会在这里。

cues.en: I work for you.
cues.zh: 我为你工作。

cues.en: I'm going to represent you.
cues.zh: 我来代表你。

cues.en: And all of these people and those people who did not vote for me,
cues.zh: 所有这些人和那些没有投票给我的人，

cues.en: You know, I'm going to represent them, too.
cues.zh: 你知道，我也将代表他们。

cues.en: I care about them.
cues.zh: 我关心他们。

cues.en: I saw a guy at a coffee shop this week.
cues.zh: 这周我在一家咖啡店见到了一个人。

cues.en: He said I didn't vote for you.
cues.zh: 他说我没有投票给你。

cues.en: I was afraid the Democrats would take control of the Senate.
cues.zh: 我担心民主党会控制参议院。

cues.en: Well, guess what?
cues.zh: 嗯，你猜怎么着？

cues.en: They're going to take control of the Senate.
cues.zh: 他们将控制参议院。

cues.en: Because this election, this election is a rebuke of unkindness and cruelty in Washington, D.C.
cues.zh: 因为这次选举，这次选举是对华盛顿不仁慈和残忍的谴责，华盛顿特区

cues.en: So, I'm going to thank all of you.
cues.zh: 所以，我要感谢你们所有人。

cues.en: I want to thank Shelly Pets.
cues.zh: 我要感谢雪莉宠物。

cues.en: I know she's around here somewhere, and she led a team who were my prayer partners,
cues.zh: 我知道她就在附近的某个地方，她领导的团队是我的祈祷伙伴，

cues.en: And they prayed for me every day, and I just can't tell you I felt when I had somebody call me,
cues.zh: 他们每天都为我祈祷，我无法告诉你当有人打电话给我时我的感受，

cues.en: You know, a groomer.
cues.zh: 你知道，美容师。

cues.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，美国总统曾两次访问堪萨斯城、威奇托和堪萨斯州

cues.en: In two weeks to to, you know, to talk smack about me.
cues.zh: 两周后，你知道，就会谈论我。

cues.zh: 副总统也做了同样的事情，并说我不是真正的基督徒。

cues.zh: 但你知道吗？

cues.zh: 我对此没有任何感觉。

cues.en: I just felt like little arrows just fell to the ground.
cues.zh: 我只觉得小箭掉到了地上。

cues.en: And in part that was because of Shelly and her team and all of you who were praying for lobotomy.
cues.zh: 部分原因是雪莉和她的团队以及所有人为脑白质切除术祈祷。

cues.en: We just felt such peace in the middle of this from your prayers.
cues.zh: 在你们的祈祷中，我们感到如此平静。

cues.en: So I want to thank you for that.
cues.zh: 所以我想为此感谢你。

cues.en: I want to thank my amazing uh team of staff.
cues.zh: 我要感谢我出色的呃团队。

cues.en: Would you all raise your hands my staff I love this.
cues.zh: 你们都举手吗，我的员工，我喜欢这个。

cues.en: And I'm about done.
cues.zh: 我快完成了。

cues.zh: 你知道，一位牧师说过大约十次这样的话。

cues.zh: 我快完成了。

cues.zh: 但是呃，但是我记得 6 个月前，当我们参加比赛时，库克报告说，

cues.zh: 现在堪萨斯州已经完全变成红色了。

cues.zh: 他们不可能选举民主党人然后大约一个半月后他们说，

cues.zh: 嗯，它们可能是红色的。

cues.zh: 嗯，部分原因是这些员工为实现这一目标而付出了不懈的努力。

cues.zh: 但我为你们作为一个会众感到非常自豪，我很感激你们给我请假

cues.zh: 我仍然相信这是上帝的召唤，试图以不同的方式改变我们的世界，

cues.zh: 今晚我们创造了历史，但真正的工作要从 1 月 3 日开始。

cues.zh: 我想邀请你加入我。

speaker: Cory Booker
role: 新泽西州 · 连任参议员
title: Cory Bookers Speech on His Victory and The Work Ahead

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Any jersey in the house?
cues.zh: 家里有球衣吗？

cues.en: Look, I want to thank this great state for giving me the greatest honor of my life to continue to be your United States Senator.
cues.zh: 看，我要感谢这个伟大的国家给了我一生中最大的荣幸，让我继续成为你们的美国参议员。

cues.en: And I want to thank Paul.
cues.zh: 我要感谢保罗。

cues.en: You're Listen, you all know this.
cues.zh: 听着，你们都知道这一点。

cues.en: I'm I've been in Essex County for half my life, but the first half of my life grew up right here in Bergen County.
cues.zh: 我已经在埃塞克斯县生活了一半，但我的前半生是在卑尔根县长大的。

cues.en: And I want to thank the chairman.
cues.zh: 我要感谢主席。

cues.en: Paul is steadfast.
cues.zh: 保罗很坚定。

cues.en: He is unyielding.
cues.zh: 他是不屈的。

cues.en: He is determined.
cues.zh: 他决心已定。

cues.en: He is hard working.
cues.zh: 他工作很努力。

cues.en: Dear God, he is the James Brown of Bergen County, the hardest working man up here.
cues.zh: 天哪，他是卑尔根县的詹姆斯·布朗，这里工作最努力的人。

cues.en: Give it up for our chairman, Paul Juliano.
cues.zh: 让我们的主席保罗·朱利亚诺放弃吧。

cues.en: And then our state party chair, who also happens to be our great great Essex County chair.
cues.zh: 然后是我们的州党主席，他也恰好是我们伟大的埃塞克斯县主席。

cues.en: He's led all over this state.
cues.zh: 他领导了整个州。

cues.en: He's one of the reasons why we have the nation's greatest governor, Mikie Sherrill.
cues.zh: 他是我们拥有美国最伟大的州长米基·谢里尔的原因之一。

cues.en: I want to thank Leroy Jones for his leadership and everything that he has done through this election and our last.
cues.zh: 我要感谢勒罗伊·琼斯的领导以及他在这次和上次选举中所做的一切。

cues.en: Look, I'm grateful for my family.
cues.zh: 瞧，我很感激我的家人。

cues.en: Grateful for my wife.
cues.zh: 感谢我的妻子。

cues.en: I'm grateful for all those people who worked on this election.
cues.zh: 我感谢所有为这次选举工作的人们。

cues.en: I want to thank Adam, my campaign manager, who has been not only a phenomenal leader,
cues.zh: 我要感谢我的竞选经理亚当，他不仅是一位杰出的领导者，

cues.en: But he has been a phenomenal friend.
cues.zh: 但他是一位非凡的朋友。

cues.en: But to everyone who worked on this campaign, for everyone who worked on the whole ticket electing them.
cues.zh: 但对于所有参与这次竞选活动的人，以及所有参与整个选票工作并选举他们的人。

cues.en: Those who knocked on doors, who made phone calls, who hung signs, who organized and mobilized all over this state,
cues.zh: 那些敲门、打电话、挂标语、在全州组织和动员的人，

cues.en: Working for people on the ticket in town council races in Egg Harbor Township all the way up to some of the most important
cues.zh: 为蛋港镇镇议会竞选的门票上的人工作，一直到一些最重要的比赛

cues.en: House races in America, including flipping one seat now with Rebecca Bennett going to the House of Representatives.
cues.zh: 美国众议院竞选，包括丽贝卡·贝内特 (Rebecca Bennett) 进入众议院，现在翻转一个席位。

cues.en: Politics is not an individual sport.
cues.zh: 政治不是一项个人运动。

cues.en: It's like my old high school football game team.
cues.zh: 这就像我以前的高中橄榄球队。

cues.en: It is a team sport.
cues.zh: 这是一项团队运动。

cues.en: We do this together.
cues.zh: 我们一起做这件事。

cues.en: And so tonight I especially want to thank for thank all those people who kept working,
cues.zh: 所以今晚我特别要感谢所有那些一直努力工作的人，

cues.en: Kept working, and kept working through this election.
cues.zh: 继续工作，并在这次选举中继续工作。

cues.en: Now, we're going to see a lot of things happen tonight.
cues.zh: 现在，今晚我们将看到很多事情发生。

cues.en: The results are going to continue to pour in.
cues.zh: 结果将继续涌入。

cues.en: And if there's anything we're seeing in America right now, it is a wave of change going through our nation.
cues.zh: 如果我们现在在美国看到什么的话，那就是我们国家正在经历的变革浪潮。

cues.en: And And mark my words, the results are not in, but this is going to be one of the greatest rebukes of a sitting
cues.zh: 记住我的话，结果还没有出来，但这将是对坐会的最大谴责之一

cues.en: President in the history of the United States of America.
cues.zh: 美利坚合众国历史上的总统。

cues.en: I said from the beginning of this election that this election is not right or left,
cues.zh: 我从这次选举一开始就说过，这次选举不分左右，

cues.en: It is right or wrong.
cues.zh: 这是对还是错。

cues.en: What we've been seeing in our communities and our towns and our neighborhoods has been wrong.
cues.zh: 我们在社区、城镇和社区所看到的情况是错误的。

cues.en: It is wrong to have people jumping out of unmarked cars, wearing masks,
cues.zh: 让人们戴着口罩从没有标记的汽车上跳下来是错误的

cues.en: Going around our schools and our churches, going around our hospitals, and dragging our neighbors into private for-profit prisons.
cues.zh: 绕过我们的学校和教堂，绕过我们的医院，并将我们的邻居拖进私人营利性监狱。

cues.en: People that have American spouses and American children, what we're seeing around this country is our citizens getting shot and often killed by this Reckless, out-of-control agency.
cues.zh: 有美国配偶和美国孩子的人，我们在这个国家看到的是我们的公民被枪击并经常被杀鲁莽、失控的机构。

cues.en: That is wrong.
cues.zh: 那是错误的。

cues.en: It is wrong for us to find ourselves in yet another unjustified Middle East war,
cues.zh: 我们发现自己陷入了另一场不公正的中东战争，这是错误的，

cues.en: A quagmire that has cost us lives, billions of dollars.
cues.zh: 这个泥潭让我们付出了生命和数十亿美元的代价。

cues.en: It is wrong to see gas prices being jacked up to record levels,
cues.zh: 看到天然气价格被推高至创纪录水平是错误的，

cues.en: And Americans all over people up and down the state of New Jersey paying more and more even though they're not making more.
cues.zh: 新泽西州上下的美国人尽管赚的钱不多，但支付的钱却越来越多。

cues.en: It is wrong to take a trillion dollars out of Medicaid, to take a sledgehammer to the Affordable Care Act,
cues.zh: 从医疗补助中拿走一万亿美元，对平价医疗法案进行大锤打击，都是错误的，

cues.en: To drive up all of our health insurance costs, all with the excuse of giving bigger and bigger tax breaks to the wealthiest of The wealthy.
cues.zh: 为了提高我们所有的健康保险费用，所有这些都是以向最富有的人提供越来越大的税收减免为借口有钱人。

cues.en: It is wrong to have tariff wars that are indiscriminate and make no sense whatsoever.
cues.zh: 不分青红皂白、毫无意义地发动关税战是错误的。

cues.en: It is wrong to declare war on Canada.
cues.zh: 对加拿大宣战是错误的。

cues.en: And all while these policies are hurting our people and hurting our neighbors,
cues.zh: 尽管这些政策正在伤害我们的人民和我们的邻居，

cues.en: It is wrong for the corruption in Washington to spread to such a level that we have a president now that has grifted more
cues.zh: 华盛顿的腐败蔓延到我们现在有一位贪污更多的总统，这是错误的

cues.en: Than two billion dollars off of his office.
cues.zh: 他的办公室损失了超过二十亿美元。

cues.en: Like Marie Antoinette, he is getting richer and richer while our nation struggles more and more.
cues.zh: 就像玛丽·安托瓦内特一样，他变得越来越富有，而我们的国家却越来越挣扎。

cues.en: But I tell you all of this to say to you very clearly,
cues.zh: 但我告诉你这一切是为了非常清楚地告诉你，

cues.en: The challenges we face as a nation did not start with Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 我们作为一个国家所面临的挑战并非始于唐纳德·特朗普。

cues.en: I will do everything in office to fight him, to check and balance him,
cues.zh: 我会在任内尽一切努力对抗他、制衡他，

cues.en: To hold him accountable, but I want to know you to know something tonight.
cues.zh: 追究他的责任，但今晚我想让你知道一些事情。

cues.en: We have challenges in our nation that predated him.
cues.zh: 我们的国家在他之前就面临着挑战。

cues.en: There are a lot of people in this country that are beginning to lose faith.
cues.zh: 这个国家有很多人开始失去信心。

cues.en: We have politicians that try to exploit our fears and our divisions and pit us against one another.
cues.zh: 我们的政客试图利用我们的恐惧和分歧，让我们相互对立。

cues.en: We are still one nation under God.
cues.zh: 我们仍然是上帝统治下的一个国家。

cues.en: We have people trying to tell us that the problem in this nation is left or right.
cues.zh: 有人试图告诉我们这个国家的问题是左还是右。

cues.en: Well, I'm going to tell you something.
cues.zh: 好吧，我要告诉你一件事。

cues.en: The difference that most should concern us in America, the distance between us that is the biggest crisis,
cues.zh: 我们在美国最应该关心的差异，我们之间的距离是最大的危机，

cues.en: Is the distance between the American people and the American dream.
cues.zh: 是美国人民与美国梦之间的距离。

cues.en: My grandparents told me about this great dream of America.
cues.zh: 我的祖父母告诉我美国的这个伟大梦想。

cues.en: They were two generations from slavery and they believed in this nation and they got involved in politics like we all are tonight.
cues.zh: 他们是奴隶制的两代人，他们相信这个国家，他们像我们今晚一样参与政治。

cues.en: Back then, my grandfather knocked on doors in Detroit for a man named fdr.
cues.zh: 当时，我的祖父在底特律为一位名叫罗斯福的人敲门。

cues.en: And he knew that this nation's dream had not been achieved, but he believed in it.
cues.zh: 他知道这个国家的梦想还没有实现，但他坚信这一点。

cues.en: Sweat and work.
cues.zh: 流汗并工作。

cues.en: He worked assembly lines during World War ii building bombers and then organized and mobilized and got a new president elected who said it's
cues.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，他在装配线上工作，制造轰炸机，然后组织和动员，当选了一位新总统，他说这是

cues.en: Time for a new deal.
cues.zh: 是时候签订新协议了。

cues.en: The new deal is necessary because the dream is out of reach for too many people.
cues.zh: 新政是必要的，因为这个梦想对太多人来说遥不可及。

cues.en: And they reset the economic table, lifted the economic floor, gave work dignity,
cues.zh: 他们重置了经济桌子，提高了经济地板，赋予了工作尊严，

cues.en: Stopped the concentrations of wealth, and let the free market and real competition spring up again.
cues.zh: 停止财富的集中，让自由市场和真正的竞争重新兴起。

cues.en: What fdr, that generation did, yielded the baby boomer generation and 90% of them did better than their parents.
cues.zh: 罗斯福那一代人的所作所为催生了婴儿潮一代，其中 90% 的人比他们的父辈做得更好。

cues.en: When my generation came on, the X generation, we benefited from all that work.
cues.zh: 当我这一代，即 X 一代出现时，我们从所有这些工作中受益。

cues.en: Almost 65% of us did better than our parents.
cues.zh: 我们中近 65% 的人比我们的父母做得更好。

cues.en: But around that time of the Reagan revolution, 1980, and I remind you I had a great afro in 1980.
cues.zh: 但在 1980 年里根革命的那个时期，我提醒你，我在 1980 年留了一个很棒的爆炸头。

cues.en: But 1980 was that tipping point when unfortunately in our country it was a 50/50 flip of a coin whether you do better than
cues.zh: 但 1980 年是一个转折点，不幸的是，在我们国家，无论你做得比

cues.en: Your parents and every generation since, millennials and Zs, have seen worse and worse economic horizons for their generations.
cues.zh: 你的父母以及此后的每一代人，千禧一代和 Z 世代，都经历了他们这一代人的经济前景越来越糟糕。

cues.en: America does not work if it only works for some.
cues.zh: 如果美国只对某些人有用，那么它就不起作用。

cues.en: We are a nation that has promised that we would be the country that shows that our way of governance,
cues.zh: 我们是一个承诺我们将成为展示我们治理方式的国家，

cues.en: That our ideals work best in the world, and the measure of that is not in how many billionaires we have,
cues.zh: 我们的理想在世界上最有效，而衡量这一点的标准不在于我们有多少亿万富翁，

cues.en: But in how many of our people can access a quality of life,
cues.zh: 但我们有多少人能够获得高质量的生活，

cues.en: A work with decency and dignity, the ability to provide for your children and retire with security.
cues.zh: 一份体面、有尊严的工作，有能力供养孩子并有保障地退休。

cues.en: And so I'm going to tell you right now what the mission is because we have ended an election,
cues.zh: 所以我现在要告诉你们使命是什么，因为我们已经结束了选举，

cues.en: But this has got to be the start of a movement.
cues.zh: 但这必须是一场运动的开始。

cues.en: It is not just a movement to deal with an out-of-control aging autocrat wannabe in the White House.
cues.zh: 这不仅仅是一场应对白宫失控、年迈独裁者的运动。

cues.en: The mission is bigger than him.
cues.zh: 使命比他更大。

cues.en: He is not the main character of our story.
cues.zh: 他不是我们故事的主角。

cues.en: The main character of our story is the American people.
cues.zh: 我们故事的主角是美国人民。

cues.en: And the job of our generation is to redeem the dream of America.
cues.zh: 我们这一代人的工作就是拯救美国梦。

cues.en: The dream of our ancestors, the dream of immigrants and laborers, the dreams of former slaves and children of fair sharecroppers.
cues.zh: 我们祖先的梦想，移民和劳工的梦想，前奴隶和公平佃农孩子的梦想。

cues.en: It is up to us to redeem the dream of America, and tonight's election must be the start of just that.
cues.zh: 我们有责任拯救美国的梦想，今晚的选举必须是这个梦想的开始。

cues.en: I'm telling you right now, America, tonight is the start of our comeback, Baby.
cues.zh: 我现在告诉你，美国，今晚是我们卷土重来的开始，宝贝。

cues.en: America, we now know the mission is to redeem the dream.
cues.zh: 美国，我们现在知道使命是拯救梦想。

cues.en: Because when there is a dream in our land, as the poet said,
cues.zh: 因为当我们的土地上有梦想时，正如诗人所说，

cues.en: With its back against the wall, the only way to save the dream is to save the dream for all.
cues.zh: 在背水一战的情况下，拯救梦想的唯一方法就是拯救所有人的梦想。

cues.en: Are you all ready for the work?
cues.zh: 你们都准备好工作了吗？

cues.en: Are you all ready for the mission?
cues.zh: 你们都准备好执行任务了吗？

cues.en: Are you ready to redeem the dream of America?
cues.zh: 你准备好拯救美国梦了吗？

cues.en: Are you ready to end the corruption in Washington?
cues.zh: 您准备好结束华盛顿的腐败了吗？

cues.en: Are you ready to make sure that in our generation we have a better deal for every family in America?
cues.zh: 您准备好确保在我们这一代，我们为美国的每个家庭提供更好的待遇吗？

cues.en: Then let's get to work.
cues.zh: 然后我们开始工作吧。

cues.en: Let's celebrate tonight, wake up tomorrow morning, and let's get working on the American dream again.
cues.zh: 让我们今晚庆祝一下，明天早上醒来，让我们再次为美国梦而努力。

cues.en: Thank you, everybody.
cues.zh: 谢谢大家。

speaker: Ed Markey
role: 马萨诸塞州 · 连任参议员
title: Sen. Ed Markey wins reelection in Massachusetts, says "we have got a fight ahead"

cues.en: My eternal gratitude.
cues.zh: 我永恒的感激之情。

cues.en: And I look out into the crowd, and I see people who worked for me on my very first campaign for Congress back and
cues.zh: 我向人群望去，看到了在我第一次竞选国会时为我工作的人

cues.en: That's a long time ago.
cues.zh: 那是很久以前的事了。

cues.en: It's back when only birds tweeted and TikTok came from a clock.
cues.zh: 那时还只有鸟儿会“推特”，TikTok 还只是时钟的滴答声。

cues.en: It was a long time ago.
cues.zh: 那是很久以前的事了。

cues.en: So I thank all of you.
cues.zh: 所以我感谢你们所有人。

cues.en: And to my phenomenal campaign team, with deep thanks to Stacy Monahan and [name unclear], and our campaign manager [name unclear],
cues.zh: 还有我出色的竞选团队，特别感谢斯泰西·莫纳汉和[姓名不清]，以及我们的竞选经理[姓名不清]，

cues.en: You fought hard every single day.
cues.zh: 你们每一天都在努力奋斗。

cues.en: You did so magnificently and you cared so deeply.
cues.zh: 你做得如此出色，你如此深切地关心。

cues.en: You left it all out on the field and we won and tonight we celebrate because tomorrow we have work to do to to
cues.zh: 你把一切都留在了球场上，我们赢了，今晚我们庆祝，因为明天我们还有工作要做

cues.en: To save our democracy.
cues.zh: 为了拯救我们的民主。

cues.en: We don't know yet the full outcome of today's elections around the country,
cues.zh: 我们还不知道今天全国各地选举的全部结果，

cues.en: But we do know that Donald Trump is the most corrupt, the most desperate person to ever lead our country.
cues.zh: 但我们确实知道唐纳德·特朗普是有史以来领导我们国家的最腐败、最绝望的人。

cues.en: He every day in the Oval Office he is a walking, talking constitutional crisis.
cues.zh: 他每天在椭圆形办公室里行走、谈论宪法危机。

cues.en: He and his maga Republican enablers know they can't win on the issues.
cues.zh: 他和他的共和党支持者知道他们无法在这些问题上获胜。

cues.en: How could they?
cues.zh: 他们怎么能呢？

cues.en: Gas prices are up, grocery prices are up, tariffs are up, healthcare premiums are up,
cues.zh: 汽油价格上涨，杂货价格上涨，关税上涨，医疗保费上涨，

cues.en: And the anger of American voters are up.
cues.zh: 美国选民的愤怒也在上升。

cues.en: So what are they trying to do today?
cues.zh: 那么他们今天想做什么？

cues.en: Cheat.
cues.zh: 欺骗。

cues.en: Baseless lawsuits to kick voters off the rolls, threats to use nuclear weapons in Iran after the election,
cues.zh: 毫无根据的诉讼将选民踢出名单，选举后威胁在伊朗使用核武器，

cues.en: Violent ICE agents patrolling the streets for months to keep our immigrant fearful and at home.
cues.zh: 暴力的 ICE 特工在街道上巡逻了数月，让我们的移民感到恐惧并留在家里。

cues.en: The President may try to steal the election, but he has no say whatsoever in the conduct of elections.
cues.zh: 总统可能会试图窃取选举结果，但他对选举的进行没有任何发言权。

cues.en: I guess they did not teach that at Trump University.
cues.zh: 我猜他们在特朗普大学没有教过这个。

cues.en: We will make sure that our elections are free and fair and not bought and paid for,
cues.zh: 我们将确保我们的选举是自由和公平的，而不是花钱买来的，

cues.en: But we cannot respond to this moment with cynicism or with resignation for the poor,
cues.zh: 但我们不能以愤世嫉俗或对穷人的顺从来应对这一时刻，

cues.en: The sick, the elderly.
cues.zh: 病人、老人。

cues.en: The past is just a memory, and the future is their hard reality.
cues.zh: 过去只是记忆，未来才是他们的残酷现实。

cues.en: The solution to despair is the courage to fight back and the hope that comes from exercising that power.
cues.zh: 解决绝望的方法是反击的勇气和运用这种力量带来的希望。

cues.en: And I'm thinking of the phone banks at Ula Cafe in Jamaica Plain,
cues.zh: 我想到了牙买加平原乌拉咖啡馆的电话银行，

cues.en: Where dozens of people are calling members of Congress to extend temporary protected status for Haitian tps holders.
cues.zh: 数十人呼吁国会议员延长海地临时保护身份持有者的临时保护地位。

cues.en: And I'm thinking of the neighbors and advocates who are giving big checks,
cues.zh: 我想到的是那些提供大额支票的邻居和倡导者，

cues.en: The big finger on polluting data centers.
cues.zh: 对污染数据中心的大手笔。

cues.en: No community should have a data center if they don't want it.
cues.zh: 如果社区不想要的话，就不应该拥有数据中心。

cues.en: They should have the right to say no.
cues.zh: 他们应该有权说不。

cues.en: The American people did not sign up for this.
cues.zh: 美国人民并没有对此表示同意。

cues.en: You can't gut Medicaid by a trillion dollars and then give a trillion dollar tax break to billionaires.
cues.zh: 你不可能削减一万亿美元的医疗补助，然后给亿万富翁提供一万亿美元的税收减免。

cues.en: Tonight, we say no more.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们不再多说。

cues.en: When Republicans gas holes in our social safety net, we will be the ones to mend the fabric hole again.
cues.zh: 当共和党人给我们的社会安全网造成漏洞时，我们将再次修补这个漏洞。

cues.en: When they undermine our democratic institutions, we will uphold the rule of law.
cues.zh: 当他们破坏我们的民主制度时，我们将维护法治。

cues.en: And when they try to silence those who speak out against them, we will meet them in the courts.
cues.zh: 当他们试图压制那些公开反对他们的人时，我们将在法庭上与他们会面。

cues.en: We will meet them in the streets, and we will bring a soapbox and a bullhorn and a box of receipts,
cues.zh: 我们会在街上遇见他们，我们会带上一个肥皂盒、一个扩音器和一盒收据，

cues.en: And we will win.
cues.zh: 我们会赢。

cues.en: Because on every issue, we are right and Trump is wrong.
cues.zh: 因为在每个问题上，我们都是对的，特朗普都是错的。

cues.en: We can watch the darkness grow and give up, or we can fix it.
cues.zh: 我们可以看着黑暗增长并放弃，或者我们可以修复它。

cues.en: But only if we meet this moment together.
cues.zh: 但前提是我们一起迎接这一刻。

cues.en: As Dr. King said, that only when it is dark enough can you see the stars.
cues.zh: 正如金博士所说，只有当天足够黑时，你才能看到星星。

cues.en: Our democracy is threatened, but it will endure because of you, the stars.
cues.zh: 我们的民主受到威胁，但由于你们，星星，它将会持续下去。

cues.en: Our democracy is stronger than greed and corruption because you are stronger than that.
cues.zh: 我们的民主比贪婪和腐败更强大，因为你们比它们更强大。

cues.en: Our democracy is more resilient than the chest-thumping threats of a petty tyrant because you are more resilient than that.
cues.zh: 我们的民主比小暴君的重重威胁更有弹性，因为你比那更有弹性。

cues.en: We in Massachusetts say no kings, not 250 years ago and not now.
cues.zh: 我们马萨诸塞州说没有国王，250 年前不是，现在也不是。

cues.en: No kings movement started here.
cues.zh: 这里没有国王运动开始。

cues.en: And our democracy, our democracy has more potential than the injustice and hate of Donald Trump and his racist, Xenophobic ICE thugs.
cues.zh: 我们的民主，我们的民主比唐纳德·特朗普及其种族主义者的不公正和仇恨更有潜力，仇外的 ICE 暴徒。

cues.en: We must abolish ICE now.
cues.zh: 我们现在必须废除 ICE。

cues.en: We are stronger.
cues.zh: 我们更强大。

cues.en: We are stronger because of our diversity.
cues.zh: 我们因我们的多样性而变得更强大。

cues.en: We are a nation of immigrants who built this country, and they deserve a pathway to citizenship.
cues.zh: 我们是一个由移民组成的国家，他们建立了这个国家，他们应该有一条获得公民身份的途径。

cues.en: But the fight, the fight to protect and rebuild our democracy won't take just some of us.
cues.zh: 但这场保护和重建民主的斗争不仅仅需要我们中的一些人。

cues.en: It will take all of us.
cues.zh: 这需要我们所有人。

cues.en: And that is I am hopeful in this moment, when there is so much fear and hate,
cues.zh: 这就是我在这一刻充满希望，当有如此多的恐惧和仇恨时，

cues.en: That is why I am optimistic because there are more of us than there are of them.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么我很乐观，因为我们的人数比他们的人数还要多。

cues.en: Because when we stand together with better ideas and stronger ideals, they don't stand a chance because the many will always beat the money Every single time.
cues.zh: 因为当我们与更好的想法和更坚定的理想站在一起时，他们就没有机会，因为多数人总是会打败金钱每一次。

cues.en: Massachusetts runs on Dunkin's, but we also run on resistance.
cues.zh: 马萨诸塞州靠唐恩都乐提神，也靠坚持抗争前行。

cues.en: My father, a union leader, taught me you don't beg for your rights,
cues.zh: 我的父亲是一名工会领袖，他教导我不要乞求自己的权利，

cues.en: You organize and you take them.
cues.zh: 你组织并接受它们。

cues.en: Our work is not done tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚我们的工作还没有完成。

cues.en: There is an epic fight before us in the weeks ahead in January with a new Congress,
cues.zh: 在接下来的一月份的几周里，我们将与新一届国会展开一场史诗般的战斗，

cues.en: And until we get Donald Trump out of the White House and we make GOP stand for get out and we make GOP stand
cues.zh: 直到我们让唐纳德·特朗普离开白宫，我们让共和党人代表滚蛋，我们让共和党人代表

cues.en: For get out permanently.
cues.zh: 为了永久退出。

cues.en: And that is because we don't agonize, we organize.
cues.zh: 那是因为我们不苦恼，我们组织。

cues.en: And every day, every day we organize for our democracy to reclaim it,
cues.zh: 每一天，每一天我们都组织起来争取我们的民主，以夺回它，

cues.en: To rebuild it so that every child, every family can have the chance to dream and to realize a better future.
cues.zh: 重建它，让每个孩子、每个家庭都有机会梦想并实现更美好的未来。

cues.en: We organize because we believe in something so big that it cannot be stopped.
cues.zh: 我们组织起来是因为我们相信一些大到无法阻止的事情。

cues.en: We believe in the power of the people.
cues.zh: 我们相信人民的力量。

cues.en: We believe in Medicare for all and health care as a human right.
cues.zh: 我们相信全民医疗保险和医疗保健是一项人权。

cues.en: We believe in streets free from gun violence.
cues.zh: 我们相信街道上没有枪支暴力。

cues.en: We believe in a world without war, and we believe in the unrelenting push for peace.
cues.zh: 我们相信世界可以没有战争，也相信应当坚持不懈地争取和平。

cues.en: We believe in civil rights and LGBTQ rights.
cues.zh: 我们相信公民权利和 LGBTQ 权利。

cues.en: We believe that trans rights are human rights.
cues.zh: 我们相信跨性别者的权利就是人权。

cues.en: And the Congress needs to pass my trans bill of rights.
cues.zh: 国会需要通过我的跨性别权利法案。

cues.en: A livable wage, reproductive freedom, universal childcare, paid sick leave for all workers,
cues.zh: 足以维持生计的工资、生育自由、全民儿童保育、所有工人的带薪病假、

cues.en: Free community college, free public college, a green new deal now.
cues.zh: 免费社区大学，免费公立大学，现在是绿色新政。

cues.en: An end to the illegal and immoral war in Iran and an end to bombing in gaza.
cues.zh: 结束伊朗非法和不道德的战争，结束加沙的轰炸。

cues.en: We must recommit to education, not we must recommit to education, not annihilation.
cues.zh: 我们必须重新致力于教育，而不是我们必须重新致力于教育，而不是消灭。

cues.en: This must be our agenda, our progressive agenda in the next Congress.
cues.zh: 这必须成为我们的议程，我们在下届国会中的进步议程。

cues.en: Yes.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: Most national election results are still coming in this evening, but no matter the outcome,
cues.zh: 大多数全国选举结果仍将在今晚公布，但无论结果如何，

cues.en: I am never giving up.
cues.zh: 我永远不会放弃。

cues.en: You are never giving up on our Massachusetts values.
cues.zh: 您永远不会放弃我们马萨诸塞州的价值观。

cues.en: And I know I am surrounded by people who feel the very same way.
cues.zh: 我知道我周围的人都有同样的感觉。

cues.en: A new day is rising in America.
cues.zh: 美国新的一天即将来临。

cues.en: It's And it's ours for the taking.
cues.zh: 这是我们的。

cues.en: If we have the resolve to seize it together, we will create a healthier,
cues.zh: 如果我们有决心共同抓住它，我们将创造一个更健康、

cues.en: Fairer, more prosperous, peaceful, and hope-filled future for everyone.
cues.zh: 为每个人带来更公平、更繁荣、更和平、更充满希望的未来。

cues.en: I'm Senator Ed Markey.
cues.zh: 我是参议员埃德·马基。

cues.en: It is the honor of my life to represent the Commonwealth of Massachusetts in the United States Senate.
cues.zh: 我一生很荣幸能够在美国参议院代表马萨诸塞州。

cues.en: We have got a fight ahead, and you haven't seen anything yet.
cues.zh: 我们前面有一场战斗，而你还没有看到任何东西。

cues.en: Thank you, Massachusetts.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，马萨诸塞州。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。
