cues.en: I don't know how to put into words the excitement and the joy that I feel.
cues.zh: 我不知道如何用语言来形容我所感受到的兴奋和喜悦。

cues.en: Um I know that I am so grateful to so many people in this room,
cues.zh: 嗯，我知道我非常感谢在座的这么多人，

cues.en: No one more than my wife, Robin, my son, Teddy, and that proof that there's a miracle left in each of us, Young Jack.
cues.zh: 没有人比我的妻子罗宾、我的儿子泰迪更能证明我们每个人都拥有奇迹，年轻的杰克.

cues.en: Do you know, there was a clear choice in this election.
cues.zh: 你知道吗，这次选举有一个明确的选择。

cues.en: There's no doubt that enough is enough.
cues.zh: 毫无疑问，够了就够了。

cues.en: Trump's corruption, all the price craziness, you could try you could choose corruption and cost of living despair,
cues.zh: 特朗普的腐败，所有的价格疯狂，你可以尝试你可以选择腐败和生活成本绝望，

cues.en: Or you could choose change.
cues.zh: 或者你可以选择改变。

cues.en: And this state chose change and this country is chose choosing change.
cues.zh: 这个国家选择了变革，这个国家选择了变革。

cues.en: I think it's worth just to take a minute to go back.
cues.zh: 我认为花一分钟时间回去是值得的。

cues.en: It's It's compressed time, you know, it's the opposite of dog years where it stretches out.
cues.zh: 这是压缩的时间，你知道，这与狗年的延长相反。

cues.en: So much of this happened so fast.
cues.zh: 这一切发生得太快了。

cues.en: And Trump came in and the first thing he started doing, I mean,
cues.zh: 特朗普进来了，他开始做的第一件事，我的意思是，

cues.en: He did some other bad things, but immediately he started dismantling our health care system, Right?
cues.zh: 他还做了一些其他坏事，但他立即开始拆除我们的医疗保健系统，正确的？

cues.en: The foundation of so much of what makes the American dream possible,
cues.zh: 使美国梦成为可能的许多因素的基础，

cues.en: And suddenly he was going to break apart.
cues.zh: 突然之间，他就要崩溃了。

cues.en: It took In Colorado, 240,000 people lost their coverage.
cues.zh: 在科罗拉多州，24万人失去了保险。

cues.en: Premiums doubled for literally hundreds of thousands more, all to pay for a trillion-dollar tax cut for the largest corporations and the wealthiest people In this country.
cues.zh: 保费翻了一番，实际上增加了数十万，所有这些都是为了为最大的公司和最富有的人提供数万亿美元的减税在这个国家。

cues.en: And then, he decided he'd do some tariffs.
cues.zh: 然后，他决定征收一些关税。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 正确的？

cues.en: At the same time, he's going to do some of the cruelest secret police work that any of us in this country have ever Seen.
cues.zh: 与此同时，他将从事一些我们这个国家任何人都曾做过的最残酷的秘密警察工作见过。

cues.en: And those tariffs and the atrocities of ICE where they would without even a judicial warrant,
cues.zh: 那些关税和 ICE 的暴行，甚至在没有司法令的情况下，

cues.en: They would pull cars over, drag people out of the car, beat them,
cues.zh: 他们会把车拦下来，把人从车里拖出来，殴打他们，

cues.en: Sometimes shoot them, lock them in detention facilities, shackle them, put them away.
cues.zh: 有时会枪杀他们，将他们锁在拘留所，给他们戴上脚镣，然后把他们收起来。

cues.en: All for this giant tax cut and to please a relatively small number of fringe people that wanted to go they wanted to go Crazy.
cues.zh: 这一切都是为了大幅减税，并取悦少数想要去的边缘人，他们想去疯了。

cues.en: Who did it hurt?
cues.zh: 伤害了谁？

cues.en: Think about the people that voted for Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 想想那些投票支持唐纳德·特朗普的人。

cues.en: So many ranchers and farmers.
cues.zh: 这么多牧场主和农民。

cues.en: And the cost increases in in diesel and gas and fertilizer.
cues.zh: 柴油、天然气和化肥的成本增加。

cues.en: The tariffs meaning they can't get a fair price for what they grow and raise.
cues.zh: 关税意味着他们种植和饲养的作物无法获得公平的价格。

cues.en: I mean, that is the cruelest of the cruel.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，这是残酷中最残酷的。

cues.en: All this culminates though and comes from perhaps the worst of it all and I'm sure there's a lot of disagreement here.
cues.zh: 所有这一切都达到了顶峰，并且可能来自最糟糕的情况，我确信这里存在很多分歧。

cues.en: Was he decides he's going to declare a war cuz he thought it'd be so easy.
cues.zh: 他决定宣战是因为他认为这很容易吗？

cues.en: And he thought it would have somehow lead him into some sense of glory.
cues.zh: 他认为这会以某种方式让他获得某种荣耀感。

cues.en: Has there ever been a worse war?
cues.zh: 曾经有过更严重的战争吗？

cues.en: I mean, there's no shortage of awful wars have been fought in this world.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，这个世界上不乏可怕的战争。

cues.en: But let's be clear.
cues.zh: 但我们要明确一点。

cues.en: That war has done more to divide and break apart things that we believed in for generations,
cues.zh: 这场战争进一步分裂和瓦解了我们几代人所信仰的事物，

cues.en: Our alliances, our trade relationships.
cues.zh: 我们的联盟，我们的贸易关系。

cues.en: Well, we're going to do now because the voters will is clear, we're going to get to rebuild what he took apart.
cues.zh: 好吧，我们现在就要做，因为选民的意愿很明确，我们将重建他拆散的东西。

cues.en: We're going to rewrite our health care system, not just the way it was,
cues.zh: 我们将重写我们的医疗保健系统，而不仅仅是原来的样子，

cues.en: But better than it was.
cues.zh: 但比以前好多了。

cues.en: We're going to expand coverage, have a better system.
cues.zh: 我们将扩大覆盖范围，拥有更好的系统。

cues.en: We're going to fix our tax code and make sure that people just starting out at the bottom have a solid floor but no Ceiling.
cues.zh: 我们将修改我们的税法，并确保刚刚从底层开始的人们有一个坚实的基础，但没有天花板。

cues.en: That they can go as high as their dream takes them.
cues.zh: 他们的梦想可以到达多高的高度。

cues.en: And we're finally in that process going to Well, as Jon Ossoff said,
cues.zh: 我们终于进入了这个过程，正如乔恩·奥索夫所说，

cues.en: Trump promised to to unrig the economy.
cues.zh: 特朗普承诺将整顿经济。

cues.en: He didn't unrig it.
cues.zh: 他没有拆开它。

cues.en: He re-rigged it for himself.
cues.zh: 他为自己重新装备了它。

cues.en: We are going to finally unrig the economy and let everybody have a shot.
cues.zh: 我们将最终放松经济，让每个人都有机会。

cues.en: Our economy works if if you're well off and well connected, it works fine.
cues.zh: 如果你富裕且人脉广泛，我们的经济就会运转良好。

cues.en: If you're not, well, you get left behind.
cues.zh: 如果你不是，那么，你就会被抛在后面。

cues.en: And I think this notion that we could build a foundation for the American dream to once become once again become real for people,
cues.zh: 我认为我们可以为美国梦奠定基础，让人们再次成为现实，

cues.en: Where we can have universal coverage, where everybody ha- has a medical home,
cues.zh: 在那里我们可以实现全民覆盖，每个人都有一个医疗之家，

cues.en: Where there's a doctor that knows their family and their history and can take care of them when they're in need,
cues.zh: 如果有一位医生了解他们的家庭和病史，可以在他们有需要时照顾他们，

cues.en: Where we can make sure that we have an education system that's affordable and actually leads to better jobs.
cues.zh: 我们可以确保我们拥有一个负担得起的教育体系，并且实际上可以带来更好的就业机会。

cues.en: We will have to have some oversight and some hearings into the corruption.
cues.zh: 我们必须对腐败行为进行一些监督和听证会。

cues.en: But let's not Yeah, yeah, whoo.
cues.zh: 但我们不要是啊，是啊，哇哦。

cues.en: We'll get to the bottom of some of this illegal activity.
cues.zh: 我们将彻查一些非法活动的真相。

cues.en: But let's not lose our our our Let's make sure we keep our eye on the ball and make sure that we are building For the future.
cues.zh: 但我们不要失去我们的 让我们确保我们密切关注并确保我们正在建设为了未来。

cues.en: That we're making sure that all that money that President Trump was borrowing,
cues.zh: 我们要确保特朗普总统借的所有钱，

cues.en: Which he was taking away from our grandchildren, that we're putting that back into good investments in our infrastructure and our education.
cues.zh: 他从我们的孙辈那里夺走了这些，我们正在将其重新投入到我们的基础设施和教育的良好投资中。

cues.en: So, clearly tonight, this was a night where we had, you know, no doubt.
cues.zh: 所以，今晚显然，毫无疑问，这是我们度过的一个夜晚。

cues.en: And it's still going on.
cues.zh: 而且这种情况仍在继续。

cues.en: It's going to be a night that I'm going to remember for the rest of my life.
cues.zh: 这将是一个我终生难忘的夜晚。

cues.en: You know, lying and cheating, we know that doesn't work.
cues.zh: 你知道，撒谎和欺骗，我们知道这是行不通的。

cues.en: And yet all of us, or at least most I know I did,
cues.zh: 然而我们所有人，或者至少我知道我做到了，

cues.en: Had some doubts, right?
cues.zh: 有一些疑问，对吗？

cues.en: That maybe lying and cheating you can get away with it.
cues.zh: 也许说谎和欺骗你可以逃脱惩罚。

cues.en: Well, we're not going to let it anybody get away with it.
cues.zh: 好吧，我们不会让任何人得逞。

cues.en: We're going to go back.
cues.zh: 我们要回去了。

cues.zh: 正如约翰斯顿市长所说，我们将奠定基础，当我们第一次开始谈论此事时，我就在场

title: Sen. Mark Warner gives victory speech following re-election

cues.en: What a night.
cues.zh: 多么美好的一个夜晚啊。

cues.en: Um First of all, I'm incredibly grateful for the people of Virginia for putting your trust in me one more time.
cues.zh: 嗯，首先，我非常感谢弗吉尼亚人民再次信任我。

cues.en: Eliza pretty damn good job.
cues.zh: 伊丽莎干得非常好。

cues.en: I want to thank eliza.
cues.zh: 我要感谢伊丽莎。

cues.en: My wonderful wife, Lisa.
cues.zh: 我很棒的妻子，丽莎。

cues.en: Gillian two new additions to our family, son-in-law and future son-in-law, Pete and Ferris and one of my two great grandchildren, Charlie.
cues.zh: 阿娇，我们家的两位新成员，女婿和未来的女婿，皮特和费里斯，以及我的两个曾孙之一，查理.

cues.en: Give it up for charlie.
cues.zh: 为了查理，放弃吧。

cues.en: You know, as as eliza said you know, growing up as the governor's or the senator's kid meant um I missed a lot of Games.
cues.zh: 你知道，正如伊丽莎所说，你知道，作为州长或参议员的孩子长大意味着我错过了很多游戏。

cues.en: We interrupted some vacations.
cues.zh: 我们中断了一些假期。

cues.en: And Lord knows there were more political conversations at our meal table than most should have to put up with.
cues.zh: 天知道我们餐桌上的政治对话比大多数人应该忍受的还要多。

cues.en: But I am so incredibly proud of all three of my daughters who they are and what they've become.
cues.zh: 但我为我的三个女儿感到非常自豪，她们是谁以及她们已经成为什么样的人。

cues.en: I want to thank our incredible campaign team led by my dear friend and relentless worker,
cues.zh: 我要感谢由我亲爱的朋友和不懈的工作人员领导的令人难以置信的竞选团队，

cues.en: Zach Golden, and all of the team.
cues.zh: 扎克·戈尔登，以及整个团队。

cues.en: And everyone who knocked on doors, made those calls uh worked their tail off.
cues.zh: 每个敲门的人都在竭尽全力地打电话。

cues.en: I to thank all my donors.
cues.zh: 我要感谢我所有的捐助者。

cues.en: I know at times you didn't really believe in the last couple of days that might said,
cues.zh: 我知道有时你并不真正相信过去几天可能会说的，

cues.en: "Well, they could drop a hundred million dollar super pack on me tomorrow."
cues.zh: “嗯，明天他们可能会给我扔一个亿美元的超级礼包。”

cues.en: And what about our two great members of Congress, Don Beyer and James Ransone?
cues.zh: 那么我们两位伟大的国会议员唐·拜尔和詹姆斯·兰索恩又如何呢？

cues.en: Give it up for them.
cues.zh: 为了他们放弃吧

cues.en: And yes, I would acknowledge Terry McAuliffe and I have been friends for 46 years,
cues.zh: 是的，我承认特里·麦考利夫和我已经是 46 年的朋友了，

cues.en: And you were my boss for a nano second.
cues.zh: 在那一刻你还是我的老板。

cues.en: And if we could Terry's been a great friend, a great governor,
cues.zh: 如果可以的话，特里是一位好朋友，一位伟大的州长，

cues.en: A great leader of our party.
cues.zh: 我们党的伟大领袖。

cues.en: And my gosh, Terry, if we could ever bring you out of your shell.
cues.zh: 天哪，特里，如果我们能把你从你的壳里带出来就好了。

cues.en: Thank you for that.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: And for those of you who don't know either speaker, Don Scott, or Lieutenant Governor Ghazala Hashmi,
cues.zh: 对于那些不认识议长唐·斯科特或副州长加扎拉·哈希米的人来说，

cues.en: They are incredible leaders, and I can assure you they make me so comfortable but the next generation of Virginia leaders are here and
cues.zh: 他们是令人难以置信的领导人，我可以向你保证，他们让我感到很舒服，但下一代弗吉尼亚领导人就在这里，

cues.en: Ready for the job.
cues.zh: 准备好工作了。

cues.en: Thank you, Ghazala and Don.
cues.zh: 谢谢你们，加扎拉和唐。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: And I was going to go through all those other candidates as we are still since we're still counting the votes,
cues.zh: 我打算像现在一样审查所有其他候选人，因为我们仍在计票，

cues.en: But Terry's declared them all winners already.
cues.zh: 但特里已经宣布他们都是赢家。

cues.en: Cuz the truth is Don and James and I are going to actually have more Democratic colleagues,
cues.zh: 因为事实是唐、詹姆斯和我实际上将会有更多的民主党同事，

cues.en: And the path to Hakeem Jeffries being speaker leads through Virginia.
cues.zh: 哈基姆·杰弗里斯 (Hakeem Jeffries) 成为议长的途径是弗吉尼亚州。

cues.en: You know, um this is my last campaign.
cues.zh: 你知道，嗯，这是我最后一次竞选。

cues.en: Um I wasn't going to use this line, but I'll use it since you booed.
cues.zh: 嗯，我本来不打算使用这条线，但既然你发出了嘘声，我就会使用它。

cues.en: I do work at the only place in America where at age 71,
cues.zh: 我71岁时在美国唯一一个工作的地方

cues.en: I'm still lower middle-aged.
cues.zh: 我还不到中年呢。

cues.en: Which is both true and pathetic.
cues.zh: 这既真实又可悲。

cues.en: Uh, but I was thinking back to my first campaign in 1996.
cues.zh: 呃，但我回想起 1996 年我的第一次竞选。

cues.en: And some of you have been on that journey with me.
cues.zh: 你们中的一些人和我一起踏上了这段旅程。

cues.en: Uh, since that time.
cues.zh: 呃，从那时起。

cues.en: And I'm grateful for your friendships, I'm grateful for your patience.
cues.zh: 我感谢你们的友谊，感谢你们的耐心。

cues.en: And I tell you I um I did take kind of take a crazy race.
cues.zh: 我告诉你，我确实参加了一场疯狂的比赛。

cues.en: I ran against John Warner.
cues.zh: 我与约翰·华纳竞选。

cues.en: And it was the famous Warner versus Warner race, and I promise this will be the last time I use this ever.
cues.zh: 这是著名的华纳对华纳比赛，我保证这将是我最后一次使用它。

cues.en: We did have a bumper sticker that said Mark, not John.
cues.zh: 我们的保险杠贴纸上确实写着马克，而不是约翰。

cues.en: And in Danville, somebody looked at the bumper sticker and said, "Excuse me,
cues.zh: 在丹维尔，有人看着保险杠贴纸说：“对不起，

cues.en: Mark, is that a biblical reference?"
cues.zh: 马克，这是圣经的参考文献吗？”

cues.en: No divine intervention.
cues.zh: 没有神圣的干预。

cues.en: John won, but John Warner taught me a lot.
cues.zh: 约翰赢了，但约翰·华纳教会了我很多。

cues.en: He taught me that we could disagree, but if we still put our country first,
cues.zh: 他告诉我，我们可以不同意，但如果我们仍然把我们的国家放在第一位，

cues.en: We could find common ground.
cues.zh: 我们可以找到共同点。

cues.en: We found ways to work together when I was governor.
cues.zh: 当我担任州长时，我们找到了合作的方法。

cues.en: One of the things I was proudest of is that he endorsed me when I ran for re-election in the Senate.
cues.zh: 我最自豪的事情之一是，当我竞选参议院连任时，他支持我。

cues.en: And I spoke at his funeral.
cues.zh: 我在他的葬礼上发表了讲话。

cues.en: That kind of politics where we can disagree, but still find common ground and that love for our country and our Commonwealth,
cues.zh: 在这种政治中，我们可以有不同意见，但仍然可以找到共同点以及对我们国家和本州的热爱，

cues.en: God knows we need more of that in our country today.
cues.zh: 上帝知道我们今天的国家需要更多这样的东西。

cues.en: You know, after I got the silver medal in 1996, Virginians gave me another chance in 2001.
cues.zh: 你知道，在我1996年获得银牌之后，弗吉尼亚人在2001年又给了我一次机会。

cues.en: And I was proud to be elected governor then.
cues.zh: 当时我很自豪能够当选州长。

cues.en: Proud of the fact that I even with the two-to-one Republican legislature, we found common cause.
cues.zh: 令我感到自豪的是，即使在两对一的共和党立法机构中，我们也找到了共同的目标。

cues.en: We made record investments in education.
cues.zh: 我们在教育方面的投资创纪录。

cues.en: We remembered parts of the Commonwealth that have too often been left behind.
cues.zh: 我们记得英本州经常被抛在后面的部分地区。

cues.en: We found ways to be recognized as the best managed state, the best state for business,
cues.zh: 我们找到了被公认为最佳管理国家、最佳商业国家的方法，

cues.en: And the thing most importantly, the best state to receive an education from from preschool to graduate school.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，从学前班到研究生院接受教育的最佳状态。

cues.en: Of course, I also learned one thing.
cues.zh: 当然，我还学到了一件事。

cues.en: As governor, it's a little bit easier being governor than being one of a hundred in the Senate.
cues.zh: 作为州长，当州长比成为参议院一百人中的一员要容易一些。

cues.en: And it's been a journey in the Senate.
cues.zh: 这是参议院的一段旅程。

cues.en: But I'm still proud of this last term where we did the infrastructure bill which was providing broadband to those parts of Virginia that Were left behind.
cues.zh: 但我仍然为上个学期感到自豪，我们制定了基础设施法案，为弗吉尼亚州的那些地区提供宽带被抛在后面。

cues.en: When we ended up capping insulin at $35.
cues.zh: 当我们最终将胰岛素上限限制在 35 美元时。

cues.en: When we brought semiconductor manufacturing back to America.
cues.zh: 当我们将半导体制造带回美国时。

cues.en: When we recognized that America's position in the world is based not only because it's military and its economy,
cues.zh: 当我们认识到美国在世界上的地位不仅是因为它的军事和经济，

cues.en: But because we for years, literally post World War have been viewed as the guiding light,
cues.zh: 但因为我们多年来，实际上是在第二次世界大战后，一直被视为指路明灯，

cues.en: The good guys in the world.
cues.zh: 世间皆有好人。

cues.en: Now, that has all been put at grip at risk more recently.
cues.zh: 现在，这一切最近都面临风险。

cues.en: Um You know, when I think back about this and it's a little It is a very kind of full circle night, Eliza.
cues.zh: 嗯，你知道，当我回想起这件事时，这是一个非常圆满的夜晚，伊丽莎。

cues.en: When I ran in 1996, I never thought I would be actually asking you one last time to vote for me 30 years later.
cues.zh: 当我 1996 年竞选时，我从未想过 30 年后我会最后一次请求你们投票给我。

cues.en: And there's a lot of things that I couldn't have imagined in 1996 and 20 about 2026.
cues.zh: 还有很多事情是我在1996年和2026年无法想象的。

cues.en: For example, I couldn't imagine that, you know, I was at the beginning of this,
cues.zh: 例如，我无法想象，你知道，我在一开始，

cues.en: You know, whole thing around cell phones.
cues.zh: 你知道，一切都围绕着手机。

cues.en: And it's been a you know, I knew it was going to be big.
cues.zh: 这是一个你知道的，我知道它会很大。

cues.en: I just never realized 30 years later they'd be used for everything but having a telephone conversation.
cues.zh: 我只是从未意识到 30 年后它们会被用于除电话通话之外的所有用途。

cues.en: I couldn't have imagined that AI writing term papers or changing our economy in a fundamental way or creating images that Dave Marsden never
cues.zh: 我无法想象人工智能会撰写学期论文或从根本上改变我们的经济或创造戴夫·马斯登从未做过的图像

cues.en: Really did in person.
cues.zh: 确实是亲自做的。

cues.en: And I definitely couldn't have imagined Donald Trump winning the presidency not once but twice.
cues.zh: 我绝对无法想象唐纳德·特朗普不仅一次而是两次赢得总统职位。

cues.en: Now, people say, "Well, you know, Mark, you a pretty good run.
cues.zh: 现在，人们说：“马克，你知道，你跑得很好。

cues.en: Why did you Why are you asking folks this last fourth this last time?"
cues.zh: 为什么你上次问大家为什么要问最后四分之一？”

cues.en: Um because there was one person in particular um who was I made this decision wasn't going to let me decide anything else.
cues.zh: 嗯，因为有一个特别的人，嗯，我做出了这个决定，不会让我决定其他任何事情。

cues.en: That was my daughter, Madison.
cues.zh: 那是我的女儿麦迪逊。

cues.en: And she was one of my longest supporters, obviously.
cues.zh: 显然，她是我最长久的支持者之一。

cues.en: She was never shy about telling me what she thought.
cues.zh: 她从不羞于告诉我她的想法。

cues.en: She was never shy about telling me what I was not doing right or how I could improve.
cues.zh: 她从不羞于告诉我哪些地方做得不对，或者我可以如何改进。

cues.en: But what she said particularly in the last months of her life was,
cues.zh: 但她在生命的最后几个月尤其说的是，

cues.en: "You know, Dad, you got the power.
cues.zh: “你知道，爸爸，你有权力。

cues.en: You got to make do things every day to make things better."
cues.zh: 你必须每天都去做事情才能让事情变得更好。”

cues.en: And while there is not a day that our family doesn't desperately miss Madison and the joy she brought to our lives and so
cues.zh: 虽然我们的家人每一天都非常想念麦迪逊和她给我们的生活带来的欢乐，所以

cues.en: Many others, I know that I am more committed to that notion of having been rehired tonight to commit every day I'm in the
cues.zh: 我知道对于其他许多人来说，我更坚定地相信今晚被重新雇用，并承诺在工作中的每一天

cues.en: Shop to making things better.
cues.zh: 购物是为了让事情变得更好。

cues.en: And now because I mean, we've seen this president who frankly doesn't think the rules apply to him.
cues.zh: 现在，因为我的意思是，我们看到这位总统坦率地认为这些规则不适用于他。

cues.en: And an administration, and not just him, but the grifters and grafters around him who don't see public office as a way to serve,
cues.zh: 一个政府，不仅是他，还有他周围的骗子和贪污者，他们不认为公职是一种服务方式，

cues.en: But as a way for actual personal enrichment.
cues.zh: 但作为实际个人致富的一种方式。

cues.en: A government that we've seen time and again, and I've seen this with my Republican colleagues who I know love our country,
cues.zh: 我们一次又一次见过这样的政府，我和我的共和党同事也见过这样的政府，我知道他们热爱我们的国家，

cues.en: But somehow have seemed to have lost their spine and seem to put loyalty to that person more importantly than loyal to our country
cues.zh: 但不知怎的，他们似乎失去了脊梁，似乎把对那个人的忠诚比对我们国家的忠诚更重要

cues.en: And what our country stands for.
cues.zh: 以及我们国家的主张。

cues.en: And I've seen Virginia families working so hard and playing by the rules and still falling behind.
cues.zh: 我看到弗吉尼亚州的家庭如此努力工作并遵守规则，但仍然落后。

cues.en: Well, tariffs there's nothing but a tax.
cues.zh: 好吧，关税只不过是一种税。

cues.en: A reckless war in Iran that didn't ever need to happen.
cues.zh: 伊朗发生了一场根本不需要发生的鲁莽战争。

cues.en: Make their life harder.
cues.zh: 让他们的生活更加艰难。

cues.en: You know, I don't think Virginians should have to pay more at the grocery store,
cues.zh: 你知道，我认为弗吉尼亚人不应该在杂货店支付更多费用，

cues.en: At the gas pump, or on electric bills because of decisions coming out of DC.
cues.zh: 由于华盛顿特区的决定，在加油站或电费账单上。

cues.en: And I don't think the President of the United States should be focused on enriching himself and his friends at the expense of our Great nation.
cues.zh: 我认为美国总统不应该专注于以牺牲我们的利益为代价来让自己和他的朋友致富。伟大的民族。

cues.en: You know, for 30 years I got the honor of doing public service.
cues.zh: 你知道，三十年来我有幸从事公共服务。

cues.en: And there's kind of one rule.
cues.zh: 有一种规则。

cues.en: You know, you always got to put the people you work for first.
cues.zh: 你知道，你总是必须把你为之工作的人放在第一位。

cues.en: My view is this is a job and you've been kind enough to hire me.
cues.zh: 我的观点是，这只是一份工作，而且你很友善地雇用了我。

cues.en: And that notion of putting you first is what's going to guide me in this last term.
cues.zh: “把你放在第一位”的理念将在最后一个学期指导我。

cues.en: You know, I always think America and particularly those of us as Democrats are at our best when we look forward.

cues.zh: 致我的兄弟菲尔。

cues.en: You are the only person in the entire world who fully understands what we endured growing up together.
cues.zh: 你是全世界唯一一个完全理解我们一起成长所经历的一切的人。

cues.en: And it was incredibly brave of you to share your story with the world.
cues.zh: 你与世界分享你的故事真是太勇敢了。

cues.en: Thank you from the bottom of my heart for fighting for me.
cues.zh: 我从心底感谢你们为我而战。

cues.en: I love you so.
cues.zh: 我是如此爱你。

cues.en: I do.
cues.zh: 我愿意。

cues.en: Thank you, Laura.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，劳拉。

cues.en: To my family, um, Eric and the kids, all our friends who are here,
cues.zh: 我的家人，嗯，埃里克和孩子们，我们所有在场的朋友，

cues.en: And there are so many here.
cues.zh: 这里有很多。

cues.en: I'm so grateful.
cues.zh: 我很感激。

cues.en: I love you as my husband and I always say forever and ever.
cues.zh: 我爱你就像我的丈夫一样，我总是说永远永远。

cues.en: Most importantly, thank you, Ohio.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，谢谢你，俄亥俄州。

cues.en: None of this would have been possible without us linking arms and pushing back.
cues.zh: 如果没有我们挽起双臂并奋力反击，这一切都是不可能实现的。

cues.en: Because of you, this stopped being just another campaign.
cues.zh: 因为你们，这不再只是另一场活动。

cues.en: It became a movement and I am so grateful to every one of you and I'm gonna be asking more of you yet.
cues.zh: 这成为了一场运动，我非常感谢你们每一个人，我还会向你们提出更多的要求。

cues.en: I have a deep belief in the resilience, the grit, and the kindness of our state and I wouldn't be here without it.
cues.zh: 我对我们国家的韧性、勇气和仁慈深信不疑，没有它我就不会在这里。

cues.en: Ohio, thank you for trusting and believing in me.
cues.zh: 俄亥俄州，感谢您对我的信任和信任。

cues.en: I trust and believe in you.
cues.zh: 我信任并相信你。

cues.en: It will take time to rebuild and create the Ohio we all dream of.
cues.zh: 重建和创建我们都梦想的俄亥俄州需要时间。

cues.en: We didn't get here overnight.
cues.zh: 我们不是一夜之间到达这里的。

cues.en: In the days and years ahead, I'm going to be asking more of all of us.
cues.zh: 在未来的日子和岁月里，我将对我们所有人提出更多的要求。

cues.en: We will heal this thing that has been broken.
cues.zh: 我们将治愈这个已经破碎的东西。

cues.en: And we will not give up on one another.
cues.zh: 我们不会互相放弃。

cues.en: Please don't give up on anyone in your life.
cues.zh: 请不要放弃生命中的任何人。

cues.en: Even your friends, your family, people who might have voted different you.
cues.zh: 甚至是你的朋友、你的家人、那些可能投票反对你的人。

cues.en: We've got to heal this thing together.
cues.zh: 我们必须一起治愈这件事。

cues.en: We are going to make life more affordable in Ohio.
cues.zh: 我们将使俄亥俄州的生活变得更加实惠。

cues.en: We are going to end the cost of corruption and we're going to build a state where all of us can get ahead.
cues.zh: 我们将消除腐败的代价，我们将建立一个人人都能取得成功的国家。

cues.en: Now, I will work with anyone to do this, but I want to be if I want to be very clear.
cues.zh: 现在，我将与任何人合作来做到这一点，但如果我想非常清楚的话，我想这样做。

cues.en: I will be a relentless warrior for Ohio.
cues.zh: 我将成为俄亥俄州的一名无情的战士。

cues.en: To those who might want to exploit our state or to take us back into the hate,
cues.zh: 对于那些可能想利用本州或让我们重新陷入仇恨的人，

cues.en: Chaos, and vitrial, do not underestimate a scrappy kid from Youngtown.
cues.zh: 混乱和激烈，不要低估一个来自扬敦的好斗的孩子。

cues.en: And do not underestimate the people of Ohio.
cues.zh: 不要低估俄亥俄州人民。

cues.en: I love Ohio.
cues.zh: 我爱俄亥俄州。

cues.en: It has always been and will always be Ohio.
cues.zh: 俄亥俄州一直是、也将永远是。

cues.en: We are the heart of it all.
cues.zh: 我们是这一切的核心。

cues.en: For me, that is what this race has always been about.
cues.zh: 对我来说，这就是这场比赛一直以来的意义。

cues.en: Putting the heart back in the heart of it all.
cues.zh: 将心放回一切的中心。

cues.en: I want to build an Ohio that leads with integrity, with decency, where everyone can write their own story,
cues.zh: 我想建立一个正直、正派的俄亥俄州，每个人都可以写下自己的故事，

cues.en: Where every kid gets a fair shot.
cues.zh: 每个孩子都能得到公平的机会。

cues.en: I know I'm not the only one who saw a thing or two in their childhood in this room.
cues.zh: 我知道我不是唯一一个在这个房间里看到过童年时期一两件事的人。

cues.en: None of us gets out of this thing unscathed.
cues.zh: 我们没有人能毫发无伤地摆脱这件事。

cues.en: But our stories, Ohio's story is one of resilience, of grit, of grace,
cues.zh: 但我们的故事，俄亥俄州的故事是一个关于韧性、勇气、恩典的故事，

cues.en: And yes, of hope.
cues.zh: 是的，充满希望。

cues.en: Of hope.
cues.zh: 充满希望。

cues.en: Hope is what drives this movement.
cues.zh: 希望是推动这一运动的动力。

cues.en: Because when we are in this together, we can build the Ohio of our dreams.
cues.zh: 因为当我们齐心协力时，我们就能建设我们梦想中的俄亥俄州。

cues.en: Tonight, one journey is coming to an end, but a new chapter in Ohio is beginning tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚，一段旅程即将结束，但俄亥俄州的新篇章今晚即将开始。

cues.en: Tonight, let us celebrate.
cues.zh: 今晚，让我们庆祝一下。

cues.en: Tomorrow, let us get to work.
cues.zh: 明天，让我们开始工作吧。

cues.en: Together, we are going to build an Ohio where no matter where you were born, You belong.
cues.zh: 我们将共同建设一个俄亥俄州，无论你出生在哪里，你属于。

cues.en: You can build the life of your dreams and you can be whoever you want to be.
cues.zh: 你可以建立你梦想的生活，你可以成为任何你想成为的人。

cues.en: Maybe even governor.
cues.zh: 也许甚至是州长。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Thank you for trusting and believing in me.
cues.zh: 感谢您对我的信任和信任。

cues.en: I love you, too.
cues.zh: 我也爱你。

cues.en: I will be with you, fighting alongside of you every step of the way.
cues.zh: 我会和你在一起，与你并肩作战。

cues.en: Thank you, Ohio.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，俄亥俄州。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

speaker: Jocelyn Benson
role: 密歇根州 · 候任州长
title: Jocelyn Benson delivers victory speech, as AP projects her as winner of Michigan governor race

cues.en: Hello, Michigan.
cues.zh: 你好，密歇根州。

cues.en: Wow.
cues.zh: 哇。

cues.en: Well, my friends, it's been quite a night.
cues.zh: 好吧，我的朋友们，这真是一个美好的夜晚。

cues.en: I think it's been a really great night for Democrats all across the country and right here in Michigan.
cues.zh: 我认为对于全国各地以及密歇根州的民主党人来说，这真是一个美好的夜晚。

cues.en: The voters of Michigan have spoken in recordbreaking turnout.
cues.zh: 密歇根州选民的发言投票率创历史新高。

cues.en: And I am honored to stand before you as the next governor of Michigan.
cues.zh: 我很荣幸能够作为下一任密歇根州州长站在你们面前。

cues.en: And I am equally thrilled that I will be heading to Lancing with a Democratic trifecta.
cues.zh: 我同样很高兴我将带着民主党三连胜前往兰辛。

cues.en: Listen, for 22 months, I have been asking you one question.
cues.zh: 听着，22 个月来，我一直在问你一个问题。

cues.en: Who do you want your leaders to work for?
cues.zh: 你希望你的领导为谁工作？

cues.en: And my friends, the voters of Michigan have answered loud and clear.
cues.zh: 我的朋友们，密歇根州的选民已经大声而明确地回答了。

cues.en: They want leaders who will work for you and every person in the state of Michigan.
cues.zh: 他们需要能够为您和密歇根州每个人工作的领导者。

cues.en: In this election, from the western reaches of the upper peninsula to downtown Detroit,
cues.zh: 在这次选举中，从上半岛西端到底特律市中心，

cues.en: Voters sent a clear message.
cues.zh: 选民发出了明确的信息。

cues.en: They want leaders who will fight for them, fight to lower costs, fight to grow our economy,
cues.zh: 他们希望领导人能够为他们而战，为降低成本而战，为发展我们的经济而战，

cues.en: Fight the corruption that too often protects the pe powerful and hurts the people.
cues.zh: 打击腐败，这种腐败常常保护权贵而伤害人民。

cues.en: And in this election, we showed the nation that in our democracy, the power of the people will always rule the day.
cues.zh: 在这次选举中，我们向全国表明，在我们的民主制度下，人民的力量将永远统治一切。

cues.en: My friend, this is this win is a victory for every one of us.
cues.zh: 我的朋友，这是我们每个人的胜利。

cues.en: Every Michigander like my friend Gwen and so many others.
cues.zh: 每个密歇根人都喜欢我的朋友格温和其他许多人。

cues.en: It's so beautiful to see you tonight.
cues.zh: 今晚见到你真是太好了。

cues.en: My friend Gwen has to look at her bills every night and wonder how to make ends meet.
cues.zh: 我的朋友格温每天晚上都要查看她的账单，想知道如何维持收支平衡。

cues.en: And I know so many Michiganers feel that same way.
cues.zh: 我知道很多密歇根人也有同样的感觉。

cues.en: But Gwen, tonight this is a victory for you and all of us.
cues.zh: 但是格温，今晚这对你和我们所有人来说都是一场胜利。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: It is a win for our kids.
cues.zh: 这对我们的孩子来说是一场胜利。

cues.en: Our kids who deserve to grow up in a state that is the best place in the nation to call home.
cues.zh: 我们的孩子应该在这个国家最好的家乡长大。

cues.en: And it is a win for our young girls who tonight can look up and for the first time in our state's history,
cues.zh: 这对我们的年轻女孩来说是一场胜利，她们今晚可以抬起头来，这在我们州历史上是第一次，

cues.en: For the first time in our state's history, see two women leading this state.
cues.zh: 在我们州的历史上，这是第一次看到两位女性领导本州。

cues.en: As governor and lieutenant governor, who will work together every day to ensure that young girls and women always have access to the health
cues.zh: 作为州长和副州长，他们将每天共同努力，确保年轻女孩和妇女始终获得健康

cues.en: Care they need and the rights and freedoms they deserve.
cues.zh: 他们需要照顾以及他们应得的权利和自由。

cues.en: And my friends, it's also a win for democracy because our Democratic trifecta.
cues.zh: 我的朋友们，这也是民主的胜利，因为我们的民主三连胜。

cues.en: Feels good to say that, doesn't it?
cues.zh: 这么说感觉很好，不是吗？

cues.en: Our Democratic trifecta is going to go to Lancing and pass a voting rights act for the state of Michigan to ensure that every
cues.zh: 我们的民主党三连胜将前往兰辛并通过密歇根州的投票权法案，以确保每个人

cues.en: Citizen in this state is protected at the ballot box in every election.
cues.zh: 该州的公民在每次选举的投票箱中都受到保护。

cues.en: Tonight, I just want to say thank you.
cues.zh: 今晚，我只想说声谢谢。

cues.en: Thank you to those of you who stayed here much longer and many longer hours than you might have thought,
cues.zh: 感谢你们在这里停留的时间比你们想象的要长得多，

cues.en: But who worked also for days and months in the better part of two years to knock doors,
cues.zh: 但他们在两年的大部分时间里也工作了几天和几个月来敲门，

cues.en: Make phone calls, have thousands of conversations with voters in all 83 counties.
cues.zh: 拨打电话，与所有 83 个县的选民进行数千次对话。

cues.en: This win is for you.
cues.zh: 这场胜利属于你。

cues.en: And I want to a special note to the hardest working campaign staff in the business.
cues.zh: 我想特别提醒业内最努力工作的竞选工作人员。

cues.en: An incredible group of people led by women, including my day one campaign manager,
cues.zh: 一群令人难以置信的由女性领导的人，包括我第一天的竞选经理，

cues.en: Nikki Goldshine, and the best communications policy deputy campaign manager in the nation, Alyssa Bradley.
cues.zh: Nikki Goldshine，全国最好的传播政策副竞选经理，艾莉莎·布拉德利。

cues.en: They along with so many of our teams from Jesse to Ashley to Wes to Alec to Mary.
cues.zh: 他们以及我们的许多团队，从杰西到阿什利，从韦斯到亚历克，再到玛丽。

cues.en: I love all of you.
cues.zh: 我爱你们所有人。

cues.en: You worked the long nights.
cues.zh: 你熬夜工作。

cues.en: You took on the tough challenges and you never stopped believing in our mission.
cues.zh: 你们接受了严峻的挑战，并且从未停止相信我们的使命。

cues.en: Your work, your dedication, your commitment, made this victory possible.
cues.zh: 你们的工作、你们的奉献、你们的承诺使这一胜利成为可能。

cues.en: And I hope everyone takes a moment tonight to be proud of what we've all accomplished together.
cues.zh: 我希望今晚每个人都能花一点时间为我们共同取得的成就感到自豪。

cues.en: To Winnie Brinks, our incredible lieutenant governor elect.
cues.zh: 致温妮·布林克斯（Winnie Brinks），我们令人难以置信的当选副州长。

cues.en: Together, we've made history and with you as my partner, we are going to deliver for the state of Michigan.
cues.zh: 我们一起创造了历史，作为我的合作伙伴，我们将为密歇根州做出贡献。

cues.en: And finally, to my family, you know, this campaign was quite a journey.
cues.zh: 最后，对于我的家人来说，这次竞选是一次相当长的旅程。

cues.en: It wasn't always an easy one, but on the good days and the bad,
cues.zh: 这并不总是一件容易的事，但无论顺境还是逆境，

cues.en: You were always there to light the way forward.
cues.zh: 你总是在那里照亮前进的道路。

cues.en: In Ryan, you will have the first spouse of a governor in state history who is a combat veteran.
cues.zh: 在瑞安，您将拥有该州历史上第一位退伍军人州长的配偶。

cues.en: And in Aiden, you will have a first kid who reminds us every day why this fight matters.
cues.zh: 在艾登，你将拥有第一个孩子，他每天都会提醒我们为什么这场战斗很重要。

cues.en: Like all of you, we know that every family deserves the chance to keep their loved ones happy,
cues.zh: 和大家一样，我们知道每个家庭都应该有机会让亲人幸福，

cues.en: Healthy, safe, and thriving.
cues.zh: 健康、安全、繁荣。

cues.en: And every child deserves a future that is limitless.
cues.zh: 每个孩子都应该拥有无限的未来。

cues.en: Michigan, we're gonna build that future for all of our kids together.
cues.zh: 密歇根州，我们将共同为我们所有的孩子建设这样的未来。

cues.en: And now the we are and now the work begins.
cues.zh: 现在我们就是这样，现在工作开始了。

cues.en: The challenges ahead are serious.
cues.zh: 未来的挑战是严峻的。

cues.en: There will be disagreements, difficult decisions, and days when the work feels harder than we imagined.
cues.zh: 会有分歧、困难的决定，以及工作感觉比我们想象的更困难的日子。

cues.en: But I know what Michiganers can accomplish when we come together around a common purpose.
cues.zh: 但我知道当我们围绕一个共同的目标聚集在一起时，密歇根人可以取得什么成就。

cues.en: Because because here in Michigan, I will because here in Michigan, we lead.
cues.zh: 因为在密歇根这里，我会因为在密歇根这里，我们处于领先地位。

cues.en: We put the world on wheels.
cues.zh: 我们把世界装在轮子上。

cues.en: We built the middle class.
cues.zh: 我们建立了中产阶级。

cues.en: We built the Meno Bridge.
cues.zh: 我们建造了梅诺桥。

cues.en: A constant reminder that we can do big transformational things when we work together.
cues.zh: 不断提醒我们，当我们共同努力时，我们可以做出重大变革。

cues.en: And look, you all know I will proudly work with anyone who is ready to deliver for the people of Michigan.
cues.zh: 看，你们都知道，我将自豪地与任何愿意为密歇根人民做出贡献的人合作。

cues.en: But make no mistake, I will be unafraid to stand up to any bully,
cues.zh: 但别误会，我不会害怕对抗任何欺凌者，

cues.en: No matter how powerful, who brings chaos to our communities or tries to put their profits ahead of our people or threatens the rights
cues.zh: 无论多么强大，谁都会给我们的社区带来混乱，或者试图将他们的利润置于我们人民之上，或者威胁我们的权利

cues.en: Or freedoms of Michiganders.
cues.zh: 或者密歇根人的自由。

cues.en: Because I will always fight for you.
cues.zh: 因为我会永远为你而战。

cues.en: No matter who you are, where you live, how you pray, or how you vote.
cues.zh: 无论你是谁、住在哪里、如何祈祷或如何投票。

cues.en: So tonight, you've given us the opportunity to build a Michigan that works for everyone.
cues.zh: 所以今晚，你们让我们有机会建立一个适合所有人的密歇根州。

cues.en: With communities full of people who are ready to roll up their sleeves and get to work,
cues.zh: 社区里到处都是准备好卷起袖子开始工作的人，

cues.en: Winnie Brinks and I, as the first team of women in history leading the state,
cues.zh: 温妮·布林克斯和我，作为历史上第一支领导该州的女性团队，

cues.en: Will carry the work forward.
cues.zh: 将扎实推进工作。

cues.en: Will carry the work forward of the women who came before us, including Gretchen Whitmer,
cues.zh: 将推动包括格雷琴·惠特默在内的前辈女性的工作，

cues.en: Who I want to say a particular thank you to, for your leadership and love for the state of Michigan,
cues.zh: 我要特别感谢你们的领导和对密歇根州的热爱，

cues.en: And for your friendship and support.
cues.zh: 感谢您的友谊和支持。

cues.en: And to every Michigander waiting for government to make a difference in your life,
cues.zh: 对于每一位等待政府改变你的生活的密歇根人，

cues.en: We're ready to get to work for you.
cues.zh: 我们已准备好为您工作。

cues.en: Let's lower costs.
cues.zh: 让我们降低成本。

cues.en: Let's raise our wages.
cues.zh: 让我们提高工资吧。

cues.en: Let's end corruption.
cues.zh: 让我们结束腐败。

cues.en: Let's make Michigan the best place in the nation to call home.
cues.zh: 让我们让密歇根州成为全国最好的家乡。

cues.en: Let's get it done.
cues.zh: 让我们完成它吧。

cues.en: Thank you everyone and good night.
cues.zh: 谢谢大家，晚安。

speaker: Keisha Lance Bottoms
role: 佐治亚州 · 候任州长
title: FULL SPEECH: Here's what Keisha Lance Bottoms had to say to Georgians after historic win

cues.en: Good evening, Georgia.
cues.zh: 晚上好，佐治亚州。

cues.en: Over the last year and a half, we have traveled from the red hills of Georgia to the Blue Ridge mountains of the Piedmont.
cues.zh: 在过去的一年半里，我们从佐治亚州的红山到皮埃蒙特的蓝岭山脉。

cues.en: From the coastal shores to rolling farmlands.
cues.zh: 从沿海海岸到连绵起伏的农田。

cues.en: From urban streets to rural communities.
cues.zh: 从城市街道到农村社区。

cues.en: And with each stop, your faces, your families, your communities, your hopes and your dreams,
cues.zh: 每到一站，你们的面孔、你们的家人、你们的社区、你们的希望和你们的梦想，

cues.en: And even your disappointments have been imprinted upon my heart.
cues.zh: 甚至你的失望也铭刻在我的心上。

cues.en: This campaign was about every community in every corner of Georgia.
cues.zh: 这项活动涉及佐治亚州每个角落的每个社区。

cues.en: It is for the veteran who needs access to health care.
cues.zh: 它适用于需要获得医疗保健的退伍军人。

cues.en: It's for the college student who wonders if the cost of their education is worth it.
cues.zh: 它适合那些想知道他们的教育费用是否值得的大学生。

cues.en: It is for the teenager who's asked about mental health support.
cues.zh: 这是为被询问心理健康支持的青少年准备的。

cues.en: This win is for the caregiver who can't afford health care and needs Georgia to finally expand Medicaid.
cues.zh: 这场胜利是为那些无力承担医疗保健并需要佐治亚州最终扩大医疗补助的护理人员赢得的。

cues.en: It is for the entrepreneur who is seeking to grow her small business.
cues.zh: 它适合寻求发展小型企业的企业家。

cues.en: This win is for the farmer who is trying to hold on to his family land.
cues.zh: 这场胜利属于试图保住家庭土地的农民。

cues.en: It is for the teacher who's working two jobs so that they can educate our children.
cues.zh: 它是为那些同时做两份工作的老师准备的，这样他们就可以教育我们的孩子。

cues.en: And this win is for the child who deserves every opportunity to succeed.
cues.zh: 这场胜利是属于那些值得拥有一切成功机会的孩子的。

cues.en: Georgia, this win is for all of us.
cues.zh: 佐治亚州，这场胜利属于我们所有人。

cues.en: Thank you, Georgia.
cues.zh: 谢谢你，佐治亚州。

cues.en: I am honored to be your 84th governor.
cues.zh: 我很荣幸成为你们的第 84 任州长。

cues.en: I spoke with Rick Jackson just a while ago.
cues.zh: 不久前我和里克·杰克逊谈过。

cues.en: And I thanked him for a hard-fought race.
cues.zh: 我感谢他带来了一场艰苦的比赛。

cues.en: And we agreed that together we would continue to support foster children across this state.
cues.zh: 我们一致同意，我们将共同继续支持全州的寄养儿童。

cues.en: And no matter who you voted for tonight, I will be a governor for all of Georgia.
cues.zh: 无论你今晚投票给谁，我都将成为整个佐治亚州的州长。

cues.en: From the beginning of this campaign, I believed that God would not give vision without provision.
cues.zh: 从这次活动一开始，我就相信上帝不会在没有供应的情况下赐予异象。

cues.en: That provision has come by the way of every prayer sent, every door knocked,
cues.zh: 这个供应是通过每一次祈祷、每一次敲门来实现的，

cues.en: Every phone call made, and every donation given, and every sign that has been planted.
cues.zh: 每打一个电话，每一次捐款，每一个标语。

cues.en: In big and small ways, you've shown that no amount of money will ever Never,
cues.zh: 你在大大小小的方面都表明，再多的钱也永远不会，

cues.en: Ever, ever overcome the power of the people.
cues.zh: 永远、永远战胜人民的力量。

cues.en: To Derrick, you are my rock and the love of my life.
cues.zh: 对于德里克来说，你是我的磐石，也是我一生的挚爱。

cues.en: And I am grateful to be your wife.
cues.zh: 我很感激能成为你的妻子。

cues.en: Lance, Langston, Lennox, and Lincoln.
cues.zh: 兰斯、兰斯顿、伦诺克斯和林肯。

cues.en: The highest honor I will ever have is to be your mother.
cues.zh: 我一生中最高的荣誉就是成为你的母亲。

cues.en: Mama, you are the real mvp.
cues.zh: 妈妈，你才是真正的mvp。

cues.en: And you told me that God was going to show himself at his finest today.
cues.zh: 你告诉我上帝今天将展现他最好的一面。

cues.en: And our God has exceeded all of my expectations.
cues.zh: 我们的神超出了我所有的期望。

cues.en: To my big sister Tracy and my brother Darian.
cues.zh: 致我的姐姐特雷西和我的弟弟达里安。

cues.en: All of my siblings, all of my family, and my dearest friends, I am eternally grateful for you.
cues.zh: 我所有的兄弟姐妹，我所有的家人，还有我最亲爱的朋友，我永远感激你们。

cues.en: And to my daddy.
cues.zh: 还有我的爸爸。

cues.en: Thank you, daddy, for your unconditional love and for instilling in me a fearlessness that made me believe that I could be and do
cues.zh: 爸爸，谢谢您无条件的爱，并给我灌输了无所畏惧的精神，让我相信我可以做到。

cues.en: Whatever my heart desired.
cues.zh: 随心所欲。

cues.en: Grandmama, granddaddy, other mama, and the rest of the great heavenly cloud of witnesses.
cues.zh: 奶奶、爷爷、其他妈妈，以及其他伟大的天上见证人云彩。

cues.en: We have run this way race with perseverance and I know you cheered us on the entire way.
cues.zh: 我们坚持不懈地跑完了这条路，我知道你们全程为我们加油。

cues.en: Sharon Hickson, Rashad Taylor, Darian Johnson.
cues.zh: 莎朗·希克森、拉沙德·泰勒、达里安·约翰逊。

cues.en: The golden three-legged stool is undefeated.
cues.zh: 黄金三足凳不败。

cues.en: And the entire team klb, I wish I had time to call all your names.
cues.zh: 还有 klb 整个团队，我希望我有时间叫出你们所有人的名字。

cues.en: I love and appreciate you all.
cues.zh: 我爱并感谢你们所有人。

cues.en: Tonight I love you, too.
cues.zh: 今晚我也爱你。

cues.en: Tonight would not have been possible without your long hours and your sacrifices.
cues.zh: 如果没有你们长时间的工作和牺牲，今晚就不可能实现。

cues.en: And to the volunteers who committed so much of your own lives to this effort, Thank you.
cues.zh: 感谢那些为这项工作奉献了自己一生的志愿者们，谢谢你。

cues.en: Your never-ending belief in this campaign has made today a reality.
cues.zh: 你们对这场运动永不停歇的信念使今天成为了现实。

cues.en: You sent a message that will ring across our state and our nation.
cues.zh: 您发出的信息将响彻我们州和本州。

cues.en: You voted and you voted with whole ballot energy and we have reelected my friend and our senator Jon Ossoff.
cues.zh: 你们投票了，你们用全部选票的能量投票了，我们再次选举了我的朋友和我们的参议员乔恩·奥索夫。

cues.en: And with Jon Ossoff and my friend and my senator and our senator Raphael Warnock,
cues.zh: 和乔恩·奥索夫、我的朋友、我的参议员和我们的参议员拉斐尔·沃诺克一起，

cues.en: We are blessed to have two senators who make Georgia proud.
cues.zh: 我们很幸运有两位让佐治亚州感到自豪的参议员。

cues.en: Yesterday I had the opportunity to visit Crawfordville, Georgia.
cues.zh: 昨天我有机会访问了佐治亚州克劳福德维尔。

cues.en: The town where my family traces its roots at least five generations.
cues.zh: 我的家族至少有五代人在这个小镇扎根。

cues.en: It was the town that was home to the former governor of Georgia and the vice president of the Confederate States of America, Alexander Stephens.
cues.zh: 这是佐治亚州前州长和美利坚联盟国副总统的家乡。亚历山大·斯蒂芬斯.

cues.en: I visited the grave of Betsy Peak, my great-great-grandmother, who was born in 1845,
cues.zh: 我参观了我的曾曾祖母贝特西·皮克 (Betsy Peak) 的坟墓，她出生于 1845 年，

cues.en: 20 years before emancipation.
cues.zh: 距离解放还有20年。

cues.en: In a cemetery filled with unmarked graves, I found hers.
cues.zh: 在一片没有标记的坟墓的墓地里，我找到了她的坟墓。

cues.en: I don't know what dreams Betsy Peak had for her children or for her grandchildren or the generations that she would never meet,
cues.zh: 我不知道贝特西·皮克对她的孩子、她的孙子或她永远不会见到的几代人有什么梦想，

cues.en: But I know I am standing on shoulders made of steel.
cues.zh: 但我知道我站在钢铁的肩膀上。

cues.en: So, yes, Crawfordville produced the Confederacy's vice president, but tonight it also produced your next governor.
cues.zh: 所以，是的，克劳福德维尔产生了联邦副总统，但今晚它也产生了你们的下一任州长。

cues.en: Tonight should remind us all that no matter what community we come from,
cues.zh: 今晚应该提醒我们所有人，无论我们来自哪个社区，

cues.en: Georgia is not defined by one moment in time or by one person.
cues.zh: 佐治亚州不是由某一时刻或某个人定义的。

cues.en: It's been defined by all of us, and I will be a governor for everyone in this state.
cues.zh: 它是由我们所有人定义的，我将成为本州每个人的州长。

cues.en: Georgia, we sent a message loud and clear that we want a leader who will put Georgia first and who will stand up to
cues.zh: 佐治亚州，我们大声而明确地发出了一个信息，我们想要一位将佐治亚州放在首位并且能够挺身而出的领导人

cues.en: All the chaos coming out of Washington, D.C.
cues.zh: 所有的混乱都来自华盛顿特区

cues.en: But even more importantly, you sent the message that in these times of division and acrimony,
cues.zh: 但更重要的是，你传达的信息是，在这个分裂和尖酸刻薄的时代，

cues.en: You believe in something foundational.
cues.zh: 你相信一些基本的东西。

cues.en: And that is hope.
cues.zh: 这就是希望。

cues.en: And that is why we launched this campaign 532 days ago.
cues.zh: 这就是我们在 532 天前发起这项活动的原因。

cues.en: Over the last year and a half, I've had the privilege of traveling across Georgia,
cues.zh: 在过去的一年半里，我有幸穿越了佐治亚州，

cues.en: Talking with people, listening to their concerns, and hearing how excited Georgians are to have a chance at something better for their families and For their communities.
cues.zh: 与人们交谈，倾听他们的担忧，并听到佐治亚州人为有机会为家人和朋友谋求更好的生活而感到多么兴奋为了他们的社区。

cues.en: Those conversations anchored our campaign because this campaign has always been about the people we serve.
cues.zh: 这些对话奠定了我们的竞选活动的基础，因为这场竞选活动始终以我们服务的人民​​为中心。

cues.en: It's about everyday hardworking people who want to be able to afford to put food on the table,
cues.zh: 这是关于那些每天努力工作的人们，他们希望能够养家糊口，

cues.en: To give our children the opportunities they deserve.
cues.zh: 为我们的孩子提供他们应得的机会。

cues.en: It's about making sure our seniors can age in place with dignity.
cues.zh: 这是为了确保我们的老年人能够有尊严地安享晚年。

cues.en: It's about ensuring that our veterans can receive the health care that they have earned.
cues.zh: 这是为了确保我们的退伍军人能够获得他们应得的医疗保健。

cues.en: This campaign is about making sure that every Georgian, no matter their background,
cues.zh: 这项运动旨在确保每个佐治亚州人，无论其背景如何，

cues.en: Their zip code, has a fair chance at building a better future.
cues.zh: 他们的邮政编码有公平的机会建设更美好的未来。

cues.en: And that is what I will fight for every day as your governor.
cues.zh: 这就是我作为你们的州长每天为之奋斗的目标。

cues.en: This has been a long campaign.
cues.zh: 这是一场漫长的竞选活动。

cues.en: And there are many days that weren't easy, and there were a lot of tough decisions to make.
cues.zh: 有很多日子并不轻松，需要做出很多艰难的决定。

cues.en: But my faith has reminded me that we are never to grow weary in well-doing.
cues.zh: 但我的信仰提醒我，我们永远不要厌倦行善。

cues.en: From Congressman John Lewis, who didn't let batons and billy clubs stop him from demanding that everyone be included in our democracy,
cues.zh: 来自国会议员约翰·刘易斯，他没有让警棍和警棍阻止他要求每个人都参与我们的民主，

cues.en: To my aunt Ruby Doris Smith Robinson, who organized the first sit-ins with students at the Atlanta University Center,
cues.zh: 我的阿姨鲁比·多丽丝·史密斯·罗宾逊在亚特兰大大学中心组织了第一次学生静坐，

cues.en: And to our native son President Jimmy Carter, who made sure that Georgia invested in every school across this country,
cues.zh: 感谢我们的儿子吉米·卡特总统，他确保佐治亚州投资于全国每所学校，

cues.en: Across our state, and even established the Department of Education.
cues.zh: 我们全州，甚至设立了教育部。

cues.en: So, Georgia has always been a state where we didn't settle for what was before us,
cues.zh: 所以，佐治亚州一直是一个我们不满足于眼前的事情的州，

cues.en: But we have always fought for better.
cues.zh: 但我们一直在为更好的目标而奋斗。

cues.en: In acts big and small, we all have the ability to shape our future.
cues.zh: 通过大大小小的行动，我们都有能力塑造我们的未来。

cues.en: That is the legacy that we have in Georgia.
cues.zh: 这就是我们在佐治亚州所拥有的遗产。

cues.en: It's a legacy that comes with responsibility, and it is that responsibility that I will take to the governor's office.
cues.zh: 这是一种伴随着责任的遗产，而我将把这种责任带到州长办公室。

cues.en: I've had a chance to think about not just the path ahead, but the path that we've traveled and the stories I've heard.
cues.zh: 我有机会思考的不仅是前方的道路，还有我们走过的道路和我听到的故事。

cues.en: From the woman in Columbus who owns a child care center because she wants to nurture the next generation,
cues.zh: 来自哥伦布的一位女士，她拥有一家儿童保育中心，因为她想培育下一代，

cues.en: To the woman I met in Atlanta who owns a mobile mammogram clinic,
cues.zh: 对于我在亚特兰大遇到的一位拥有移动乳房X光检查诊所的女士，

cues.en: Who had her funding completely cut with guts to the cdc.
cues.zh: 她的资金完全被削减了，她对疾控中心有勇气。

cues.en: I think about the veteran I met in Augusta who wants support for that small business,
cues.zh: 我想起我在奥古斯塔遇到的一位退伍军人，他希望为那家小企业提供支持，

cues.en: And the teacher in Waycross who's working two jobs to make ends meet,
cues.zh: 韦克罗斯的老师为了维持收支平衡而打两份工，

cues.en: And the student in Albany who told me that she was making choices between rent,
cues.zh: 奥尔巴尼的一名学生告诉我，她正在租金之间做出选择，

cues.en: Food, and her books.
cues.zh: 食物，还有她的书。

cues.en: Our campaign is about Georgians across this state.
cues.zh: 我们的活动是关于全州佐治亚人的。

cues.en: It has been about everyone who wants something better for our future.
cues.zh: 它关乎每个人都希望我们的未来有更好的发展。

cues.en: So, Georgia, I have said over the past few days, "If I were your woman."
cues.zh: 所以，佐治亚，我在过去几天里说过，“如果我是你的女人就好了。”

cues.en: Well, now I am your woman.
cues.zh: 好吧，现在我是你的女人了。

cues.en: And here is what I will do.
cues.zh: 这就是我要做的。

cues.en: I will never, ever, ever stop loving you.
cues.zh: 我永远、永远、永远不会停止爱你。

cues.en: Thank you, Georgia, for electing me as your governor.
cues.zh: 佐治亚州，谢谢您选举我担任州长。

cues.en: God bless you all, and may God bless our great state.
cues.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们所有人，愿上帝保佑我们伟大的国家。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

speaker: Deb Haaland
role: 新墨西哥州 · 候任州长
title: Deb Haaland declares victory in New Mexico Governor's race

cues.en: I'm so happy happy to be here.
cues.zh: 我很高兴来到这里。

cues.en: So much thank you so much for that beautiful beautiful introduction.
cues.zh: 非常感谢您的精彩介绍。

cues.en: It's a great night to be a New Mexican.
cues.zh: 对于新墨西哥人来说，这是一个美好的夜晚。

cues.en: I want to thank my opponent Gregg Hull for putting himself forward to lead our state and for running such a respectful campaign.
cues.zh: 我要感谢我的对手格雷格·赫尔，感谢他挺身而出竞选州长，也感谢他以相互尊重的态度开展竞选。

cues.en: My ancestors came to the Rio Grande Valley in the late 1200s and this beautiful land has sustained all of us for generations.
cues.zh: 我的祖先在 1200 年代末来到了里奥格兰德河谷，这片美丽的土地养育了我们世世代代。

cues.en: The home we all know, mesas, dotted desert, llanos, and agricultural fields, and just beyond this room,
cues.zh: 我们都知道的家，台地、星罗棋布的沙漠、大草原和农田，就在这个房间的另一边，

cues.en: The rivers, mountains, valleys, and basalt flows from volcanoes long past.
cues.zh: 河流、山脉、山谷和玄武岩都从很久以前的火山中流出。

cues.en: Tonight our state proved that Democrats are entrusted to fight for our home for New Mexico, Not New America.
cues.zh: 今晚我们的州证明民主党人有责任为新墨西哥州的家园而战，不是新美国。

cues.en: New Mexico's brightest days ahead of us.
cues.zh: 新墨西哥州最光明的日子就在前方。

cues.en: Because I believe in a New Mexico that works for all New Mexicans.
cues.zh: 因为我相信新墨西哥州适合所有新墨西哥人。

cues.en: A New Mexico, a New Mexico that embraces who we are, the care,
cues.zh: 一个新墨西哥州，一个拥抱我们是谁、关怀、

cues.en: The grit, and the heart that we have to lead the nation.
cues.zh: 我们必须有勇气和勇气来领导国家。

cues.en: To my running mate, Stephanie Garcia Richard, thank you for your partnership, your dedication to our state,
cues.zh: 我的竞选搭档斯蒂芬妮·加西亚·理查德，感谢您的合作以及对我们州的奉献，

cues.en: And your hard work and commitment.
cues.zh: 还有你的辛勤工作和承诺。

cues.en: It gives me endless pride to officially call you New Mexico's next Lieutenant Governor.
cues.zh: 正式称呼您为新墨西哥州的下一任副州长，这让我感到无比自豪。

cues.en: To all the candidates up and down the ballot, congratulations.
cues.zh: 祝贺所有参与选票的候选人。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

cues.en: Thank you for stepping up to serve our communities and working to build the New Mexico we all know is possible.
cues.zh: 感谢您挺身而出为我们的社区服务，并努力建设我们都知道是可能的新墨西哥州。

cues.en: To my amazing and incredible campaign staff.
cues.zh: 感谢我令人惊叹的竞选团队。

cues.en: Some who have been with me since we first launched on February 11th, 2025.
cues.zh: 一些自 2 月 11 日我们首次推出以来就一直陪伴在我身边的人，2025 年。

cues.en: 20 months ago for some of you who don't want to get your calculators out.
cues.zh: 20 个月前，对于那些不想拿出计算器的人来说。

cues.en: And those who joined along the way.
cues.zh: 还有那些一路上加入的人。

cues.en: I thank you all for investing your heart and souls right alongside me.
cues.zh: 我感谢你们所有人将你们的心和灵魂投入到我身边。

cues.en: Thank you all so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢大家。

cues.en: To the organizers and the awesome volunteers who knocked doors, made phone calls,
cues.zh: 感谢组织者和那些敲门、打电话的出色志愿者，

cues.en: Talked to their neighbors, and believed in what we could accomplish together, this moment belongs to all of you.
cues.zh: 与他们的邻居交谈，并相信我们可以共同完成的事情，这一刻属于你们所有人。

cues.en: And to the people of New Mexico, thank you for believing in me to lead our beautiful state for the next four years.
cues.zh: 感谢新墨西哥州人民相信我能够在未来四年领导我们美丽的州。

cues.en: We celebrate this moment right here along Route 66 on its centennial on Laguna Pueblo land.
cues.zh: 我们就在普韦布洛湖土地上的 66 号公路百年纪念日庆祝这一时刻。

cues.en: A huge thanks to Maxine Velasquez and the whole team at Route 66 for making tonight possible.
cues.zh: 非常感谢 Maxine Velasquez 和 66 号公路的整个团队让今晚成为可能。

cues.en: And I'll just say it's always nice to see a woman in charge.
cues.zh: 我只想说，看到一位女性负责总是很高兴。

cues.en: The historic Route 66 has connected our communities, brought people together, and opened doors of opportunity for generations of New Mexicans.
cues.zh: 历史悠久的 66 号公路连接了我们的社区，将人们聚集在一起，并为几代新墨西哥人打开了机会之门。

cues.en: Just off this mother road, my grandparents taught me the importance of hard work,
cues.zh: 就在这条母亲之路旁，我的祖父母教会了我努力工作的重要性，

cues.en: Our responsibility to care for our earth, and our duty to look out for our neighbors.
cues.zh: 我们有责任爱护我们的地球，我们有责任照顾我们的邻居。

cues.en: This place, this land shaped who I am.
cues.zh: 这个地方，这片土地塑造了我。

cues.en: I remember carrying water from the community spigot and playing outside from sunrise to sunset,
cues.zh: 我记得从社区水龙头提水，从日出到日落都在外面玩耍，

cues.en: Spending time in my grandfather's cornfield, helping him irrigate.
cues.zh: 花时间在祖父的玉米地里，帮助他灌溉。

cues.en: I remember watching my grandma bake bread and cook beans in chili.
cues.zh: 我记得看着我奶奶烤面包，用辣椒煮豆子。

cues.en: And just off this road, my grandmother was taken away to boarding school,
cues.zh: 就在这条路旁边，我的祖母被带到了寄宿学校，

cues.en: And along with my grandfather, survived through a time where the federal government attempted to strip them of their languages, Traditions, and identities.
cues.zh: 和我的祖父一起度过了联邦政府试图剥夺他们语言的时期，传统和身份。

cues.en: Yet, we are still here.
cues.zh: 然而，我们还在这里。

cues.en: And tonight, in our nation's 250th year, I stand before you as the first Native American woman elected governor in US history.
cues.zh: 今晚，在我们建国 250 周年之际，我作为美国历史上第一位当选州长的美国原住民女性站在你们面前。

cues.en: But tonight tonight isn't only about history.
cues.zh: 但今晚不仅仅关乎历史。

cues.en: Tonight isn't only about history.
cues.zh: 今晚不仅仅关乎历史。

cues.en: It's about our future.
cues.zh: 这关系到我们的未来。

cues.en: Right now, New Mexicans are working hard, doing everything they're supposed to do,
cues.zh: 现在，新墨西哥人正在努力工作，做他们应该做的一切，

cues.en: And yet we still struggle to get ahead.
cues.zh: 然而我们仍然在努力取得进步。

cues.en: Right now, there is a president in the White House who has enriched himself beyond comprehension while working his hardest to make New Mexicans
cues.zh: 现在，白宫里有一位总统，他一边致富，一边竭尽全力造就新墨西哥人。

cues.en: Sicker, poorer, and hungrier.
cues.zh: 更病、更穷、更饥饿。

cues.en: But time and again, we have said no.
cues.zh: 但我们一次又一次地说不。

cues.en: It is our time.
cues.zh: 这是我们的时代。

cues.en: It's time.
cues.zh: 是时候了。

cues.en: It's time for the single mother in Chaparral working two jobs, doing everything she can to keep food on the table, To get ahead.
cues.zh: 是时候让丛林中的单亲妈妈打两份工，竭尽全力维持餐桌上的食物了，为了取得进步。

cues.en: It's time for the college student in Albuquerque who wants to build a future but has no hope because housing prices are through the
cues.zh: 对于阿尔伯克基的大学生来说，他们想要创造一个未来，但由于房价上涨而没有希望，现在是时候了。

cues.en: Roof to feel like he can graduate and build a prosperous future right here in New Mexico.
cues.zh: 屋顶感觉他可以毕业并在新墨西哥州建立一个繁荣的未来。

cues.en: It's time for families in rural communities who travel hours to see a doctor,
cues.zh: 对于那些需要花几个小时去看医生的农村家庭来说，现在是时候了，

cues.en: Unsure how they'll cover the cost to have affordable, accessible, high-quality healthcare.
cues.zh: 不确定他们将如何支付费用来获得负担得起的、可获得的、高质量的医疗保健。

cues.en: And it's time for union workers in New Mexico to have better access to good-paying jobs like helping build more affordable housing right here
cues.zh: 现在是新墨西哥州工会工人更好地获得高薪工作的时候了，比如帮助在这里建造更多经济适用房

cues.en: In our beautiful state.
cues.zh: 在我们美丽的州。

cues.en: And it's time to make it easier for every parent to give their children a better life that they have always hoped and dreamed Of having.
cues.zh: 现在是时候让每个父母更容易地给孩子们一直希望和梦想的更好的生活了拥有。

cues.en: And that's why I ran for governor.
cues.zh: 这就是我竞选州长的原因。

cues.en: Because I believe in a New Mexico that works for all New Mexicans.
cues.zh: 因为我相信新墨西哥州适合所有新墨西哥人。

cues.en: Because I believe that no matter where you come from, how much money you have,
cues.zh: 因为我相信，无论你来自哪里，有多少钱，

cues.en: Or what challenges you faced, every New Mexican deserves the chance to thrive.
cues.zh: 或者您面临哪些挑战，每个新墨西哥人都应该有机会茁壮成长。

cues.en: Every every New Mexican deserves a bright future.
cues.zh: 每个新墨西哥人都应该拥有光明的未来。

cues.en: And tonight, New Mexicans have said decisively that they want the chance to build that future.
cues.zh: 今晚，新墨西哥人果断表示，他们希望有机会建设这样的未来。

cues.en: New Mexicans deserve a world class education system.
cues.zh: 新墨西哥人值得拥有世界一流的教育体系。

cues.en: I will put reading coaches in classrooms and ensure our educators have the support they need to unlock every student's potential,
cues.zh: 我将在课堂上安排阅读教练，并确保我们的教育工作者获得释放每个学生潜力所需的支持，

cues.en: Whether they choose college, the trades, or the military.
cues.zh: 无论他们选择大学、行业还是军队。

cues.en: New Mexicans know that cyfd must be fixed, and I will get to work on day one to ensure our kids receive the protection
cues.zh: 新墨西哥人知道 cyfd 必须得到解决，我会在第一天开始工作，以确保我们的孩子得到保护

cues.en: And care they deserve.
cues.zh: 和他们应得的关怀。

cues.en: New Mexicans need to feel safe in their neighborhoods, and that's why I'm committed to giving law enforcement the tools they need to get
cues.zh: 新墨西哥人需要在他们的社区感到安全，这就是为什么我致力于为执法部门提供他们所需的工具

cues.en: Violent criminals and illegal drugs off of our streets so we can finally get ahead of this fentanyl crisis and address crime at its
cues.zh: 暴力犯罪分子和非法毒品离开我们的街道，这样我们终于可以战胜芬太尼危机并立即解决犯罪问题

cues.en: Source and get people the help they need.
cues.zh: 寻找并为人们提供他们需要的帮助。

cues.en: New Mexicans are tired of having to travel hours outside of their communities just to access basic health care.
cues.zh: 新墨西哥人厌倦了必须在社区外花费数小时才能获得基本医疗保健。

cues.en: I will create a path toward universal health care.
cues.zh: 我将开辟一条实现全民医疗保健的道路。

cues.en: I will retain and recruit medical professionals and deploy mobile health care clinics so you can access the care you need,
cues.zh: 我将保留和招募医疗专业人员并部署流动医疗保健诊所，以便您可以获得所需的护理，

cues.en: Not just when you're sick, but to stay healthy.
cues.zh: 不仅是在生病时，而且是为了保持健康。

cues.en: New Mexicans deserve leaders who protect our water, our lands, and our precious natural resources.
cues.zh: 新墨西哥人值得拥有保护我们的水、土地和宝贵自然资源的领导人。

cues.en: As governor, I will make sure industries don't come to New Mexico just to use us as a piggy bank while putting our future At risk.
cues.zh: 作为州长，我将确保各行业不会来到新墨西哥州只是为了把我们当作存钱罐，同时把我们的未来有危险。

cues.en: New Mexicans deserve transparency.
cues.zh: 新墨西哥人应该享有透明度。

cues.en: As new companies look to make New Mexico their home, I will demand accountability from every single industry.
cues.zh: 当新公司希望在新墨西哥州落户时，我将要求每个行业承担责任。

cues.en: And because the affordability crisis leaves many New Mexicans wondering how we're going to pay for gas,
cues.zh: 由于负担能力危机让许多新墨西哥人想知道我们将如何支付天然气费用，

cues.en: Buy groceries, or take care of our families, I will expand tax credits for working families and work to raise wages so that more
cues.zh: 购买杂货，或照顾我们的家庭，我将扩大对工薪家庭的税收抵免，并努力提高工资，以便更多人

cues.en: New Mexicans have money in their pockets at the end of the month.
cues.zh: 到月底，新墨西哥人的口袋里就会有钱了。

cues.en: Finally, when the federal government fails to live up to its obligations to our state,
cues.zh: 最后，当联邦政府未能履行对我们州的义务时，

cues.en: I will demand answers and fight for the funding that they have promised.
cues.zh: 我将要求答案并争取他们承诺的资金。

cues.en: Because I've stood up to Donald Trump before and I'm ready to do it again.
cues.zh: 因为我以前曾反抗过唐纳德·特朗普，而且我准备再次这样做。

cues.en: Right now, right now, while families across our state struggle to make ends meet,
cues.zh: 现在，现在，当我们州各地的家庭都在努力维持生计时，

cues.en: Donald Trump is gaming out a path of prosperity for him and his billionaire friends.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普正在为他和他的亿万富翁朋友们谋划一条繁荣之路。

cues.en: On January 1st, on January 1st, 2027, the day I'll officially take office,
cues.zh: 1月1日，2027年1月1日，我正式上任的那天，

cues.en: Is the same month that 89,000 New Mexicans are projected to lose their Medicaid coverage thanks to Trump's big, Ugly bill.
cues.zh: 同月，由于特朗普的大刀阔斧的政策，预计 89,000 名新墨西哥人将失去医疗补助覆盖范围。丑陋的账单。

cues.en: He's cutting snap benefits and making families jump through endless hoops just to get basic healthcare.
cues.zh: 他削减了临时福利，让家庭为了获得基本医疗保健而经历了无尽的困难。

cues.en: His actions threaten the very resources that thousands of New Mexicans rely on to survive,
cues.zh: 他的行为威胁到了成千上万新墨西哥人赖以生存的资源，

cues.en: And he could care less.
cues.zh: 他不在乎。

cues.en: So, our work to combat Trump cuts starts on day one.
cues.zh: 因此，我们应对特朗普削减开支的工作从第一天就开始了。

cues.en: Because no matter what comes out of Washington, we have a responsibility to take care of our people right here at home.
cues.zh: 因为无论华盛顿发生什么，我们都有责任照顾我们国内的人民。

cues.en: Our state legislature is already leading the nation, leading the nation by providing universal childcare and early childhood education.
cues.zh: 我们的州立法机构已经领先于国家，通过提供全民儿童保育和幼儿教育来领先于国家。

cues.en: They have stood up for our state when our family snap benefits were at risk,
cues.zh: 当我们的家庭突然福利面临风险时，他们为我们的州挺身而出，

cues.en: And they'll continue to fund higher education for our students.
cues.zh: 他们将继续资助我们学生的高等教育。

cues.en: I'm excited to work with all of you as we tackle our state's toughest challenges,
cues.zh: 我很高兴能与大家一起应对本州最严峻的挑战，

cues.en: Because to build a more equitable and prosperous New Mexico, we must work together.
cues.zh: 因为为了建设一个更加公平和繁荣的新墨西哥州，我们必须共同努力。

cues.en: We need our teachers, nurses, firefighters, law enforcement officers, small business owners, workers,
cues.zh: 我们需要教师、护士、消防员、执法人员、小企业主、工人、

cues.en: And tribal and community leaders at the table.
cues.zh: 桌边还有部落和社区领袖。

cues.en: And we need Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike to recognize that while we may disagree on how to solve certain problems,
cues.zh: 我们需要民主党人、共和党人和独立人士都认识到，虽然我们可能在如何解决某些问题上存在分歧，

cues.en: We have a shared responsibility to deliver solutions.
cues.zh: 我们有共同的责任提供解决方案。

cues.en: So tonight, I want to speak directly to every New Mexican.
cues.zh: 所以今晚，我想直接对每一位新墨西哥人讲话。

cues.en: To those who voted for me, thank you for your trust.
cues.zh: 感谢那些投票给我的人，感谢你们的信任。

cues.en: To those who did not, I want you to know that I am proud to be your governor too.
cues.zh: 对于那些没有这样做的人，我想让你们知道，我也很自豪能够成为你们的州长。

cues.en: I will listen to you, I will work with you, and I will never forget that serving every New Mexican is a governor's sacred Responsibility.
cues.zh: 我会听你的，我会和你一起工作，我永远不会忘记，为每一位新墨西哥人服务是州长的神圣职责责任。

cues.en: Now I know there are young folks watching tonight who may not know what their future holds.
cues.zh: 现在我知道今晚观看比赛的年轻人可能不知道自己的未来会怎样。

cues.en: They may be growing up in small rural communities.
cues.zh: 他们可能在小型农村社区长大。

cues.en: They may be living on the rez.
cues.zh: 他们可能住在雷兹。

cues.en: They may be watching from Española, Las Cruces, Belen, Hobbs, or even Gallup.
cues.zh: 他们可能在埃斯帕诺拉、拉斯克鲁塞斯、贝伦、霍布斯甚至盖洛普观看。

cues.en: Some of them may be growing up in households where money is tight,
cues.zh: 他们中的一些人可能在资金紧张的家庭中长大，

cues.en: Where their parents work more than one job, or where they wonder what opportunities will actually be available to them when they grow up.
cues.zh: 他们的父母从事不止一份工作，或者他们想知道自己长大后实际上可以获得哪些机会。

cues.en: I want every child watching to know that your dreams matter, and that New Mexico is a place where you can build the life You want.
cues.zh: 我希望每一个观看的孩子都知道你的梦想很重要，新墨西哥州是一个你可以创造生活的地方你想要。

cues.en: Where you can build the life you want close to the communities that raised you.
cues.zh: 在这里，您可以在靠近养育您的社区的地方过上您想要的生活。

cues.en: Here in New Mexico, we can do anything.
cues.zh: 在新墨西哥州，我们可以做任何事情。

cues.en: And I know this because I am living proof.
cues.zh: 我知道这一点，因为我就是活生生的证据。

cues.en: I spent years working on my sobriety.
cues.zh: 我花了很多年的时间努力保持清醒。

cues.en: I raised a child in poverty as a single mom, registered voters in a res car,
cues.zh: 我作为一个单亲妈妈在贫困中养育了一个孩子，在一辆救援车里登记选民，

cues.en: Along dirt roads, and in dust storms, to eventually serve in the halls of Congress and become the first Native American to serve as
cues.zh: 沿着土路，在沙尘暴中，最终在国会大厅任职，并成为第一个担任国会议员的美国原住民

cues.en: A US cabinet secretary.
cues.zh: 美国内阁秘书。

cues.en: And now I'm heading to the Roundhouse to serve as your next governor.
cues.zh: 现在我要去圆屋担任你们的下一任州长。

cues.en: As I've said, as I've said, my journey has never been mine alone.
cues.zh: 正如我说过的，正如我说过的，我的旅程从来都不是我一个人的。

cues.en: My parents raised me to work hard and to care, and I thank them both.
cues.zh: 我的父母养育了我努力工作和关心他人，我感谢他们俩。

cues.en: To Soma, my sisters and my brother, my wonderful extended family and former colleagues,
cues.zh: 致索玛、我的姐妹和兄弟、我美好的大家庭和前同事，

cues.en: I see the sacrifices you all have made for your families and our communities,
cues.zh: 我看到你们为家人和社区做出的牺牲，

cues.en: And I am forever grateful.
cues.zh: 我永远心存感激。

cues.en: I stand here tonight because of the many generations who came before me,
cues.zh: 今晚我站在这里是因为在我之前的许多代人，

cues.en: The family who looked out for me, and the New Mexicans who have always believed that a better New Mexico is possible.
cues.zh: 照顾我的家人，以及始终相信更好的新墨西哥州是可能的新墨西哥人。

cues.en: I will fight for that fair shot in a New Mexico that believes in all of us.
cues.zh: 我将在相信我们所有人的新墨西哥州争取公平的机会。

cues.en: A New Mexico where anyone can grow up, build a family, find a good job,
cues.zh: 一个任何人都可以成长、建立家庭、找到好工作的新墨西哥州，

cues.en: And be proud to call this beautiful state home.
cues.zh: 并自豪地称之为这个美丽的州府。

cues.en: This is a responsibility.
cues.zh: 这是一种责任。

cues.en: This is the responsibility we all share.
cues.zh: 这是我们大家共同的责任。

cues.en: So tonight this campaign ends, and our real work begins.
cues.zh: 今晚这个活动结束了，我们真正的工作开始了。

cues.en: We now turn our a thousands of conversations into action, our promises into progress,
cues.zh: 我们现在将数千次对话转化为行动，将我们的承诺转化为进步，

cues.en: And our shared vision into a better future for all New Mexicans.
cues.zh: 我们共同的愿景是为所有新墨西哥人创造更美好的未来。

cues.en: With our grit, our creativity, our determination, and our willingness to look out for each other,
cues.zh: 凭借我们的勇气、我们的创造力、我们的决心以及我们互相照顾的意愿，

cues.en: I know we can accomplish anything together.
cues.zh: 我知道我们可以一起完成任何事情。

cues.en: And that's why I know New Mexico's brightest days are ahead of us.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么我知道新墨西哥州最光明的日子就在前方。

cues.en: God bless New Mexico.
cues.zh: 上帝保佑新墨西哥州。

cues.en: God bless our country.
cues.zh: 上帝保佑我们的国家。

cues.en: Thank you all so much.
cues.zh: 非常感谢大家。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢你。

title: Amy Klobuchar speaks after winning Minnesota's Governor's race

cues.en: Minnesota, you chose to put your trust in me.
cues.zh: 明尼苏达州的人民，你们选择把信任交给我。

cues.en: A campaign built on substance and not divisiveness.
cues.zh: 这场竞选着眼于实质问题，拒绝制造分裂。

cues.en: On hope,
cues.zh: 选择希望，

cues.en: Hope and not on hate.
cues.zh: 选择希望，而非仇恨。

cues.en: And it is time to move this state forward.
cues.zh: 现在，是时候推动本州向前发展了。

cues.en: I am not interested in moving Minnesota to the left or the right.
cues.zh: 我对将明尼苏达州向左或向右移动不感兴趣。

cues.en: I want to move us forward.
cues.zh: 我想推动我们前进。

cues.en: I am going to be working not just for everyone who voted for me but for all Minnesotans.
cues.zh: 我将为所有明尼苏达州民众工作，包括每一位投票给我的人。

cues.en: Whether or not I got your vote, I will give you my best.
cues.zh: 无论我是否得到你的投票，我都会给你最好的。

cues.en: I want to thank my family, John, our daughter Abigail, my lieutenant governor-elect Ben [surname unclear] and his family,
cues.zh: 我要感谢我的家人、约翰、女儿阿比盖尔，以及候任副州长本[姓氏不清]和他的家人，

cues.en: His wife Tessa, who you're about to see, his five kids, his two cats,
cues.zh: 他的妻子泰莎，你即将见到的，他的五个孩子，他的两只猫，

cues.en: And his one dog.
cues.zh: 还有他的一只狗。

cues.en: I want to thank my incredible staff on this campaign.
cues.zh: 我要感谢这次活动中出色的工作人员。

cues.en: I want to thank our Senate office.
cues.zh: 我要感谢我们的参议院办公室。

cues.en: And I also, now listen, I want to thank my opponent, Lisa Damoth,
cues.zh: 现在我还要感谢我的对手丽莎·达莫斯，

cues.en: Who just called to congratulate me, which I truly appreciate.
cues.zh: 谁刚刚打电话祝贺我，我真的很感激。

cues.en: And I want to wish her family and Lisa the best.
cues.zh: 我祝愿她的家人和丽莎一切顺利。

cues.en: And thank her for her work with the House of Representatives.
cues.zh: 感谢她与众议院的合作。

cues.en: I want to thank this incredible ticket which is going to win Amy to Zach a to Z.
cues.zh: 我要感谢这张令人难以置信的彩票，它将赢得艾米到扎克的所有奖项。

cues.en: And to the people of Minnesota, thank you.
cues.zh: 感谢明尼苏达州人民。

cues.en: Make no mistake, this was a hard election.
cues.zh: 毫无疑问，这是一场艰难的选举。

cues.en: Outside money flooding our state, ugly and hateful attacks that were meant to divide us.
cues.zh: 外部资金涌入我们的州，丑陋和仇恨的攻击旨在分裂我们。

cues.en: But I think we learned a few things tonight.
cues.zh: 但我认为今晚我们学到了一些东西。

cues.en: For one, we learned that a Packers ca fan cannot buy our governor's seat.
cues.zh: 首先，我们了解到包装工队的球迷无法购买我们的州长席位。

cues.en: Even if that guy is a billionaire.
cues.zh: 即使那家伙是亿万富翁。

cues.en: We learned that dark money doesn't win even when we were outspent two to one on ads.
cues.zh: 我们了解到，即使我们在广告上的支出比我们多出两比一，黑钱也不会获胜。

cues.en: And we learned that you can't buy a seat when the people of Minnesota vote.
cues.zh: 我们了解到，当明尼苏达州人民投票时，你买不到席位。

cues.en: And when the people of Minnesota show up and you showed up, Minnesota,
cues.zh: 当明尼苏达州人民出现并且你出现时，明尼苏达州，

cues.en: You showed up like you have all year.
cues.zh: 你像一整年一样出现了。

cues.en: You inspire me.
cues.zh: 你激励我。

cues.en: And as your next governor, I will work my heart out for you.
cues.zh: 作为你们的下一任州长，我将竭尽全力为你们服务。

cues.en: I promise that I will be a transformative governor for this state.
cues.zh: 我保证我将成为本州变革性的州长。

cues.en: In Minnesota, trust is not given, it is earned.
cues.zh: 在明尼苏达州，信任不是给予的，而是赢得的。

cues.en: It comes with expectations and that is results.
cues.zh: 它伴随着期望，那就是结果。

cues.en: And we will deliver results.
cues.zh: 我们将交付成果。

cues.en: Results that you can see and feel in your life and we will do it with our legislature.
cues.zh: 您在生活中可以看到和感受到的结果，我们将与我们的立法机关一起做到这一点。

cues.en: So you deserve to afford a good life, buy that first home, start that business, Retire with dignity.
cues.zh: 所以你应该负担得起美好的生活，购买第一套房子，开始创业，有尊严地退休。

cues.en: You deserve a state government that matches your drive and ambition.
cues.zh: 您值得拥有一个与您的动力和抱负相匹配的州政府。

cues.en: And that is what we're going to do.
cues.zh: 这就是我们要做的。

cues.en: We will root out the waste, the fraud, and the abuse and cut through the red tape.
cues.zh: 我们将根除浪费、欺诈和滥用行为，并消除繁文缛节。

cues.en: A top tobottom audit of state government that starts on day one.
cues.zh: 从第一天开始对州政府进行自上而下的审计。

cues.en: If something works, we will keep it.
cues.zh: 如果有东西有效，我们就会保留它。

cues.en: If it's broken, we will fix it or get rid of it.
cues.zh: 如果它坏了，我们将修复它或摆脱它。

cues.en: We are going to speed up government, rebuild trust, and work for you.
cues.zh: 我们将加快政府进程，重建信任，并为您服务。

cues.en: And I'm looking forward to bringing in a new team and working together with our state employees to make that happen.
cues.zh: 我期待着引入一个新的团队，并与我们的州雇员一起努力实现这一目标。

cues.en: This is not going to be easy to do.
cues.zh: 这并不容易做到。

cues.en: I will need people out there at my side, both parties.
cues.zh: 我需要有人在我身边，双方。

cues.en: And spoiler alert, you may not like every single thing I do, but that is what I ran on.
cues.zh: 剧透警告，你可能不喜欢我做的每一件事，但这就是我所做的。

cues.en: And that is getting things done.
cues.zh: 这就是把事情做好。

cues.en: So we face headwinds every day.
cues.zh: 所以我们每天都面临逆风。

cues.en: Skyrocketing gas prices due to Trump's war, rising health care costs and his tariffs.
cues.zh: 由于特朗普的战争、不断上涨的医疗费用和他的关税，天然气价格飞涨。

cues.en: But as you know right now, he has had a lot of rubber stance to enable him in these last two years.
cues.zh: 但正如你现在所知，在过去的两年里，他有很多橡胶立场来支持他。

cues.en: But tonight, the ink ran out.
cues.zh: 但今晚，墨水用完了。

cues.en: It ran out in Texas.
cues.zh: 它在德克萨斯州用完了。

cues.en: It It ran out in Ohio.
cues.zh: 它在俄亥俄州用完了。

cues.en: It It ran out in South Carolina.
cues.zh: 它在南卡罗来纳州用完了。

cues.en: And it ran out because next senator from the state of Minnesota will be our own Peggy Flanigan.
cues.zh: 它已经用完了，因为明尼苏达州的下一位参议员将是我们自己的佩吉·弗拉尼根。

cues.en: So, so Minnesota, I'm not going to be a rubber stamp for Donald Trump and I will do my job without fear or favor.
cues.zh: 所以，明尼苏达州，我不会成为唐纳德·特朗普的橡皮图章，我将毫无恐惧或偏袒地完成我的工作。

cues.en: I will govern for motans and nobody else.
cues.zh: 我将为莫坦斯而不是其他人执政。

cues.en: And while the headwinds we face may well be a constant, they can never be an excuse.
cues.zh: 尽管我们面临的阻力很可能是持续存在的，但它们永远不能成为借口。

cues.en: That's why I've committed to bring down the cost of health care premiums and bring down the cost of prescription drugs.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么我致力于降低医疗保健费用和处方药的成本。

cues.en: Working working with the private sector to build 100,000 new homes from apartments to single family homes.
cues.zh: 与私营部门合作建造 100,000 套新住宅，从公寓到单户住宅。

cues.en: We are going to have a growth mindset and we're going to have a growth agenda because we must continue to be a state
cues.zh: 我们将拥有增长心态，我们将制定增长议程，因为我们必须继续成为一个国家

cues.en: That makes stuff that invents things and exports to the world.
cues.zh: 它制造出的东西可以发明东西并出口到世界各地。

cues.en: And we are going to make it easier to start a business and double the number of apprenticeships.
cues.zh: 我们将使创业变得更容易，并将学徒数量增加一倍。

cues.en: And when it comes to our schools, we're going to see student achievement up and screen time in the classroom down.
cues.zh: 对于我们的学校来说，我们将看到学生成绩的提高和课堂上的屏幕时间的减少。

cues.en: So after Tim decided not to run, and by the way, we thank Tim and Gwen for their commitment to our state.
cues.zh: 因此，在蒂姆决定不参选之后，顺便说一句，我们感谢蒂姆和格温对我们州的承诺。

cues.en: I look back at the year Minnesota had losing Melissa and Mark, the shooting of the Hoffman's,
cues.zh: 我回顾明尼苏达州失去梅丽莎和马克的那一年，霍夫曼一家的枪击事件，

cues.en: The kids in the church, the 3,000 ICE agents, the serious fraud problem,
cues.zh: 教堂里的孩子、3000 名 ICE 特工、严重的欺诈问题、

cues.en: And the affront on trust in our government.
cues.zh: 以及对我们政府信任的侮辱。

cues.en: You know, I've loved my job in the Senate, but I love our state more.
cues.zh: 你知道，我很喜欢我在参议院的工作，但我更爱我们的州。

cues.en: In the words of Harry Truman about his years in Washington, I tried to never forget who I was,
cues.zh: 用哈里·杜鲁门 (Harry Truman) 谈到他在华盛顿的岁月时的话来说，我努力永远不要忘记自己是谁，

cues.en: Where I came from, and where I would go back to.
cues.zh: 我从哪里来，又要回到哪里。

cues.en: I know where I come from.
cues.zh: 我知道我从哪里来。

cues.en: I know who I am, and I know who I ran for.
cues.zh: 我知道我是谁，我也知道我为谁而竞选。

cues.en: The people of Minnesota.
cues.zh: 明尼苏达州人民。

cues.en: People across each of our 87 incredible counties that I travel to every year.
cues.zh: 我每年都会去 87 个令人难以置信的县，那里的人们遍布其中。

cues.en: I want to thank our staff because we walked 40 miles of parades.
cues.zh: 我要感谢我们的工作人员，因为我们走了 40 英里的游行。

cues.en: We had hours lines outside our state fair booth.
cues.zh: 我们在州博览会展位外排了几个小时的队。

cues.en: We did 30,000 launch signs thanks to you.
cues.zh: 感谢您，我们制作了 30,000 个发射标志。

cues.en: I think of the people we met, the Nelson family outside of Morehead.
cues.zh: 我想起了我们遇到的人，莫尔黑德郊外的纳尔逊一家。

cues.en: Four generations who have now farmed the land.
cues.zh: 现在已经有四代人耕种这片土地了。

cues.en: Kate Lungquist, a breast cancer survivor.
cues.zh: 凯特·朗奎斯特，乳腺癌幸存者。

cues.en: Julie Pider, her turn who turned her grief into a mission and carried it all the way to Washington after losing her husband to Cancer from toxins.
cues.zh: 朱莉·皮德 (Julie Pider) 在失去丈夫后，将悲伤转化为使命，一路来到华盛顿。癌症来自毒素。

cues.en: The students at Apollo High School in St. Cloud.
cues.zh: 圣克劳德阿波罗高中的学生。

cues.en: Gwen Elliott, who lives in a manufactured home in Blaine and has fought,
cues.zh: 格温·埃利奥特 (Gwen Elliott) 住在布莱恩的活动房屋里，曾与

cues.en: As we will do, with the legislature, to make sure these homeowners are treated fairly.
cues.zh: 正如我们将与立法机关所做的那样，以确保这些房主受到公平对待。

cues.en: And I think my friends of Harper Mo's parents, listen to this, Mike and Jackie,
cues.zh: 我想哈珀·莫父母的朋友们，听听这个，迈克和杰基，

cues.en: Little Harper, who had just begun fifth grade when those bullets rained through the stained glass windows.
cues.zh: 当子弹从彩色玻璃窗中倾泻而下时，小哈珀刚刚上五年级。

cues.en: She would have turned 12 today.
cues.zh: 今天她就满12岁了。

cues.en: Today is her birthday.
cues.zh: 今天是她的生日。

cues.en: So, thanks to your work and what I think is happening with the Minnesota legislature today,
cues.zh: 因此，感谢您的工作以及我认为明尼苏达州立法机关今天所发生的事情，

cues.en: We will get that gun safety vote and I will sign that bill into law.
cues.zh: 我们将进行枪支安全投票，我将将该法案签署为法律。

cues.en: I think of so many of you that have stood up.
cues.zh: 我想到你们中有很多人站起来了。

cues.en: When ice descended on our state, you brought food to strangers and kids to school.
cues.zh: 当冰雪降临我们州时，你们为陌生人和孩子们送去学校的食物。

cues.en: You marched 50,000 strong in sub-zero weather in what will be one of the top civil rights moments of our century in this country.
cues.zh: 你们在零度以下的天气里游行了五万人，这将是这个国家本世纪最重要的民权时刻之一。

cues.en: And after the horror of Renee Good and Alex Prey, their senseless killings,
cues.zh: 在蕾妮·古德和亚历克斯·普雷的恐怖经历以及他们毫无意义的杀戮之后，

cues.en: We didn't look down.
cues.zh: 我们没有往下看。

cues.en: We looked up.
cues.zh: 我们抬头一看。

cues.en: We didn't look away.
cues.zh: 我们没有移开目光。

cues.en: We looked at each other.
cues.zh: 我们面面相觑。

cues.en: And with their family's guidance, I went back to Washington and grilled Christy Gnome.
cues.zh: 在他们家人的指导下，我回到华盛顿，烤了克里斯蒂·诺姆。

cues.en: And the next day, she got fired.
cues.zh: 第二天，她就被解雇了。

cues.en: And months after that, months after that, I got a call from Ambassador Caroline Kennedy.
cues.zh: 几个月后，几个月后，我接到了卡罗琳·肯尼迪大使的电话。

cues.en: She said they're giving the profiling courage award named after her dad to Minnesota.
cues.zh: 她说他们将以她父亲的名字命名的勇气奖颁给明尼苏达州。

cues.en: And she asked me, she asked me, should it go to an elected official?
cues.zh: 她问我，她问我，它应该交给民选官员吗？

cues.en: And I said, "No, give it to the people."
cues.zh: 我说：“不，把它交给人民。”

cues.en: And that is what happened.
cues.zh: 这就是发生的事情。

cues.en: And a few weeks later, a middle school class from St. Paul came to see me.
cues.zh: 几周后，圣保罗的一个中学班来找我。

cues.en: And this little 14-year-old M girl who was this tall, but she stood like she was six feet tall.
cues.zh: 还有这个14岁的小M女孩，这么高，但站起来就像有六英尺高。

cues.en: She looked at me and said, "So the people got the award?" I said, "Yeah."
cues.zh: 她看着我说：“所以这些人获奖了？”我说：“是啊。”

cues.en: And then she said, "That means she said I got the award."
cues.zh: 然后她说：“这意味着她说我获奖了。”

cues.en: She said, "I got the award."
cues.zh: 她说：“我获奖了。”

cues.en: That is the spirit with which I decided to take this job.
cues.zh: 这就是我决定接受这份工作的精神。

cues.en: And that is a spirit of our state.
cues.zh: 这就是我们国家的精神。

cues.en: It is a spirit that will carry us to a higher ground.
cues.zh: 这种精神将带领我们走向更高的境界。

cues.en: We will not rest on our laurels.
cues.zh: 我们不会固步自封。

cues.en: And I will end with my story.
cues.zh: 我将以我的故事结束。

cues.en: My grandpa worked 1500 ft underground up in northern Minnesota.
cues.zh: 我的祖父在明尼苏达州北部 1500 英尺的地下工作。

cues.en: He saved money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to a two-year community college.
cues.zh: 他在地下室的一个咖啡罐里存了钱，送我父亲去一所两年制社区大学。

cues.en: My dad went on from that hard scrabble mining town to be a beloved journalist covering the Minnesota Vikings.
cues.zh: 我父亲从那个艰苦的拼字游戏小镇长大后，成为一名报道明尼苏达维京人队的受人爱戴的记者。

cues.en: My mom, a proud union member, and thank you labor for being in the house.
cues.zh: 我的妈妈，一位自豪的工会成员，感谢你们来到家里。

cues.en: My mom taught second grade until she was 70 years old.
cues.zh: 我妈妈教二年级直到她70岁。

cues.en: I still have people come up to me on the street and say she is their favorite teacher.
cues.zh: 仍然有人在街上来找我，说她是他们最喜欢的老师。

cues.en: So I stand before you today as a granddaughter of an iron or minor who never got to graduate from high school,
cues.zh: 所以今天我作为一个从未高中毕业的铁人或未成年人的孙女站在你们面前，

cues.en: The daughter of a teacher and a newspaper man.
cues.zh: 教师和报人的女儿。

cues.en: And thanks to you, the first woman elected to the United States Senate from the state of Minnesota.
cues.zh: 感谢您，第一位从明尼苏达州当选为美国参议员的女性。

cues.en: And thanks to you, the first woman elected governor of the state of Minnesota.
cues.zh: 感谢您，第一位当选明尼苏达州州长的女性。

cues.en: Our past, Minnesota, has made us who we are, but our future is up to us.
cues.zh: 明尼苏达州，我们的过去造就了现在的我们，但我们的未来取决于我们。

cues.en: I want to build that future together.
cues.zh: 我想共同建设这个未来。

cues.en: I want to build that future for everyone, and I know you do, Too.
cues.zh: 我想为每个人建设这样的未来，我知道你也这么做，也是。

cues.en: We have a lot of work to do.
cues.zh: 我们还有很多工作要做。

cues.en: We're going to start right away working with our legislators, Aaron Murphy, Zack Stevenson, The next leader.
cues.zh: 我们将立即开始与我们的立法者亚伦·墨菲、扎克·史蒂文森合作，下一个领导者。

cues.en: Peggy Flanigan.
cues.zh: 佩吉·弗拉尼根。

cues.en: And by the way, let's let's thank Tina Smith for her service with Keith Ellison and Steve Simon.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，让我们感谢蒂娜·史密斯为基思·埃里森和史蒂夫·西蒙提供的服务。

cues.en: And Zack Filipovich and when we're done, everyone will know how to say his name.
cues.zh: 还有扎克·菲利波维奇（Zack Filipovich），当我们完成后，每个人都会知道如何说出他的名字。

cues.en: And Ben Sher, Minnesota's next lieutenant governor, the first person, the first person elected statewide from the seventh congressional district in over 90 years.
cues.zh: 还有明尼苏达州的下一任副州长本·谢尔（Ben Sher），他是 90 多年来第一人，第一个从第七个国会选区在全州范围内当选的人。

cues.en: So, let us get to work.
cues.zh: 那么，让我们开始工作吧。

cues.en: Let us move forward.
cues.zh: 让我们继续前进。

cues.en: And tonight, we will celebrate this election.
cues.zh: 今晚，我们将庆祝这次选举。

cues.en: Thank you everyone.
cues.zh: 谢谢大家。
